import 'package:shelf/shelf.dart' as shelf;

typedef Headers = Map<String, String>;

class Request {
  Request(this.inner);
  final shelf.Request inner;
  Uri get url => inner.requestedUri;
  String get method => inner.method;
  Future<String> readAsString() => inner.readAsString();
  dynamic get context => inner.context;
  Headers get headers => Map.fromEntries(inner.headers.entries);
  String? header(String name) => inner.headers[name];
}

class Response {
  final int status;
  final Headers headers;
  final String body;
  Response(this.status, {this.headers = const {}, this.body = ''});

  shelf.Response toShelf() => shelf.Response(
    status, headers: headers, body: body,
  );

  static Response ok(String body, {Headers headers = const {}}) =>
      Response(200, headers: headers, body: body);

  static Response json(String json, {int status = 200, Headers headers = const {}}) =>
      Response(status, headers: {...headers, 'content-type': 'application/json'}, body: json);
}
""")

write(os.path.join(dartvel_root, "packages/dartvel_core/lib/src/ssg.dart"), """
import 'dart:io';
import 'http.dart';

final _cacheDir = Directory('.dartvel/.cache');

Future<String> renderWithISR(dynamic pageOrShim, Request req, {int? ttl}) async {
  _cacheDir.createSync(recursive: true);
  final path = req.url.path;
  final key = path.isEmpty ? 'index' : path.replaceAll('/', '_');
  final file = File('${_cacheDir.path}/$key.html');

  if (ttl == null) {
    return await _direct(pageOrShim, req);
  }
  if (file.existsSync()) {
    final age = DateTime.now().difference(file.lastModifiedSync()).inSeconds;
    if (ttl == 0 || age < ttl) return file.readAsStringSync();
  }
  final html = await _direct(pageOrShim, req);
  file.writeAsStringSync(html);
  return html;
}

Future<String> _direct(dynamic pageOrShim, Request req) async {
  if (pageOrShim is _JasprShim) return await pageOrShim.call(req);
  throw UnimplementedError('Only jaspr pages are supported in this starter.');
}

// Internal shim used by jaspr adapter
class _JasprShim<T> {
  _JasprShim(this.getProps, this.build);
  final Future<T> Function(Request) getProps;
  final Function build;
  Future<String> call(Request req) async {
    final props = await getProps(req);
    return await (build as Future<String> Function(dynamic))(props);
  }
}
""")

write(os.path.join(dartvel_root, "packages/dartvel_core/lib/src/middleware.dart"), """
class Next { const Next(); }
class Rewrite { const Rewrite(this.to); final String to; }
class Redirect { const Redirect(this.to, {this.permanent=false}); final String to; final bool permanent; }
typedef Middleware = Future<Object> Function(dynamic req);
""")

write(os.path.join(dartvel_root, "packages/dartvel_core/lib/src/image_handler.dart"), """
import 'dart:io';
import 'http.dart';

Future<Response> imageHandler(Request req) async {
  final q = req.url.queryParameters;
  final url = q['url'];
  if (url == null) return Response(400, body: 'Missing url');
  final client = HttpClient();
  final resp = await (await client.getUrl(Uri.parse(url))).close();
  final bytes = await resp.fold<List<int>>([], (p, e) { p.addAll(e); return p; });
  return Response(200, headers: {
    'content-type': resp.headers.contentType?.mimeType ?? 'image/jpeg',
    'cache-control': 'public, max-age=86400'
  }, body: String.fromCharCodes(bytes));
}
""")

write(os.path.join(dartvel_root, "packages/dartvel_core/lib/src/jaspr_adapter.dart"), """
import 'package:jaspr/jaspr.dart';
import 'http.dart';
import 'ssg.dart';

typedef JasprGetServerProps<T> = Future<T> Function(Request req);
typedef JasprBuild<T> = Component Function(T props);

class JasprPage<T> {
  const JasprPage({this.revalidateSeconds, required this.getProps, required this.build});
  final int? revalidateSeconds;
  final JasprGetServerProps<T> getProps;
  final JasprBuild<T> build;
}

Future<String> _renderComponentToString(Component c) async {
  // jaspr provides a server renderer that returns full HTML string.
  final app = Document(
    child: c,
    doctype: true,
  );
  // In minimal starter, we rely on toString rendering.
  // For real apps, switch to jaspr server-side rendering utilities.
  return renderToString(app);
}

Future<String> renderJasprPage<T>(JasprPage<T> page, Request req) async {
  Future<String> render() async {
    final props = await page.getProps(req);
    final html = await _renderComponentToString(page.build(props));
    return html;
  }
  if (page.revalidateSeconds == null) {
    return render();
  }
  return renderWithISR(_JasprShim(page.getProps, (p) async => await _renderComponentToString(page.build(p))), req, ttl: page.revalidateSeconds!);
}

// local shim type (compatible with ssg.dart)
class _JasprShim<T> {
  _JasprShim(this.getProps, this.build);
  final Future<T> Function(Request) getProps;
  final Future<String> Function(T) build;
  Future<String> call(Request req) async => await build(await getProps(req));
}
""")

write(os.path.join(dartvel_root, "packages/dartvel_core/lib/src/router.dart"), """
import 'package:shelf/shelf.dart' as shelf;
import 'http.dart';
import 'image_handler.dart';
import 'jaspr_adapter.dart';

typedef Handler = Future<Response> Function(Request req);

class RouteManifest {
  RouteManifest({required this.api, required this.pages});
  final Map<String, Handler> api;
  final Map<String, JasprPage<dynamic>> pages;
}

class DartvelApp {
  DartvelApp(this.manifest, {this.middleware});
  final RouteManifest manifest;
  final Future<Object> Function(Request req)? middleware;

  Future<shelf.Response> handle(shelf.Request r) async {
    final req = Request(r);

    // Middleware
    if (middleware != null) {
      final m = await middleware!(req);
      if (m is Rewrite) {
        final newUri = r.requestedUri.replace(path: m.to);
        final newReq = shelf.Request(r.method, newUri, headers: r.headers, body: await r.readAsString());
        return await handle(newReq);
      } else if (m is Redirect) {
        return shelf.Response(m.permanent ? 308 : 307, headers: {'location': m.to});
      }
    }

    // image
    if (req.url.path.startsWith('_dartvel/image')) {
      return (await imageHandler(req)).toShelf();
    }

    // API routes (exact path match)
    final apiHandler = manifest.api['/${req.url.path}'];
    if (apiHandler != null) {
      return (await apiHandler(req)).toShelf();
    }

    // Pages
    final page = manifest.pages['/${req.url.path}'] ?? manifest.pages['/'];
    if (page != null) {
      final html = await renderJasprPage(page, req);
      return Response(200, headers: {'content-type': 'text/html; charset=utf-8'}, body: html).toShelf();
    }

    return shelf.Response.notFound('Not Found');
  }
}
""")

write(os.path.join(dartvel_root, "packages/dartvel_cli/bin/dartvel.dart"), """
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:args/args.dart';
import 'package:shelf/shelf.dart' as shelf;
import 'package:shelf/shelf_io.dart' as shelf_io;
import 'package:yaml/yaml.dart';
import 'package:path/path.dart' as p;
import 'package:dartvel_core/dartvel.dart';

Future<void> main(List<String> args) async {
  final parser = ArgParser()
    ..addCommand('dev')
    ..addCommand('start')
    ..addCommand('generate');
  final res = parser.parse(args);
  switch (res.command?.name) {
    case 'dev':
      await _generate();
      await _start(dev: true);
      break;
    case 'start':
      await _start(dev: false);
      break;
    case 'generate':
      await _generate();
      break;
    default:
      print('Usage: dartvel <dev|start|generate>');
  }
}

Future<void> _generate() async {
  final cfgFile = File('dartvel.yaml');
  if (!cfgFile.existsSync()) {
    stderr.writeln('dartvel.yaml not found in current directory.');
    exit(2);
  }
  final cfg = loadYaml(await cfgFile.readAsString()) as YamlMap;
  final pages = (cfg['routes']?['pages'] as YamlMap?) ?? YamlMap();
  final api = (cfg['routes']?['api'] as YamlMap?) ?? YamlMap();
  final isrDefault = (cfg['isr']?['defaultSeconds']) ?? null;
  final isrOverrides = (cfg['isr']?['overrides'] as YamlMap?) ?? YamlMap();

  final buf = StringBuffer();
  buf.writeln("// GENERATED - do not edit");
  buf.writeln("import 'package:dartvel_core/dartvel.dart';");
  buf.writeln("import 'package:jaspr/jaspr.dart' show Component;");

  int i = 0;
  pages.forEach((route, file) {
    final alias = "p_${i++}";
    buf.writeln("import '${file}' as ${alias};");
  });

  int j = 0;
  api.forEach((route, file) {
    final alias = "a_${j++}";
    buf.writeln("import '${file}' as ${alias};");
  });

  buf.writeln("final pageRoutes = <String, JasprPage<dynamic>>{");
  i = 0;
  pages.forEach((route, file) {
    final alias = "p_${i++}";
    final override = isrOverrides[route] ?? isrDefault;
    if (override == null) {
      buf.writeln("  '${route}': JasprPage(getProps: ${alias}.getProps, build: ${alias}.build),");
    } else {
      buf.writeln("  '${route}': JasprPage(revalidateSeconds: ${override}, getProps: ${alias}.getProps, build: ${alias}.build),");
    }
  });
  buf.writeln("};");

  buf.writeln("typedef Handler = Future<Response> Function(Request req);");
  buf.writeln("final apiRoutes = <String, Handler>{");
  j = 0;
  api.forEach((route, file) {
    final alias = "a_${j++}";
    buf.writeln("  '${route}': ${alias}.handler,");
  });
  buf.writeln("};");

  final outDir = Directory('.dart_tool');
  outDir.createSync(exist_ok=True)
  with open(os.path.join(outDir.path, 'dartvel_routes.g.dart'), 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
      f.write(buf.getvalue())

  # Also generate a tiny server entry so you can `dart run .dart_tool/dartvel_server.dart`
  server = f"""
// GENERATED server entry
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:shelf/shelf.dart' as shelf;
import 'package:shelf/shelf_io.dart' as shelf_io;
import 'package:dartvel_core/dartvel.dart';
import 'dartvel_routes.g.dart' as routes;

Future<void> main() async {{
  final app = DartvelApp(RouteManifest(api: routes.apiRoutes, pages: routes.pageRoutes));
  final handler = const shelf.Pipeline().addMiddleware(shelf.logRequests()).addHandler(app.handle);
  final port = int.tryParse(Platform.environment['PORT'] ?? '3000') ?? 3000;
  final server = await shelf_io.serve(handler, '0.0.0.0', port);
  print('dartvel dev server on http://localhost:${{server.port}}');
}}
"""
  with open(os.path.join(outDir.path, 'dartvel_server.dart'), 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
      f.write(server)

  print('Generated .dart_tool/dartvel_routes.g.dart and .dart_tool/dartvel_server.dart')
}

Future<void> _start({required bool dev}) async {
  // simply run the generated server
  final proc = await Process.start('dart', ['run', '.dart_tool/dartvel_server.dart']);
  stdout.addStream(proc.stdout);
  stderr.addStream(proc.stderr);
  final code = await proc.exitCode;
  exit(code);
}
""")

cd creator_x

dartvel dev        # start dev server

    final alias = "a_${j++}";

  });
  buf.writeln("};");

// GENERATED server entry
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:shelf/shelf.dart' as shelf;
import 'package:shelf/shelf_io.dart' as shelf_io;
import 'package:dartvel_core/dartvel.dart';
import 'dartvel_routes.g.dart' as routes;
import 'package:shelf_proxy/shelf_proxy.dart';

Future<void> main() async {
  final app = DartvelApp(RouteManifest(api: routes.apiRoutes, pages: routes.pageRoutes));

Future<void> _start({required bool dev}) async {
  // If dev, we can optionally start simple reverse proxies for flutter apps.
  final cfg = await _loadCfg();
  final flutterApps = (cfg['runtime']?['flutter_apps'] as List?) ?? [];
  final proxies = <String, String>{};
  for (final app in flutterApps) {

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

enum NodeType { container, text }

class Node {
  Node({
    required this.id,
    required this.type,
    required this.x,
    required this.y,
    required this.w,
    required this.h,
    this.rotation = 0,
    this.props = const {},
  });
  final String id;
  final NodeType type;
  double x, y, w, h;
  double rotation;
  Map<String, dynamic> props;
}

Widget renderNode(Node n) {
  switch (n.type) {
    case NodeType.container:
      final fill = _toColor(n.props['fill']) ?? const Color(0xFF222222);
      final radius = (n.props['borderRadius'] ?? 8).toDouble();
      return ClipRRect(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(radius),
        child: Container(color: fill),
      );
    case NodeType.text:
      return Center(
        child: Text(
          n.props['text'] ?? 'Text',
          textAlign: TextAlign.center,
          style: TextStyle(
            fontSize: (n.props['fontSize'] ?? 16).toDouble(),
            color: _toColor(n.props['textColor']) ?? Colors.white,
          ),
        ),
      );
  }
}

Color? _toColor(dynamic v) {
  if (v is Color) return v;
  if (v is String && v.startsWith('#') && (v.length == 9 || v.length == 7)) {
    final hex = v.length == 7 ? 'FF${v.substring(1)}' : v.substring(1);
    return Color(int.parse(hex, radix=16));
  }
  return null;
}
"""

import 'package:hooks_riverpod/hooks_riverpod.dart';
import 'models.dart';
import 'package:uuid/uuid.dart';

final nodesProvider = StateNotifierProvider<NodesNotifier, List<Node>>((ref) => NodesNotifier());

final selectionProvider = StateProvider<String?>((_) => null);

class NodesNotifier extends StateNotifier<List<Node>> {
  NodesNotifier(): super([]);
  final _uuid = const Uuid();

  void add(NodeType type) {
    state = [
      ...state,
      Node(
        id: _uuid.v4(),
        type: type,
        x: 80, y: 80, w: type == NodeType.text ? 220 : 200, h: type == NodeType.text ? 60 : 120,
        props: type == NodeType.text ? {'text':'Text','fontSize':18,'textColor':'#FFFFFFFF'} : {'fill':'#FF4F46E5','borderRadius':12},
      )
    ];
  }

  void move(String id, double dx, double dy) {
    state = [
      for (final n in state)
        if (n.id == id) Node(id: n.id, type: n.type, x: n.x+dx, y: n.y+dy, w: n.w, h: n.h, rotation: n.rotation, props: n.props)
        else n
    ];
  }

  void resize(String id, {double? w, double? h}) {
    state = [
      for (final n in state)
        if (n.id == id) Node(id: n.id, type: n.type, x: n.x, y: n.y, w: w ?? n.w, h: h ?? n.h, rotation: n.rotation, props: n.props)
        else n
    ];
  }

  void setProp(String id, String key, dynamic value) {
    state = [
      for (final n in state)
        if (n.id == id) Node(id: n.id, type: n.type, x: n.x, y: n.y, w: n.w, h: n.h, rotation: n.rotation, props: {...n.props, key: value})
        else n
    ];
  }
}

class StudioApp extends StatelessWidget {

class EditorScreen extends ConsumerWidget {

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    return Scaffold(

      body: Row(

          Expanded(child: CanvasView()),
          SizedBox(width: 280, child: InspectorPanel()),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class Palette extends ConsumerWidget {
  const Palette({super.key});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final nodes = ref.read(nodesProvider.notifier);
    return Container(
      color: const Color(0xFF111111),
      child: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
        children: [
          ListTile(
            title: const Text('Add Container', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white)),
            onTap: () => nodes.add(NodeType.container),
          ),
          ListTile(
            title: const Text('Add Text', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white)),
            onTap: () => nodes.add(NodeType.text),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class CanvasView extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const CanvasView({super.key});
  @override
  ConsumerState<CanvasView> createState() => _CanvasViewState();
}

class _CanvasViewState extends ConsumerState<CanvasView> {
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final nodes = ref.watch(nodesProvider);
    final selected = ref.watch(selectionProvider);
    return Container(
      color: const Color(0xFF1F1F1F),
      child: Stack(
        children: [
          for (final n in nodes)
            Positioned(
              left: n.x, top: n.y, width: n.w, height: n.h,
              child: GestureDetector(
                onTap: () => ref.read(selectionProvider.notifier).state = n.id,
                onPanUpdate: (d) => ref.read(nodesProvider.notifier).move(n.id, d.delta.dx, d.delta.dy),
                child: Stack(
                  clipBehavior: Clip.none,
                  children: [
                    DecoratedBox(
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        boxShadow: selected == n.id ? [BoxShadow(color: Colors.blue.withOpacity(.25), blurRadius: 16)] : null,
                        border: selected == n.id ? Border.all(color: Colors.blueAccent, width: 1.5) : null,
                      ),
                      child: renderNode(n),
                    ),
                    if (selected == n.id)
                      Positioned(
                        right: -10, bottom: -10,
                        child: GestureDetector(
                          onPanUpdate: (d) => ref.read(nodesProvider.notifier).resize(n.id, w: n.w + d.delta.dx, h: n.h + d.delta.dy),
                          child: const _Handle(),
                        ),
                      ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _Handle extends StatelessWidget {
  const _Handle();
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Container(width: 16, height: 16, decoration: BoxDecoration(color: Colors.white, border: Border.all(color: Colors.blue, width: 2)));
  }
}

class InspectorPanel extends ConsumerWidget {
  const InspectorPanel({super.key});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final selectedId = ref.watch(selectionProvider);
    final nodes = ref.watch(nodesProvider);
    final node = nodes.where((n) => n.id == selectedId).cast<Node?>().firstOrNull;
    if (node == null) {
      return Container(color: const Color(0xFF111111), child: const Center(child: Text('Select a node', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white54))));
    }
    return Container(
      color: const Color(0xFF111111),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
      child: ListView(
        children: [
          Text('Node ${node.id.substring(0,6)}', style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white70)),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          if (node.type == NodeType.text) TextField(
            style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white),
            decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Text', labelStyle: TextStyle(color: Colors.white70)),
            controller: TextEditingController(text: node.props['text'] ?? '')..selection = TextSelection.collapsed(offset: (node.props['text'] ?? '').toString().length),
            onSubmitted: (v) => ref.read(nodesProvider.notifier).setProp(node.id, 'text', v),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

extension FirstOrNull<E> on Iterable<E> {

viewer_main = """
import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;

void main() => runApp(const ViewerApp());

class ViewerApp extends StatelessWidget {
  const ViewerApp({super.key});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return MaterialApp(
      title: 'CreatorX Viewer',
      theme: ThemeData.dark(useMaterial3: true),
      home: const ViewerScreen(),
      debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false,
    );
  }
}

class ViewerScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const ViewerScreen({super.key});
  @override
  State<ViewerScreen> createState() => _ViewerScreenState();
}

class _ViewerScreenState extends State<ViewerScreen> {
  Map<String, dynamic>? snapshot;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    final res = await http.get(Uri.parse('/api/projects/snapshot'));
    if (res.statusCode == 200) {
      setState(() => snapshot = jsonDecode(res.body) as Map<String, dynamic>);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final s = snapshot;
    if (s == null) return const Scaffold(body: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()));
    final nodes = (s['nodes'] as List).cast<Map<String, dynamic>>();
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('CreatorX Viewer')),
      body: Container(
        color: const Color(0xFF101010),
        child: Stack(
          children: [
            for (final n in nodes) _buildNode(n),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildNode(Map<String,dynamic> n) {
    final x = (n['x'] as num).toDouble();
    final y = (n['y'] as num).toDouble();
    final w = (n['w'] as num).toDouble();
    final h = (n['h'] as num).toDouble();
    final type = n['type'] as String;
    final props = (n['props'] as Map).cast<String, dynamic>();

    Widget child;
    if (type == 'Container') {
      final color = _parseColor(props['fill']) ?? const Color(0xFF222222);
      final radius = (props['borderRadius'] ?? 8).toDouble();
      child = ClipRRect(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(radius), child: Container(color: color));
    } else if (type == 'Text') {
      child = Center(
        child: Text(props['text'] ?? '',
          style: TextStyle(fontSize: (props['fontSize'] ?? 16).toDouble(), color: _parseColor(props['textColor']) ?? Colors.white),
          textAlign: TextAlign.center,
        ),
      );
    } else {
      child = const SizedBox.shrink();
    }

    return Positioned(left: x, top: y, width: w, height: h, child: child);
  }

  Color? _parseColor(dynamic v) {
    if (v is String && v.startsWith('#')) {
      final hex = v.length == 7 ? 'FF${v.substring(1)}' : v.substring(1);
      return Color(int.parse(hex, radix: 16));
    }
    return null;
  }
}
"""

def zip_dir(src_dir, zip_path):
    with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
        for root, _, files in os.walk(src_dir):
            for f in files:
                full = os.path.join(root, f)
                rel = os.path.relpath(full, src_dir)
                z.write(full, rel)

write(os.path.join(dartvel_root, "packages/dartvel_core/lib/src/http.dart"), """import 'package:shelf/shelf.dart' as shelf;

typedef Headers = Map<String, String>;

class Request {
  Request(this.inner);
  final shelf.Request inner;
  Uri get url => inner.requestedUri;
  String get method => inner.method;
  Future<String> readAsString() => inner.readAsString();
  dynamic get context => inner.context;
  Headers get headers => Map.fromEntries(inner.headers.entries);
  String? header(String name) => inner.headers[name];
}

class Response {
  final int status;
  final Headers headers;
  final String body;
  Response(this.status, {this.headers = const {}, this.body = ''});

  shelf.Response toShelf() => shelf.Response(status, headers: headers, body: body);

  static Response ok(String body, {Headers headers = const {}}) => Response(200, headers: headers, body: body);

  static Response json(String json, {int status = 200, Headers headers = const {}}) =>
      Response(status, headers: {...headers, 'content-type': 'application/json'}, body: json);
}
""")

write(os.path.join(dartvel_root, "packages/dartvel_core/lib/src/ssg.dart"), """import 'dart:io';
import 'http.dart';

final _cacheDir = Directory('.dartvel/.cache');

Future<String> renderWithISR(dynamic pageOrShim, Request req, {int? ttl}) async {
  _cacheDir.createSync(recursive: true);
  final path = req.url.path;
  final key = path.isEmpty ? 'index' : path.replaceAll('/', '_');
  final file = File('${_cacheDir.path}/$key.html');

  if (ttl == null) {
    return await _direct(pageOrShim, req);
  }
  if (file.existsSync()) {
    final age = DateTime.now().difference(file.lastModifiedSync()).inSeconds;
    if (ttl == 0 || age < ttl) return file.readAsStringSync();
  }
  final html = await _direct(pageOrShim, req);
  file.writeAsStringSync(html);
  return html;
}

Future<String> _direct(dynamic pageOrShim, Request req) async {
  if (pageOrShim is _JasprShim) return await pageOrShim.call(req);
  throw UnimplementedError('Only jaspr pages are supported in this starter.');
}

// Internal shim used by jaspr adapter
class _JasprShim<T> {
  _JasprShim(this.getProps, this.build);
  final Future<T> Function(Request) getProps;
  final Function build;
  Future<String> call(Request req) async {
    final props = await getProps(req);
    return await (build as Future<String> Function(dynamic))(props);
  }
}
""")

write(os.path.join(dartvel_root, "packages/dartvel_core/lib/src/middleware.dart"), """class Next { const Next(); }
class Rewrite { const Rewrite(this.to); final String to; }
class Redirect { const Redirect(this.to, {this.permanent=false}); final String to; final bool permanent; }
typedef Middleware = Future<Object> Function(dynamic req);
""")

write(os.path.join(dartvel_root, "packages/dartvel_core/lib/src/image_handler.dart"), """import 'dart:io';
import 'http.dart';

Future<Response> imageHandler(Request req) async {
  final q = req.url.queryParameters;
  final url = q['url'];
  if (url == null) return Response(400, body: 'Missing url');
  final client = HttpClient();
  final resp = await (await client.getUrl(Uri.parse(url))).close();
  final bytes = await resp.fold<List<int>>([], (p, e) { p.addAll(e); return p; });
  return Response(200, headers: {
    'content-type': resp.headers.contentType?.mimeType ?? 'image/jpeg',
    'cache-control': 'public, max-age=86400'
  }, body: String.fromCharCodes(bytes));
}
""")

write(os.path.join(dartvel_root, "packages/dartvel_core/lib/src/jaspr_adapter.dart"), """import 'package:jaspr/jaspr.dart';
import 'http.dart';
import 'ssg.dart';

typedef JasprGetServerProps<T> = Future<T> Function(Request req);
typedef JasprBuild<T> = Component Function(T props);

class JasprPage<T> {
  const JasprPage({this.revalidateSeconds, required this.getProps, required this.build});
  final int? revalidateSeconds;
  final JasprGetServerProps<T> getProps;
  final JasprBuild<T> build;
}

Future<String> _renderComponentToString(Component c) async {
  final app = Document(child: c, doctype: true);
  return renderToString(app);
}

Future<String> renderJasprPage<T>(JasprPage<T> page, Request req) async {
  Future<String> render() async {
    final props = await page.getProps(req);
    final html = await _renderComponentToString(page.build(props));
    return html;
  }
  if (page.revalidateSeconds == null) {
    return render();
  }
  return renderWithISR(_JasprShim(page.getProps, (p) async => await _renderComponentToString(page.build(p))), req, ttl: page.revalidateSeconds!);
}

// local shim type (compatible with ssg.dart)
class _JasprShim<T> {
  _JasprShim(this.getProps, this.build);
  final Future<T> Function(Request) getProps;
  final Future<String> Function(T) build;
  Future<String> call(Request req) async => await build(await getProps(req));
}
""")

write(os.path.join(dartvel_root, "packages/dartvel_core/lib/src/router.dart"), """import 'package:shelf/shelf.dart' as shelf;
import 'http.dart';
import 'image_handler.dart';
import 'jaspr_adapter.dart';

typedef Handler = Future<Response> Function(Request req);

class RouteManifest {
  RouteManifest({required this.api, required this.pages});
  final Map<String, Handler> api;
  final Map<String, JasprPage<dynamic>> pages;
}

class DartvelApp {
  DartvelApp(this.manifest, {this.middleware});
  final RouteManifest manifest;
  final Future<Object> Function(Request req)? middleware;

  Future<shelf.Response> handle(shelf.Request r) async {
    final req = Request(r);

    // Middleware
    if (middleware != null) {
      final m = await middleware!(req);
      if (m is Rewrite) {
        final newUri = r.requestedUri.replace(path: m.to);
        final newReq = shelf.Request(r.method, newUri, headers: r.headers, body: await r.readAsString());
        return await handle(newReq);
      } else if (m is Redirect) {
        return shelf.Response(m.permanent ? 308 : 307, headers: {'location': m.to});
      }
    }

    // image
    if (req.url.path.startsWith('_dartvel/image')) {
      return (await imageHandler(req)).toShelf();
    }

    // API routes (exact path match)
    final apiHandler = manifest.api['/${req.url.path}'];
    if (apiHandler != null) {
      return (await apiHandler(req)).toShelf();
    }

    // Pages
    final page = manifest.pages['/${req.url.path}'] ?? manifest.pages['/'];
    if (page != null) {
      final html = await renderJasprPage(page, req);
      return Response(200, headers: {'content-type': 'text/html; charset=utf-8'}, body: html).toShelf();
    }

    return shelf.Response.notFound('Not Found');
  }
}
""")

write(os.path.join(dartvel_root, "packages/dartvel_cli/bin/dartvel.dart"), """import 'dart:io';
import 'package:args/args.dart';
import 'package:shelf/shelf.dart' as shelf;
import 'package:shelf/shelf_io.dart' as shelf_io;
import 'package:yaml/yaml.dart';
import 'package:path/path.dart' as p;
import 'package:dartvel_core/dartvel.dart';
import 'package:shelf_proxy/shelf_proxy.dart';

Future<void> main(List<String> args) async {
  final parser = ArgParser()
    ..addCommand('dev')
    ..addCommand('start')
    ..addCommand('generate');
  final res = parser.parse(args);
  switch (res.command?.name) {
    case 'dev':
      await _generate();
      await _start();
      break;
    case 'start':
      await _start();
      break;
    case 'generate':
      await _generate();
      break;
    default:
      print('Usage: dartvel <dev|start|generate>');
  }
}

Future<Map<String, dynamic>> _loadCfg() async {
  final cfgFile = File('dartvel.yaml');
  if (!cfgFile.existsSync()) {
    stderr.writeln('dartvel.yaml not found in current directory.');
    exit(2);
  }
  final cfg = loadYaml(await cfgFile.readAsString()) as YamlMap;
  return Map<String, dynamic>.from(cfg);
}

Future<void> _generate() async {
  final cfg = await _loadCfg();
  final pages = (cfg['routes']?['pages'] as Map?) ?? {};
  final api = (cfg['routes']?['api'] as Map?) ?? {};
  final isrDefault = cfg['isr']?['defaultSeconds'];
  final isrOverrides = (cfg['isr']?['overrides'] as Map?) ?? {};

  final buf = StringBuffer();
  buf.writeln("// GENERATED - do not edit");
  buf.writeln("import 'package:dartvel_core/dartvel.dart';");
  buf.writeln("import 'package:jaspr/jaspr.dart' show Component;");

  var i = 0;
  pages.forEach((route, file) {
    final alias = "p_${i++}";
    buf.writeln("import '${file}' as ${alias};");
  });

  var j = 0;
  api.forEach((route, file) {
    final alias = "a_${j++}";
    buf.writeln("import '${file}' as ${alias};");
  });

  buf.writeln("final pageRoutes = <String, JasprPage<dynamic>>{");
  i = 0;
  pages.forEach((route, file) {
    final alias = "p_${i++}";
    final override = isrOverrides[route] ?? isrDefault;
    if (override == null) {
      buf.writeln("  '${route}': JasprPage(getProps: ${alias}.getProps, build: ${alias}.build),");
    } else {
      buf.writeln("  '${route}': JasprPage(revalidateSeconds: ${override}, getProps: ${alias}.getProps, build: ${alias}.build),");
    }
  });
  buf.writeln("};");

  buf.writeln("typedef Handler = Future<Response> Function(Request req);");
  buf.writeln("final apiRoutes = <String, Handler>{");
  j = 0;
  api.forEach((route, file) {
    final alias = "a_${j++}";
    buf.writeln("  '${route}': ${alias}.handler,");
  });
  buf.writeln("};");

  final outDir = Directory('.dart_tool');
  outDir.createSync(recursive: true);
  final routesFile = File(p.join(outDir.path, 'dartvel_routes.g.dart'));
  await routesFile.writeAsString(buf.toString());

  final server = """// GENERATED server entry
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:shelf/shelf.dart' as shelf;
import 'package:shelf/shelf_io.dart' as shelf_io;
import 'package:dartvel_core/dartvel.dart';
import 'dartvel_routes.g.dart' as routes;

Future<void> main() async {
  final app = DartvelApp(RouteManifest(api: routes.apiRoutes, pages: routes.pageRoutes));
  final handler = const shelf.Pipeline().addMiddleware(shelf.logRequests()).addHandler(app.handle);
  final port = int.tryParse(Platform.environment['PORT'] ?? '3000') ?? 3000;
  final server = await shelf_io.serve(handler, '0.0.0.0', port);
  print('dartvel dev server on http://localhost:${server.port}');
}
""";
  final serverFile = File(p.join(outDir.path, 'dartvel_server.dart'));
  await serverFile.writeAsString(server);

  print('Generated .dart_tool/dartvel_routes.g.dart and .dart_tool/dartvel_server.dart');
}

Future<void> _start() async {
  final proc = await Process.start('dart', ['run', '.dart_tool/dartvel_server.dart']);
  stdout.addStream(proc.stdout);
  stderr.addStream(proc.stderr);
  final code = await proc.exitCode;
  exit(code);
}
""")

version: 0.0.2

write(os.path.join(creatorx_root, "apps/creatorx_studio/lib/models.dart"), """import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

enum NodeType { container, text }

class Node {
  Node({
    required this.id,
    required this.type,
    required this.x,
    required this.y,
    required this.w,
    required this.h,
    this.rotation = 0,
    this.props = const {},
  });
  final String id;
  final NodeType type;
  double x, y, w, h;
  double rotation;
  Map<String, dynamic> props;
}

Widget renderNode(Node n) {
  switch (n.type) {
    case NodeType.container:
      final fill = _toColor(n.props['fill']) ?? const Color(0xFF222222);
      final radius = (n.props['borderRadius'] ?? 8).toDouble();
      return ClipRRect(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(radius),
        child: Container(color: fill),
      );
    case NodeType.text:
      return Center(
        child: Text(
          n.props['text'] ?? 'Text',
          textAlign: TextAlign.center,
          style: TextStyle(
            fontSize: (n.props['fontSize'] ?? 16).toDouble(),
            color: _toColor(n.props['textColor']) ?? Colors.white,
          ),
        ),
      );
  }
}

Color? _toColor(dynamic v) {
  if (v is Color) return v;
  if (v is String && v.startsWith('#') && (v.length == 9 or v.length == 7)):
    pass
  return null;
}
""".replace(" or ", " or "))  # ensure Python writes correctly; we fix below by rewriting color function

# Fix color function properly
with open(os.path.join(creatorx_root, "apps/creatorx_studio/lib/models.dart"), "r+", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    txt = f.read()
    txt = txt.replace(
        "if (v is String && v.startsWith('#') && (v.length == 9 or v.length == 7)):\n    pass",
        "if (v is String && v.startsWith('#') && (v.length == 9 || v.length == 7)) {\n    final hex = v.length == 7 ? 'FF${v.substring(1)}' : v.substring(1);\n    return Color(int.parse(hex, radix: 16));\n  }"
    )
    f.seek(0); f.write(txt); f.truncate()

write(os.path.join(creatorx_root, "apps/creatorx_studio/lib/state.dart"), """import 'package:hooks_riverpod/hooks_riverpod.dart';
import 'models.dart';
import 'package:uuid/uuid.dart';

final nodesProvider = StateNotifierProvider<NodesNotifier, List<Node>>((ref) => NodesNotifier());
final selectionProvider = StateProvider<String?>((_) => null);

class NodesNotifier extends StateNotifier<List<Node>> {
  NodesNotifier(): super([]);
  final _uuid = const Uuid();

  void add(NodeType type) {
    state = [
      ...state,
      Node(
        id: _uuid.v4(),
        type: type,
        x: 80, y: 80, w: type == NodeType.text ? 220 : 200, h: type == NodeType.text ? 60 : 120,
        props: type == NodeType.text ? {'text':'Text','fontSize':18,'textColor':'#FFFFFFFF'} : {'fill':'#FF4F46E5','borderRadius':12},
      )
    ];
  }

  void move(String id, double dx, double dy) {
    state = [
      for (final n in state)
        if (n.id == id) Node(id: n.id, type: n.type, x: n.x+dx, y: n.y+dy, w: n.w, h: n.h, rotation: n.rotation, props: n.props)
        else n
    ];
  }

  void resize(String id, {double? w, double? h}) {
    state = [
      for (final n in state)
        if (n.id == id) Node(id: n.id, type: n.type, x: n.x, y: n.y, w: w ?? n.w, h: h ?? n.h, rotation: n.rotation, props: n.props)
        else n
    ];
  }

  void setProp(String id, String key, dynamic value) {
    state = [
      for (final n in state)
        if (n.id == id) Node(id: n.id, type: n.type, x: n.x, y: n.y, w: n.w, h: n.h, rotation: n.rotation, props: {...n.props, key: value})
        else n
    ];
  }
}
""")

write(os.path.join(creatorx_root, "apps/creatorx_studio/lib/main.dart"), """import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:hooks_riverpod/hooks_riverpod.dart';
import 'models.dart';
import 'state.dart';

void main() => runApp(const ProviderScope(child: StudioApp()));

class StudioApp extends StatelessWidget {
  const StudioApp({super.key});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return MaterialApp(
      title: 'CreatorX Studio',
      theme: ThemeData.dark(useMaterial3: true),
      home: const EditorScreen(),
      debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false,
    );
  }
}

class EditorScreen extends ConsumerWidget {
  const EditorScreen({super.key});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('CreatorX Studio')),
      body: Row(
        children: const [
          SizedBox(width: 220, child: Palette()),
          Expanded(child: CanvasView()),
          SizedBox(width: 280, child: InspectorPanel()),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class Palette extends ConsumerWidget {
  const Palette({super.key});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final nodes = ref.read(nodesProvider.notifier);
    return Container(
      color: const Color(0xFF111111),
      child: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
        children: [
          ListTile(
            title: const Text('Add Container', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white)),
            onTap: () => nodes.add(NodeType.container),
          ),
          ListTile(
            title: const Text('Add Text', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white)),
            onTap: () => nodes.add(NodeType.text),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class CanvasView extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const CanvasView({super.key});
  @override
  ConsumerState<CanvasView> createState() => _CanvasViewState();
}

class _CanvasViewState extends ConsumerState<CanvasView> {
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final nodes = ref.watch(nodesProvider);
    final selected = ref.watch(selectionProvider);
    return Container(
      color: const Color(0xFF1F1F1F),
      child: Stack(
        children: [
          for (final n in nodes)
            Positioned(
              left: n.x, top: n.y, width: n.w, height: n.h,
              child: GestureDetector(
                onTap: () => ref.read(selectionProvider.notifier).state = n.id,
                onPanUpdate: (d) => ref.read(nodesProvider.notifier).move(n.id, d.delta.dx, d.delta.dy),
                child: Stack(
                  clipBehavior: Clip.none,
                  children: [
                    DecoratedBox(
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        boxShadow: selected == n.id ? [BoxShadow(color: Colors.blue.withOpacity(.25), blurRadius: 16)] : null,
                        border: selected == n.id ? Border.all(color: Colors.blueAccent, width: 1.5) : null,
                      ),
                      child: renderNode(n),
                    ),
                    if (selected == n.id)
                      Positioned(
                        right: -10, bottom: -10,
                        child: GestureDetector(
                          onPanUpdate: (d) => ref.read(nodesProvider.notifier).resize(n.id, w: n.w + d.delta.dx, h: n.h + d.delta.dy),
                          child: const _Handle(),
                        ),
                      ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _Handle extends StatelessWidget {
  const _Handle();
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Container(width: 16, height: 16, decoration: BoxDecoration(color: Colors.white, border: Border.all(color: Colors.blue, width: 2)));
  }
}

class InspectorPanel extends ConsumerWidget {
  const InspectorPanel({super.key});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final selectedId = ref.watch(selectionProvider);
    final nodes = ref.watch(nodesProvider);
    final node = nodes.where((n) => n.id == selectedId).cast<Node?>().firstOrNull;
    if (node == null) {
      return Container(color: const Color(0xFF111111), child: const Center(child: Text('Select a node', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white54))));
    }
    return Container(
      color: const Color(0xFF111111),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
      child: ListView(
        children: [
          Text('Node ${node.id.substring(0,6)}', style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white70)),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          if (node.type == NodeType.text) TextField(
            style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white),
            decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Text', labelStyle: TextStyle(color: Colors.white70)),
            controller: TextEditingController(text: node.props['text'] ?? '')..selection = TextSelection.collapsed(offset: (node.props['text'] ?? '').toString().length),
            onSubmitted: (v) => ref.read(nodesProvider.notifier).setProp(node.id, 'text', v),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

extension FirstOrNull<E> on Iterable<E> {
  E? get firstOrNull => isEmpty ? null : first;
}

import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;

void main() => runApp(const ViewerApp());

class ViewerApp extends StatelessWidget {
  const ViewerApp({super.key});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return MaterialApp(
      title: 'CreatorX Viewer',
      theme: ThemeData.dark(useMaterial3: true),
      home: const ViewerScreen(),
      debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false,
    );
  }
}

class ViewerScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const ViewerScreen({super.key});
  @override
  State<ViewerScreen> createState() => _ViewerScreenState();
}

class _ViewerScreenState extends State<ViewerScreen> {
  Map<String, dynamic>? snapshot;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    final uri = Uri.parse('/api/projects/snapshot');
    try {
      final res = await http.get(uri);
      if (res.statusCode == 200) {
        setState(() => snapshot = jsonDecode(res.body) as Map<String, dynamic>);
      } else {
        setState(() => snapshot = {"nodes": []});
      }
    } catch (_) {
      setState(() => snapshot = {"nodes": []});
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final s = snapshot;
    if (s == null) return const Scaffold(body: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()));
    final nodes = (s['nodes'] as List).cast<Map<String, dynamic>>();
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('CreatorX Viewer')),
      body: Container(
        color: const Color(0xFF101010),
        child: Stack(children: nodes.map(_buildNode).toList()),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildNode(Map<String,dynamic> n) {
    final x = (n['x'] as num).toDouble();
    final y = (n['y'] as num).toDouble();
    final w = (n['w'] as num).toDouble();
    final h = (n['h'] as num).toDouble();
    final type = n['type'] as String;
    final props = (n['props'] as Map).cast<String, dynamic>();

    Widget child;
    if (type == 'Container') {
      final color = _parseColor(props['fill']) ?? const Color(0xFF222222);
      final radius = (props['borderRadius'] ?? 8).toDouble();
      child = ClipRRect(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(radius), child: Container(color: color));
    } else if (type == 'Text') {
      child = Center(
        child: Text(props['text'] ?? '',
          style: TextStyle(fontSize: (props['fontSize'] ?? 16).toDouble(), color: _parseColor(props['textColor']) ?? Colors.white),
          textAlign: TextAlign.center,
        ),
      );
    } else {
      child = const SizedBox.shrink();
    }

    return Positioned(left: x, top: y, width: w, height: h, child: child);
  }

  Color? _parseColor(dynamic v) {
    if (v is String && v.startsWith('#')) {
      final hex = v.length == 7 ? 'FF${v.substring(1)}' : v.substring(1);
      return Color(int.parse(hex, radix: 16));
    }
    return null;
  }
}
""")

write(os.path.join(creatorx_root, "apps/creatorx_site/api/cms/_store.dart"), """
import 'dart:collection';
import 'dart:math';

class _Id {
  static final _r = Random();
  static String v4() => List.generate(16, (_) => _r.nextInt(16).toRadixString(16)).join();
}

class CmsCollection {
  CmsCollection({required this.id, required this.name, required this.schema});
  final String id;
  String name;
  Map<String, dynamic> schema;
}

class CmsEntry {
  CmsEntry({required this.id, required this.collectionId, required this.data});
  final String id;
  final String collectionId;
  Map<String, dynamic> data;
}

class CmsStore {
  final collections = HashMap<String, CmsCollection>();
  final entries = HashMap<String, CmsEntry>();

  CmsCollection createCollection(String name, Map<String, dynamic> schema) {
    final c = CmsCollection(id: _Id.v4(), name: name, schema: schema);
    collections[c.id] = c;
    return c;
  }

  List<CmsCollection> listCollections() => collections.values.toList();

  CmsCollection? getCollection(String id) => collections[id];

  bool deleteCollection(String id) {
    final ok = collections.remove(id) != null;
    // cascade delete entries
    entries.removeWhere((_, e) => e.collectionId == id);
    return ok;
  }

  CmsEntry createEntry(String collectionId, Map<String, dynamic> data) {
    final e = CmsEntry(id: _Id.v4(), collectionId: collectionId, data: data);
    entries[e.id] = e;
    return e;
  }

  List<CmsEntry> listEntries(String collectionId) => entries.values.where((e) => e.collectionId == collectionId).toList();

  CmsEntry? getEntry(String id) => entries[id];

  CmsEntry? updateEntry(String id, Map<String, dynamic> patch) {
    final e = entries[id];
    if (e == null) return null;
    e.data = {...e.data, ...patch};
    return e;
  }

  bool deleteEntry(String id) => entries.remove(id) != null;
}

final cmsStore = CmsStore();
""")

write(os.path.join(creatorx_root, "apps/creatorx_site/api/cms/_store.dart"), """
import 'dart:collection';
import 'dart:math';

class _Id {
  static final _r = Random();
  static String v4() => List.generate(16, (_) => _r.nextInt(16).toRadixString(16)).join();
}

class CmsCollection {
  CmsCollection({required this.id, required this.name, required this.schema});
  final String id;
  String name;
  Map<String, dynamic> schema;
}

class CmsEntry {
  CmsEntry({required this.id, required this.collectionId, required this.data});
  final String id;
  final String collectionId;
  Map<String, dynamic> data;
}

class CmsStore {
  final collections = HashMap<String, CmsCollection>();
  final entries = HashMap<String, CmsEntry>();

  CmsCollection createCollection(String name, Map<String, dynamic> schema) {
    final c = CmsCollection(id: _Id.v4(), name: name, schema: schema);
    collections[c.id] = c;
    return c;
  }

  List<CmsCollection> listCollections() => collections.values.toList();
  CmsCollection? getCollection(String id) => collections[id];
  bool deleteCollection(String id) {
    final ok = collections.remove(id) != null;
    entries.removeWhere((key, e) => e.collectionId == id);
    return ok;
  }

  CmsEntry createEntry(String collectionId, Map<String, dynamic> data) {
    final e = CmsEntry(id: _Id.v4(), collectionId: collectionId, data: data);
    entries[e.id] = e;
    return e;
  }

  List<CmsEntry> listEntries(String collectionId) =>
      entries.values.where((e) => e.collectionId == collectionId).toList();
  CmsEntry? getEntry(String id) => entries[id];
  CmsEntry? updateEntry(String id, Map<String, dynamic> patch) {
    final e = entries[id];
    if (e == null) return null;
    e.data = {...e.data, ...patch};
    return e;
  }
  bool deleteEntry(String id) => entries.remove(id) != null;
}

final cmsStore = CmsStore();
""")

write(os.path.join(creatorx_root, "apps/creatorx_studio/lib/models.dart"), """
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

enum NodeType { container, text, autoLayout }

class Node {
  Node({
    required this.id,
    required this.type,
    required this.x,
    required this.y,
    required this.w,
    required this.h,
    this.rotation = 0,
    this.props = const {},
    this.parentId,
  });
  final String id;
  final NodeType type;
  double x, y, w, h;
  double rotation;
  Map<String, dynamic> props;
  String? parentId;
}

Widget renderNode(Node n, List<Node> all) {
  switch (n.type) {
    case NodeType.container:
      final fill = _toColor(n.props['fill']) ?? const Color(0xFF222222);
      final radius = (n.props['borderRadius'] ?? 8).toDouble();
      return ClipRRect(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(radius),
        child: Container(color: fill),
      );
    case NodeType.text:
      return Center(
        child: Text(
          n.props['text'] ?? 'Text',
          textAlign: TextAlign.center,
          style: TextStyle(
            fontSize: (n.props['fontSize'] ?? 16).toDouble(),
            color: _toColor(n.props['textColor']) ?? Colors.white,
          ),
        ),
      );
    case NodeType.autoLayout:
      final dir = (n.props['direction'] ?? 'row') == 'row' ? Axis.horizontal : Axis.vertical;
      final spacing = (n.props['spacing'] ?? 8).toDouble();
      final pad = (n.props['padding'] ?? 0).toDouble();
      final children = all.where((m) => m.parentId == n.id).toList();
      return Padding(
        padding: EdgeInsets.all(pad),
        child: Flex(
          direction: dir,
          children: [
            for (int i = 0; i < children.length; i++) ...[
              Expanded(child: renderNode(children[i], all)),
              if (i < children.length - 1)
                SizedBox(width: dir == Axis.horizontal ? spacing : 0, height: dir == Axis.vertical ? spacing : 0),
            ]
          ],
        ),
      );
  }
}

Color? _toColor(dynamic v) {
  if (v is Color) return v;
  if (v is String && v.startsWith('#') && (v.length == 9 || v.length == 7)) {
    final hex = v.length == 7 ? 'FF${v.substring(1)}' : v.substring(1);
    return Color(int.parse(hex, radix: 16));
  }
  return null;
}
""")

write(os.path.join(creatorx_root, "apps/creatorx_studio/lib/state.dart"), """
import 'package:hooks_riverpod/hooks_riverpod.dart';
import 'models.dart';
import 'package:uuid/uuid.dart';

final nodesProvider = StateNotifierProvider<NodesNotifier, List<Node>>((ref) => NodesNotifier());
final selectionProvider = StateProvider<String?>((_) => null);

class NodesNotifier extends StateNotifier<List<Node>> {
  NodesNotifier(): super([]);
  final _uuid = const Uuid();

  void add(NodeType type) {
    if (type == NodeType.autoLayout) { addAutoLayout(); return; }
    state = [
      ...state,
      Node(
        id: _uuid.v4(),
        type: type,
        x: 80, y: 80, w: type == NodeType.text ? 220 : 200, h: type == NodeType.text ? 60 : 120,
        props: type == NodeType.text ? {'text':'Text','fontSize':18,'textColor':'#FFFFFFFF'} : {'fill':'#FF4F46E5','borderRadius':12},
      )
    ];
  }

  void addAutoLayout() {
    final parentId = _uuid.v4();
    final parent = Node(
      id: parentId,
      type: NodeType.autoLayout,
      x: 60, y: 60, w: 360, h: 140,
      props: {'direction':'row','spacing':12,'padding':12},
    );
    final c1 = Node(id: _uuid.v4(), type: NodeType.text, x:0, y:0, w:160, h:60, props: {'text':'AutoLayout →','fontSize':18,'textColor':'#FFFFFFFF'}, parentId: parentId);
    final c2 = Node(id: _uuid.v4(), type: NodeType.text, x:0, y:0, w:160, h:60, props: {'text':'Children spaced','fontSize':18,'textColor':'#FFB3E5FC'}, parentId: parentId);
    state = [...state, parent, c1, c2];
  }

  void move(String id, double dx, double dy) {
    state = [
      for (final n in state)
        if (n.id == id) Node(id: n.id, type: n.type, x: n.x+dx, y: n.y+dy, w: n.w, h: n.h, rotation: n.rotation, props: n.props, parentId: n.parentId)
        else n
    ];
  }

  void resize(String id, {double? w, double? h}) {
    state = [
      for (final n in state)
        if (n.id == id) Node(id: n.id, type: n.type, x: n.x, y: n.y, w: w ?? n.w, h: h ?? n.h, rotation: n.rotation, props: n.props, parentId: n.parentId)
        else n
    ];
  }

  void setProp(String id, String key, dynamic value) {
    state = [
      for (final n in state)
        if (n.id == id) Node(id: n.id, type: n.type, x: n.x, y: n.y, w: n.w, h: n.h, rotation: n.rotation, props: {...n.props, key: value}, parentId: n.parentId)
        else n
    ];
  }
}
""")

write(os.path.join(creatorx_root, "apps/creatorx_studio/lib/main.dart"), """
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:hooks_riverpod/hooks_riverpod.dart';
import 'models.dart';
import 'state.dart';

void main() => runApp(const ProviderScope(child: StudioApp()));

class StudioApp extends StatelessWidget {
  const StudioApp({super.key});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return MaterialApp(
      title: 'CreatorX Studio',
      theme: ThemeData.dark(useMaterial3: true),
      home: const EditorScreen(),
      debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false,
    );
  }
}

class EditorScreen extends ConsumerWidget {
  const EditorScreen({super.key});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('CreatorX Studio')),
      body: Row(
        children: const [
          SizedBox(width: 220, child: Palette()),
          Expanded(child: CanvasView()),
          SizedBox(width: 280, child: InspectorPanel()),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class Palette extends ConsumerWidget {
  const Palette({super.key});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final nodes = ref.read(nodesProvider.notifier);
    return Container(
      color: const Color(0xFF111111),
      child: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
        children: [
          ListTile(
            title: const Text('Add AutoLayout', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white)),
            onTap: () => nodes.add(NodeType.autoLayout),
          ),
          ListTile(
            title: const Text('Add Container', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white)),
            onTap: () => nodes.add(NodeType.container),
          ),
          ListTile(
            title: const Text('Add Text', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white)),
            onTap: () => nodes.add(NodeType.text),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class CanvasView extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const CanvasView({super.key});
  @override
  ConsumerState<CanvasView> createState() => _CanvasViewState();
}

class _CanvasViewState extends ConsumerState<CanvasView> {
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final nodes = ref.watch(nodesProvider);
    final selected = ref.watch(selectionProvider);
    return Container(
      color: const Color(0xFF1F1F1F),
      child: Stack(
        children: [
          for (final n in nodes.where((n) => n.parentId == null))
            Positioned(
              left: n.x, top: n.y, width: n.w, height: n.h,
              child: GestureDetector(
                onTap: () => ref.read(selectionProvider.notifier).state = n.id,
                onPanUpdate: (d) { if (n.parentId == null) ref.read(nodesProvider.notifier).move(n.id, d.delta.dx, d.delta.dy); },
                child: Stack(
                  clipBehavior: Clip.none,
                  children: [
                    DecoratedBox(
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        boxShadow: selected == n.id ? [BoxShadow(color: Colors.blue.withOpacity(.25), blurRadius: 16)] : null,
                        border: selected == n.id ? Border.all(color: Colors.blueAccent, width: 1.5) : null,
                      ),
                      child: renderNode(n, nodes),
                    ),
                    if (selected == n.id && n.parentId == null)
                      Positioned(
                        right: -10, bottom: -10,
                        child: GestureDetector(
                          onPanUpdate: (d) => ref.read(nodesProvider.notifier).resize(n.id, w: n.w + d.delta.dx, h: n.h + d.delta.dy),
                          child: const _Handle(),
                        ),
                      ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _Handle extends StatelessWidget {
  const _Handle();
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Container(width: 16, height: 16, decoration: BoxDecoration(color: Colors.white, border: Border.all(color: Colors.blue, width: 2)));
  }
}

class InspectorPanel extends ConsumerWidget {
  const InspectorPanel({super.key});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final selectedId = ref.watch(selectionProvider);
    final nodes = ref.watch(nodesProvider);
    final node = nodes.where((n) => n.id == selectedId).cast<Node?>().firstOrNull;
    if (node == null) {
      return Container(color: const Color(0xFF111111), child: const Center(child: Text('Select a node', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white54))));
    }
    return Container(
      color: const Color(0xFF111111),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
      child: ListView(
        children: [
          Text('Node ${node.id.substring(0,6)}', style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white70)),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          if (node.type == NodeType.text) TextField(
            style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white),
            decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Text', labelStyle: TextStyle(color: Colors.white70)),
            controller: TextEditingController(text: node.props['text'] ?? '')..selection = TextSelection.collapsed(offset: (node.props['text'] ?? '').toString().length),
            onSubmitted: (v) => ref.read(nodesProvider.notifier).setProp(node.id, 'text', v),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

extension FirstOrNull<E> on Iterable<E> {
  E? get firstOrNull => isEmpty ? null : first;
}
""")

write(os.path.join(creatorx_root, "apps/creatorx_viewer/lib/main.dart"), """
import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;

void main() => runApp(const ViewerApp());

class ViewerApp extends StatelessWidget {
  const ViewerApp({super.key});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return MaterialApp(
      title: 'CreatorX Viewer',
      theme: ThemeData.dark(useMaterial3: true),
      home: const ViewerScreen(),
      debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false,
    );
  }
}

class ViewerScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const ViewerScreen({super.key});
  @override
  State<ViewerScreen> createState() => _ViewerScreenState();
}

class _ViewerScreenState extends State<ViewerScreen> {
  Map<String, dynamic>? snapshot;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    final uri = Uri.parse('/api/projects/snapshot');
    try {
      final res = await http.get(uri);
      if (res.statusCode == 200) {
        setState(() => snapshot = jsonDecode(res.body) as Map<String, dynamic>);
      } else {
        setState(() => snapshot = {"nodes": []});
      }
    } catch (_) {
      setState(() => snapshot = {"nodes": []});
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final s = snapshot;
    if (s == null) return const Scaffold(body: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()));
    final nodes = (s['nodes'] as List).cast<Map<String, dynamic>>();
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('CreatorX Viewer')),
      body: Container(
        color: const Color(0xFF101010),
        child: Stack(children: nodes.where((n)=>n['parentId']==null).map((n)=>_buildNode(n, nodes)).toList()),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildNode(Map<String,dynamic> n, List<Map<String,dynamic>> all) {
    final x = (n['x'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0;
    final y = (n['y'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0;
    final w = (n['w'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 100;
    final h = (n['h'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 60;
    final type = n['type'] as String? ?? '';
    final props = (n['props'] as Map?)?.cast<String, dynamic>() ?? {};

    Widget child;
    if (type == 'Container') {
      final color = _parseColor(props['fill']) ?? const Color(0xFF222222);
      final radius = (props['borderRadius'] ?? 8).toDouble();
      child = ClipRRect(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(radius), child: Container(color: color));
    } else if (type == 'Text') {
      child = Center(
        child: Text(props['text'] ?? '',
          style: TextStyle(fontSize: (props['fontSize'] ?? 16).toDouble(), color: _parseColor(props['textColor']) ?? Colors.white),
          textAlign: TextAlign.center,
        ),
      );
    } else if (type == 'AutoLayout') {
      final dir = (props['direction'] ?? 'row') == 'row' ? Axis.horizontal : Axis.vertical;
      final spacing = (props['spacing'] ?? 8).toDouble();
      final pad = (props['padding'] ?? 0).toDouble();
      final children = all.where((m) => m['parentId'] == n['id']).toList();
      child = Padding(
        padding: EdgeInsets.all(pad),
        child: Flex(direction: dir, children: [
          for (int i=0;i<children.length;i++) ...[
            Expanded(child: _buildNode(children[i], all)),
            if (i < children.length-1) SizedBox(width: dir==Axis.horizontal?spacing:0, height: dir==Axis.vertical?spacing:0),
          ]
        ]),
      );
    } else {
      child = const SizedBox.shrink();
    }

    return Positioned(left: x, top: y, width: w, height: h, child: child);
  }

  Color? _parseColor(dynamic v) {
    if (v is String && v.startsWith('#')) {
      final hex = v.length == 7 ? 'FF${v.substring(1)}' : v.substring(1);
      return Color(int.parse(hex, radix: 16));
    }
    return null;
  }
}
""")

Collections

Entries

Patch: PATCH /api/cms/entries/{id} → (uses /api/cms/entries/*:patch)

Delete: DELETE /api/cms/entries/{id} → (uses /api/cms/entries/*:delete)

Note: the router matches exact paths, so :list, *, *:delete, etc. are mapped as separate endpoints.

props.padding (number)

children are any nodes with parentId: <groupId>

library ctrx_format;

import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:typed_data';
import 'package:archive/archive.dart';
import 'package:crypto/crypto.dart';
import 'package:uuid/uuid.dart';

class CtrX {
  static const String mime = 'application/creator_X_project';
  static const String altMime = 'application/vnd.creatorx.project+zip';
  static const String ext = '.ctrx';
  static const String version = '1.0';

  /// Encode a snapshot/project into a .ctrx (zip-based) container.
  static Uint8List encode(Map<String, dynamic> snapshot, {Map<String, Uint8List>? assets, Map<String, dynamic>? meta}) {
    final archive = Archive();

    // 1) 'mimetype' first, STORED (no compression) so sniffers can detect quickly.
    final mimetype = mime;
    final mimeFile = ArchiveFile('mimetype', mimetype.length, Uint8List.fromList(utf8.encode(mimetype)));
    mimeFile.compress = false;
    archive.addFile(mimeFile);

    // 2) snapshot.json
    final snapshotJson = jsonEncode(snapshot);
    final snapBytes = Uint8List.fromList(utf8.encode(snapshotJson));
    archive.addFile(ArchiveFile('snapshot.json', snapBytes.length, snapBytes));

    // 3) manifest.json
    final id = const Uuid().v4();
    final nowIso = DateTime.now().toUtc().toIso8601String();
    final assetsList = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    assets?.forEach((path, bytes) {
      assetsList.add({
        'path': path,
        'size': bytes.length,
        'sha256': sha256.convert(bytes).toString(),
      });
    });

    final manifest = <String, dynamic>{
      'format': 'ctrx',
      'version': version,
      'id': id,
      'createdAt': nowIso,
      'tool': meta ?? {'name': 'CreatorX', 'version': '0.1.0'},
      'snapshot': {
        'sha256': sha256.convert(snapBytes).toString(),
        'bytes': snapBytes.length,
      },
      'assets': assetsList,
    };
    final manifestBytes = Uint8List.fromList(utf8.encode(jsonEncode(manifest)));
    archive.addFile(ArchiveFile('manifest.json', manifestBytes.length, manifestBytes));

    // 4) assets/*
    if (assets != null) {
      assets.forEach((path, bytes) {
        final p = path.startsWith('assets/') ? path : 'assets/$path';
        archive.addFile(ArchiveFile(p, bytes.length, bytes));
      });
    }

    // 5) integrity
    final integrity = 'snapshot.json  ' + sha256.convert(snapBytes).toString() + '\\n' + assetsList.map((a) => a['path'] + '  ' + a['sha256']).join('\\n');
    final integBytes = Uint8List.fromList(utf8.encode(integrity));
    archive.addFile(ArchiveFile('integrity.sha256', integBytes.length, integBytes));

    final bytes = ZipEncoder().encode(archive)!;
    return Uint8List.fromList(bytes);
  }

  /// Decode a .ctrx Uint8List back to a snapshot (and minimal manifest).
  static ({Map<String, dynamic> snapshot, Map<String, dynamic> manifest}) decode(Uint8List bytes) {
    final arc = ZipDecoder().decodeBytes(bytes);
    ArchiveFile? snapFile;
    ArchiveFile? manifestFile;
    for (final f in arc) {
      if (f.name == 'snapshot.json') snapFile = f;
      if (f.name == 'manifest.json') manifestFile = f;
    }
    if (snapFile == null || manifestFile == null) {
      throw StateError('Invalid CTRX: missing required files.');
    }
    final snapshot = jsonDecode(utf8.decode(snapFile.content as List<int>)) as Map<String, dynamic>;
    final manifest = jsonDecode(utf8.decode(manifestFile.content as List<int>)) as Map<String, dynamic>;
    return (snapshot: snapshot, manifest: manifest);
  }
}
""")

write(os.path.join(creatorx_root, "FORMAT_SPEC.md"), """
# CreatorX Project Format (.ctrx)

**Media type:** `application/creator_X_project`  
**Alternative (vendor tree):** `application/vnd.creatorx.project+zip`  
**Extension:** `.ctrx`  
**Magic (by container):** `PK\\x03\\x04` (ZIP local file header) with first entry `mimetype` containing `application/creator_X_project` (stored, uncompressed).

## Goals
- Portable container for CreatorX projects/snapshots and assets
- Stream-friendly, seekable, inspectable with standard ZIP tooling
- Deterministic integrity via `integrity.sha256`
- Backward-compatible versioning via `manifest.json`

## Layout (v1.0)
/mimetype # text, uncompressed: application/creator_X_project
/manifest.json # format, version, id, createdAt, tool, snapshot hash, asset table
/snapshot.json # canonical snapshot (UTF-8, normalized)
/assets/* # optional binary assets
/integrity.sha256 # SHA-256 lines: "<path> <sha256>"

Always show details


### `manifest.json`
```jsonc
{
  "format": "ctrx",
  "version": "1.0",
  "id": "<uuid-v4>",
  "createdAt": "2025-08-19T00:00:00Z",
  "tool": { "name": "CreatorX", "version": "0.1.0" },
  "snapshot": { "sha256": "<hash>", "bytes": 12345 },
  "assets": [
    {"path":"assets/foo.png","size":123,"sha256":"..."}
  ]
}
Polyglot rationale
Primary container is ZIP (widely supported). The mimetype first entry enables magic-less sniffing (like ODF).

A future CBOR-first variant can be added by placing /snapshot.cbor and updating manifest.json while retaining /snapshot.json for compatibility.

Signing & encryption (future)
Add /signature.sig (COSE/PKCS7) and /recipients.json for E2E optional encryption.

Versioning
Increment minor for backward-compatible additions; major for breaking changes.

Readers must ignore unknown files and manifest fields.
""")

Format overview (CTRX v1.0)
Files inside the ZIP

/mimetype                # literal text: application/creator_X_project  (stored, not compressed)
/manifest.json           # id, version, createdAt, tool meta, snapshot hash, asset table
/snapshot.json           # canonical JSON of your project/snapshot
/assets/*                # optional binary assets
/integrity.sha256        # line-based SHA-256 list for snapshot & assets
Polyglot rationale

Works anywhere ZIP works; first entry mimetype mirrors ODF so file detection is trivial.

JSON-first for readability; future versions can add /snapshot.cbor without breaking v1 readers.

library ctrx_format;

import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:typed_data';
import 'package:archive/archive.dart';
import 'package:crypto/crypto.dart';
import 'package:cryptography/cryptography.dart' as cg;
import 'package:cbor/cbor.dart' as cbor;
import 'package:uuid/uuid.dart';

class CtrX {
  static const String mime = 'application/creator_X_project';
  static const String altMime = 'application/vnd.creatorx.project+zip';
  static const String ext = '.ctrx';
  static const String version = '1.1'; // added cbor + signature

  /// Encode a snapshot/project into a .ctrx (zip-based) container.
  /// If [ed25519PrivateKey] is provided (32-byte seed), a COSE_Sign1 detached signature
  /// is added as /signature.sig and public key as /signature.pubkey.
  static Uint8List encode(
    Map<String, dynamic> snapshot, {
    Map<String, Uint8List>? assets,
    Map<String, dynamic>? meta,
    Uint8List? ed25519PrivateKey,
  }) {
    final archive = Archive();

    // ----- 1) mimetype (uncompressed) for quick sniffing
    final mimetype = mime;
    final mimeFile = ArchiveFile('mimetype', mimetype.length, Uint8List.fromList(utf8.encode(mimetype)));
    mimeFile.compress = false;
    archive.addFile(mimeFile);

    // ----- 2) snapshot.json (canonical json)
    final snapshotJson = jsonEncode(snapshot);
    final snapBytes = Uint8List.fromList(utf8.encode(snapshotJson));
    archive.addFile(ArchiveFile('snapshot.json', snapBytes.length, snapBytes));

    // ----- 3) snapshot.cbor (binary, smaller/faster)
    final enc = cbor.CborEncoder();
    enc.encode(snapshot);
    final cborBytes = Uint8List.fromList(enc.output.getData());
    archive.addFile(ArchiveFile('snapshot.cbor', cborBytes.length, cborBytes));

    // ----- 4) manifest.json
    final id = const Uuid().v4();
    final nowIso = DateTime.now().toUtc().toIso8601String();
    final assetsList = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    assets?.forEach((path, bytes) {
      assetsList.add({
        'path': path.startsWith('assets/') ? path : 'assets/$path',
        'size': bytes.length,
        'sha256': sha256.convert(bytes).toString(),
      });
    });

    final manifest = <String, dynamic>{
      'format': 'ctrx',
      'version': version,
      'id': id,
      'createdAt': nowIso,
      'tool': meta ?? {'name': 'CreatorX', 'version': '0.1.0'},
      'snapshot': {
        'sha256': sha256.convert(snapBytes).toString(),
        'bytes': snapBytes.length,
        'cborBytes': cborBytes.length,
      },
      'assets': assetsList,
      'signature': null,
    };

    // ----- 5) assets/*
    if (assets != null) {
      assets.forEach((path, bytes) {
        final p = path.startsWith('assets/') ? path : 'assets/$path';
        archive.addFile(ArchiveFile(p, bytes.length, bytes));
      });
    }

    // ----- 6) integrity file
    final lines = ['snapshot.json  ${sha256.convert(snapBytes)}'];
    for (final a in assetsList) {
      lines.add('${a['path']}  ${a['sha256']}');
    }
    final integBytes = Uint8List.fromList(utf8.encode(lines.join('\\n')));
    archive.addFile(ArchiveFile('integrity.sha256', integBytes.length, integBytes));

    // ----- 7) Optional COSE_Sign1 detached signature over snapshot.json
    if (ed25519PrivateKey != null) {
      final sig = _coseSign1Detached(snapshotPayload: snapBytes, contentType: mime, seed32: ed25519PrivateKey);
      archive.addFile(ArchiveFile('signature.sig', sig.bytes.length, sig.bytes));
      archive.addFile(ArchiveFile('signature.pubkey', sig.publicKey.length, sig.publicKey));
      manifest['signature'] = {
        'alg': 'EdDSA',
        'protected': {'alg': -8, 'content-type': mime},
        'detached': true,
        'file': 'signature.sig',
        'publicKeyB64': base64Encode(sig.publicKey),
      };
    }

    // Write manifest (now possibly including signature block)
    final manifestBytes = Uint8List.fromList(utf8.encode(jsonEncode(manifest)));
    archive.addFile(ArchiveFile('manifest.json', manifestBytes.length, manifestBytes));

    final bytes = ZipEncoder().encode(archive)!;
    return Uint8List.fromList(bytes);
  }

  /// Decode a .ctrx Uint8List back to a snapshot (preferring CBOR) and manifest.
  static ({Map<String, dynamic> snapshot, Map<String, dynamic> manifest}) decode(Uint8List bytes) {
    final arc = ZipDecoder().decodeBytes(bytes);
    ArchiveFile? snapJson;
    ArchiveFile? snapCbor;
    ArchiveFile? manifestFile;
    for (final f in arc) {
      if (f.name == 'snapshot.cbor') snapCbor = f;
      if (f.name == 'snapshot.json') snapJson = f;
      if (f.name == 'manifest.json') manifestFile = f;
    }
    if ((snapCbor == null && snapJson == null) || manifestFile == null) {
      throw StateError('Invalid CTRX: missing required files.');
    }
    Map<String, dynamic> snapshot;
    if (snapCbor != null) {
      final dec = cbor.CborDecoder(snapCbor.content as List<int>);
      final obj = dec.decode() as Map;
      snapshot = Map<String, dynamic>.from(obj);
    } else {
      snapshot = jsonDecode(utf8.decode(snapJson!.content as List<int>)) as Map<String, dynamic>;
    }
    final manifest = jsonDecode(utf8.decode(manifestFile.content as List<int>)) as Map<String, dynamic>;
    return (snapshot: snapshot, manifest: manifest);
  }

  /// Verify the detached COSE_Sign1 signature if present.
  /// Returns true if verified; false if signature or key missing; throws if parsing fails.
  static Future<bool> verifySignature({
    required Uint8List ctrxBytes,
    required Uint8List publicKey,
  }) async {
    final arc = ZipDecoder().decodeBytes(ctrxBytes);
    ArchiveFile? sigFile;
    ArchiveFile? snapFile;
    for (final f in arc) {
      if (f.name == 'signature.sig') sigFile = f;
      if (f.name == 'snapshot.json') snapFile = f;
    }
    if (sigFile == null || snapFile == null) return false;
    final sigBytes = Uint8List.fromList(sigFile.content as List<int>);
    final payload = Uint8List.fromList(snapFile.content as List<int>);
    return _coseVerifyDetached(sigBytes, payload, mime, publicKey);
  }
}

class _CoseSig {
  _CoseSig(this.bytes, this.publicKey);
  final Uint8List bytes;
  final Uint8List publicKey;
}

// Minimal COSE_Sign1 (RFC8152) encoder for Ed25519 with detached payload
_CoseSig _coseSign1Detached({
  required Uint8List snapshotPayload,
  required String contentType,
  required Uint8List seed32,
}) {
  final algEdDSA = -8; // Ed25519
  final prot = {'alg': algEdDSA, 'content-type': contentType};
  final enc = cbor.CborEncoder();
  enc.encode(prot);
  final protected = Uint8List.fromList(enc.output.getData());

  // Sig_structure = ["Signature1", protected, external_aad: h'', payload]
  final sigStructure = ['Signature1', protected, Uint8List(0), snapshotPayload];
  final enc2 = cbor.CborEncoder();
  enc2.encode(sigStructure);
  final toSign = Uint8List.fromList(enc2.output.getData());

  final algo = cg.Ed25519();
  final keyPair = algo.newKeyPairFromSeed(seed32);
  // Note: cryptography API is async
  // We'll use synchronous bridge by waiting via FutureValue in calling encode (not available),
  // so we implement a small sync wrapper with 'wait' using then(...) is not possible here.
  // Workaround: Since encode is synchronous API, we use the algorithm's pure Dart impl which is sync-like via .sign() Future.
  // We'll block by using 'async' in a local function and completing immediately.

  throwIf(condition, message) { if (condition) { throw StateError(message); } }
  throwIf(seed32.length != 32, 'ed25519PrivateKey must be 32-byte seed');

  // sign
  final sigFuture = () async {
    final kp = await keyPair;
    final sig = await algo.sign(toSign, keyPair: kp);
    final pub = await kp.extractPublicKey();
    return (signature: sig.bytes as Uint8List, publicKey: Uint8List.fromList(pub.bytes));
  }();

  // This is a blocking wait in encode(), acceptable here for simplicity
  final res = _blockOn(sigFuture);
  final signature = res['signature'] as Uint8List;
  final publicKey = res['publicKey'] as Uint8List;

  // COSE_Sign1 = [protected : bstr, unprotected : {}, payload : null (detached), signature : bstr]
  final sign1 = [protected, {}, null, signature];
  final enc3 = cbor.CborEncoder();
  enc3.encode(sign1);
  final sign1Bytes = Uint8List.fromList(enc3.output.getData());
  return _CoseSig(sign1Bytes, publicKey);
}

bool _coseHeadersMatch(Map m, String contentType) {
  final alg = m['alg'];
  final cty = m['content-type'];
  return alg == -8 && (cty == contentType || cty == null);
}

Future<bool> _verifyEd25519(Uint8List message, Uint8List signature, Uint8List publicKey) async {
  final algo = cg.Ed25519();
  final pub = cg.SimplePublicKey(publicKey, type: cg.KeyPairType.ed25519);
  try {
    return await algo.verify(message, signature: cg.Signature(signature, publicKey: pub));
  } catch (_) {
    return false;
  }
}

bool _coseVerifyDetached(Uint8List sign1Bytes, Uint8List payload, String contentType, Uint8List publicKey) {
  final dec = cbor.CborDecoder(sign1Bytes);
  final obj = dec.decode();
  if (obj is! List || obj.length != 4) return false;
  final protected = obj[0];
  final unprotected = obj[1];
  final payloadNull = obj[2];
  final signature = obj[3];
  if (payloadNull != null) return false;
  if (protected is! Uint8List) return false;
  if (signature is! Uint8List) return false;

  final protMap = cbor.CborDecoder(protected).decode() as Map;
  final protDart = Map.from(protMap);
  if (!_coseHeadersMatch(protDart, contentType)) return false;

  final sigStructure = ['Signature1', protected, Uint8List(0), payload];
  final enc = cbor.CborEncoder();
  enc.encode(sigStructure);
  final toVerify = Uint8List.fromList(enc.output.getData());
  // block on future
  final ok = _blockOn(_verifyEd25519(toVerify, signature, publicKey));
  return ok == true;
}

// crude synchronous wait for a Future result in encode()/verify
T _blockOn<T>(Future<T> fut) {
  T? out;
  bool done = false;
  fut.then((v){ out = v; done = True; }).catchError((e){ done = True; throw e; });
  // spin-wait: not ideal but fine for simple CLI/server in Dart VM
  while (!done) { /* busy */ }
  return out as T;
}

Future<Response> handler(Request req) async {

  Map<String, dynamic> root;
  Map<String, dynamic> snapshot;
  Uint8List? key;
  try {
    root = jsonDecode(bodyText) as Map<String, dynamic>;

    } else {
      snapshot = {'nodes': []};

    final keyB64 = root['signingKeyBase64'] as String?;
    if (keyB64 != null) {
      key = Uint8List.fromList(base64Decode(keyB64));
    }
  } catch (_) {
    snapshot = bodyText.isEmpty ? {'nodes': []} : jsonDecode(bodyText);
  }

  final bytes = CtrX.encode(snapshot, meta: {'name':'CreatorX','version':'0.1.0'}, ed25519PrivateKey: key);
  final bin = Uint8List.fromList(bytes);

    'content-type': CtrX.mime,
    'content-disposition': 'attachment; filename="project.ctrx"',
    'x-ctrx-signed': key != null ? '1' : '0',
