write(os.path.join(creatorx_root, "apps/creatorx_site/api/export/ctrx.post.dart"), """
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:typed_data';
import 'package:dartvel_core/dartvel.dart';
import 'package:ctrx_format/ctrx_format.dart';

List<Map<String, dynamic>> _harvest(Map<String, dynamic> snap) {
  final out = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
  final nodes = (snap['nodes'] as List?)?.cast<Map<String, dynamic>>() ?? const [];
  String extFrom(String mime) {
    switch (mime) {
      case 'image/png': return 'png';
      case 'image/jpeg': return 'jpg';
      case 'image/webp': return 'webp';
      case 'image/gif': return 'gif';
      case 'image/svg+xml': return 'svg';
      default: return 'bin';
    }
  }
  for (final n in nodes) {
    if (n['type'] != 'Image') continue;
    final props = (n['props'] as Map?)?.cast<String, dynamic>() ?? {};
    final src = props['src'] as String?;
    final dataUri = props['dataUri'] as String?;
    if (src != null && src.startsWith('asset:')) {
      final p = src.substring('asset:'.length);
      out.add({'path': p, 'base64': null});
    } else if (dataUri != null && dataUri.startsWith('data:')) {
      final i = dataUri.indexOf(',');
      final header = dataUri.substring(5, i);
      final mime = header.split(';').first;
      final b64 = dataUri.substring(i+1);
      final key = dataUri.hashCode.toUnsigned(32).toRadixString(16);
      final path = 'assets/img_' + key + '.' + extFrom(mime);
      out.add({'path': path, 'base64': b64});
      props['src'] = 'asset:' + path;
      n['props'] = props;
    }
  }
  return out;
}

Future<ResponseType> handler(Request req) async {
  final body = await req.readAsString();
  Map<String, dynamic> root = {};
  Map<String, dynamic> snapshot = {'nodes': []};
  Uint8List? seed;
  final assets = <String, Uint8List>{};

  try {
    root = jsonDecode(body) as Map<String, dynamic>;
    snapshot = ((root['snapshot'] ?? root) as Map).cast<String, dynamic>();
    final k = root['signingKeyBase64'] as String?;
    if (k != null) seed = Uint8List.fromList(base64Decode(k));
    final list = (root['assets'] as List?) ?? const [];
    for (final a in list) {
      final p0 = (a['path'] as String);
      final p = p0.startsWith('assets/') ? p0 : 'assets/' + p0;
      final b64 = a['base64'] as String;
      assets[p] = Uint8List.fromList(base64Decode(b64));
    }
  } catch (_) {
    if (body.isNotEmpty) snapshot = jsonDecode(body) as Map<String, dynamic>;
  }

  if (assets.isEmpty) {
    final harvest = _harvest(snapshot);
    for (final a in harvest) {
      final p0 = (a['path'] as String);
      final p = p0.startsWith('assets/') ? p0 : 'assets/' + p0;
      final b64 = a['base64'] as String?;
      if (b64 != null) assets[p] = Uint8List.fromList(base64Decode(b64));
    }
  }

  Uint8List bytes;
  if (seed != null) {
    bytes = await CtrX.encodeSigned(snapshot, assets: assets, meta: {'name':'CreatorX','version':'0.2.0'}, ed25519Seed32: seed);
  } else {
    bytes = CtrX.encode(snapshot, assets: assets, meta: {'name':'CreatorX','version':'0.2.0'});
  }

  return Res.text(String.fromCharCodes(bytes), headers: {
    'content-type': CtrX.mime,
    'content-disposition': 'attachment; filename="project.ctrx"',
    'x-ctrx-signed': seed != null ? '1' : '0',
    'access-control-allow-origin': '*',
    'access-control-allow-methods': 'GET,POST,OPTIONS',
    'access-control-allow-headers': 'Content-Type'
  });
}
""")

write(os.path.join(creatorx_root, "apps/creatorx_site/api/import/ctrx.post.dart"), """
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:typed_data';
import 'package:archive/archive.dart';
import 'package:dartvel_core/dartvel.dart';
import 'package:ctrx_format/ctrx_format.dart';
import '../ctrx_store.dart';

Map<String, dynamic> _rewrite(Map<String, dynamic> snap, String id) {
  final nodes = (snap['nodes'] as List?)?.cast<Map<String, dynamic>>() ?? const [];
  for (final n in nodes) {
    if (n['type'] == 'Image') {
      final props = (n['props'] as Map?)?.cast<String, dynamic>() ?? {};
      final src = props['src'] as String?;
      if (src != null && src.startsWith('asset:')) {
        final path = src.substring('asset:'.length);
        props.remove('dataUri');
        props['src'] = 'ctrx://$id/$path';
        n['props'] = props;
      }
    }
  }
  return {'nodes': nodes};
}

Future<ResponseType> handler(Request req) async {
  final Map<String, dynamic> inb = jsonDecode(await req.readAsString());
  final data = base64Decode(inb['fileBase64'] as String);
  final decoded = CtrX.decode(Uint8List.fromList(data));

  final arc = ZipDecoder().decodeBytes(data);
  final assets = <String, Uint8List>{};
  for (final f in arc) {
    if (f.name.startsWith('assets/')) {
      assets[f.name] = Uint8List.fromList(f.content as List<int>);
    }
  }
  final id = (decoded.manifest['id'] ?? 'unknown') as String;
  if (assets.isNotEmpty) ctrxStore.put(id, assets);

  bool? verified;
  final vk = inb['verifyKeyBase64'] as String?;
  if (vk != null) {
    verified = await CtrX.verifySignature(ctrxBytes: Uint8List.fromList(data), publicKey: Uint8List.fromList(base64Decode(vk)));
  }

  return Res.json(jsonEncode({
    'id': id,
    'manifest': decoded.manifest,
    'assetsStored': assets.length,
    'signatureVerified': verified,
    'snapshot': decoded.snapshot,
    'snapshotRewritten': _rewrite(decoded.snapshot, id)
  }));
}
""")

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

enum NodeType { container, text, autoLayout, image }

class Node {
  Node({
    required this.id,
    required this.type,
    required this.x,
    required this.y,
    required this.w,
    required this.h,
    this.rotation = 0,
    this.props = const {},
    this.parentId,
  });
  final String id;
  final NodeType type;
  double x, y, w, h;
  double rotation;
  Map<String, dynamic> props;
  String? parentId;
}

Widget renderNode(Node n, List<Node> all) {
  switch (n.type) {
    case NodeType.container:
      final fill = _toColor(n.props['fill']) ?? const Color(0xFF222222);
      final radius = (n.props['borderRadius'] ?? 8).toDouble();
      return ClipRRect(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(radius), child: Container(color: fill));
    case NodeType.text:
      return Center(child: Text(n.props['text'] ?? 'Text', style: TextStyle(fontSize: (n.props['fontSize'] ?? 16).toDouble(), color: _toColor(n.props['textColor']) ?? Colors.white)));
    case NodeType.autoLayout:
      final dir = (n.props['direction'] ?? 'row') == 'row' ? Axis.horizontal : Axis.vertical;
      final spacing = (n.props['spacing'] ?? 8).toDouble();
      final pad = (n.props['padding'] ?? 0).toDouble();
      final children = all.where((m) => m.parentId == n.id).toList();
      return Padding(padding: EdgeInsets.all(pad), child: Flex(direction: dir, children: [
        for (int i=0;i<children.length;i++) ...[
          Expanded(child: renderNode(children[i], all)),
          if (i < children.length-1) SizedBox(width: dir==Axis.horizontal?spacing:0, height: dir==Axis.vertical?spacing:0),
        ]
      ]));
    case NodeType.image:
      final dataUri = n.props['dataUri'] as String?;
      if (dataUri != null && dataUri.startsWith('data:')) return Image.network(dataUri, fit: BoxFit.cover);
      return Container(color: const Color(0xFF333333), child: const Center(child: Text('Image', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white70))));
  }
}

Color? _toColor(dynamic v) {
  if (v is Color) return v;
  if (v is String && v.startsWith('#') && (v.length == 9 || v.length == 7)) {
    final hex = v.length == 7 ? 'FF${v.substring(1)}' : v.substring(1);
    return Color(int.parse(hex, radix: 16));
  }
  return null;
}

String _nodeTypeToString(NodeType t) {
  switch (t) {
    case NodeType.container: return 'Container';
    case NodeType.text: return 'Text';
    case NodeType.autoLayout: return 'AutoLayout';
    case NodeType.image: return 'Image';
  }
}

extension NodeSer on Node {
  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
    'id': id, 'parentId': parentId, 'type': _nodeTypeToString(type),
    'x': x, 'y': y, 'w': w, 'h': h, 'rotation': rotation, 'props': props,
  };
}
""")

import 'package:hooks_riverpod/hooks_riverpod.dart';
import 'models.dart';
import 'package:uuid/uuid.dart';

final nodesProvider = StateNotifierProvider<NodesNotifier, List<Node>>((ref) => NodesNotifier());
final selectionProvider = StateProvider<String?>((_) => null);

class NodesNotifier extends StateNotifier<List<Node>> {
  NodesNotifier(): super([]);
  final _uuid = const Uuid();

  void add(NodeType type) {
    if (type == NodeType.autoLayout) { addAutoLayout(); return; }
    state = [...state, Node(id: _uuid.v4(), type: type, x: 80, y: 80, w: type == NodeType.text ? 220 : 200, h: type == NodeType.text ? 60 : 120,
      props: type == NodeType.text ? {'text':'Text','fontSize':18,'textColor':'#FFFFFFFF'} : {'fill':'#FF4F46E5','borderRadius':12})];
  }

  void addAutoLayout() {
    final parentId = _uuid.v4();
    final parent = Node(id: parentId, type: NodeType.autoLayout, x: 60, y: 60, w: 360, h: 140, props: {'direction':'row','spacing':12,'padding':12});
    final c1 = Node(id: _uuid.v4(), type: NodeType.text, x:0, y:0, w:160, h:60, props: {'text':'AutoLayout →','fontSize':18,'textColor':'#FFFFFFFF'}, parentId: parentId);
    final c2 = Node(id: _uuid.v4(), type: NodeType.text, x:0, y:0, w:160, h:60, props: {'text':'Children spaced','fontSize':18,'textColor':'#FFB3E5FC'}, parentId: parentId);
    state = [...state, parent, c1, c2];
  }

  void addImageFromAsset({required String dataUri, required String assetPath}) {
    state = [...state, Node(id: _uuid.v4(), type: NodeType.image, x: 80, y: 80, w: 220, h: 160, props: {'src':'asset:$assetPath','dataUri': dataUri})];
  }

  void move(String id, double dx, double dy) {
    state = [for (final n in state) if (n.id == id) Node(id: n.id, type: n.type, x: n.x+dx, y: n.y+dy, w: n.w, h: n.h, rotation:n.rotation, props:n.props, parentId:n.parentId) else n];
  }
  void resize(String id, {double? w, double? h}) {
    state = [for (final n in state) if (n.id == id) Node(id: n.id, type: n.type, x: n.x, y: n.y, w: w ?? n.w, h: h ?? n.h, rotation:n.rotation, props:n.props, parentId:n.parentId) else n];
  }
  void setProp(String id, String key, dynamic value) {
    state = [for (final n in state) if (n.id == id) Node(id: n.id, type: n.type, x: n.x, y: n.y, w: n.w, h: n.h, rotation:n.rotation, props:{...n.props, key:value}, parentId:n.parentId) else n];
  }
}
""")

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:hooks_riverpod/hooks_riverpod.dart';
import 'models.dart';
import 'state.dart';
import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
// ignore: avoid_web_libraries_in_flutter
import 'dart:html' as html;

void main() => runApp(const ProviderScope(child: StudioApp()));

class AssetItem {
  AssetItem({required this.path, required this.base64, required this.dataUri});
  final String path;
  final String base64;
  final String dataUri;
}

final assetsProvider = StateNotifierProvider<AssetsNotifier, List<AssetItem>>((ref) => AssetsNotifier());
class AssetsNotifier extends StateNotifier<List<AssetItem>> {
  AssetsNotifier(): super([]);
  void add(AssetItem a) => state = [...state, a];
  void clear() => state = [];
}

enum RightTab { inspector, assets }
final rightTabProvider = StateProvider<RightTab>((_) => RightTab.inspector);

class StudioApp extends StatelessWidget {
  const StudioApp({super.key});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return MaterialApp(title: 'CreatorX Studio', theme: ThemeData.dark(useMaterial3: true), home: const EditorScreen(), debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false);
  }
}

class EditorScreen extends ConsumerWidget {
  const EditorScreen({super.key});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('CreatorX Studio'), actions: [IconButton(tooltip:'Download .ctrx', icon: const Icon(Icons.download), onPressed: () => _downloadCtrx(context, ref))]),
      body: const Row(children: [SizedBox(width:220, child: Palette()), Expanded(child: CanvasView()), SizedBox(width:320, child: RightPanel())]),
    );
  }
}

class Palette extends ConsumerWidget {
  const Palette({super.key});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final nodes = ref.read(nodesProvider.notifier);
    return Container(color: const Color(0xFF111111), child: ListView(padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12), children: [
      ListTile(title: const Text('Upload Images', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white)), onTap: () { _pickImages(context, ref); ref.read(rightTabProvider.notifier).state = RightTab.assets; }),
      ListTile(title: const Text('Add AutoLayout', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white)), onTap: () => nodes.add(NodeType.autoLayout)),
      ListTile(title: const Text('Add Container', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white)), onTap: () => nodes.add(NodeType.container)),
      ListTile(title: const Text('Add Text', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white)), onTap: () => nodes.add(NodeType.text)),
    ]));
  }
}

class CanvasView extends ConsumerStatefulWidget { const CanvasView({super.key}); @override ConsumerState<CanvasView> createState()=>_CanvasViewState(); }
class _CanvasViewState extends ConsumerState<CanvasView> {
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final nodes = ref.watch(nodesProvider);
    final selected = ref.watch(selectionProvider);
    return Container(color: const Color(0xFF1F1F1F), child: Stack(children: [
      for (final n in nodes.where((n) => n.parentId == null))
        Positioned(left: n.x, top: n.y, width: n.w, height: n.h, child: GestureDetector(
          onTap: () => ref.read(selectionProvider.notifier).state = n.id,
          onPanUpdate: (d) { if (n.parentId == null) ref.read(nodesProvider.notifier).move(n.id, d.delta.dx, d.delta.dy); },
          child: Stack(clipBehavior: Clip.none, children: [
            DecoratedBox(decoration: BoxDecoration(border: selected==n.id ? Border.all(color: Colors.blueAccent, width:1.5) : null), child: renderNode(n, nodes)),
            if (selected==n.id && n.parentId==null) Positioned(right:-10,bottom:-10, child: GestureDetector(onPanUpdate:(d)=>ref.read(nodesProvider.notifier).resize(n.id, w:n.w+d.delta.dx, h:n.h+d.delta.dy), child: const _Handle())),
          ]),
        )),
    ]));
  }
}
class _Handle extends StatelessWidget { const _Handle(); @override Widget build(BuildContext c)=>Container(width:16,height:16,decoration:BoxDecoration(color:Colors.white,border:Border.all(color:Colors.blue,width:2))); }

class RightPanel extends ConsumerWidget {
  const RightPanel({super.key});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final tab = ref.watch(rightTabProvider);
    return Column(children: [
      Container(color: const Color(0xFF0E0E0E), padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8), child: Row(children: [
        _TabButton(label: 'Inspector', active: tab==RightTab.inspector, onTap: ()=>ref.read(rightTabProvider.notifier).state = RightTab.inspector),
        const SizedBox(width: 8),
        _TabButton(label: 'Assets', active: tab==RightTab.assets, onTap: ()=>ref.read(rightTabProvider.notifier).state = RightTab.assets),
      ])),
      Expanded(child: Container(color: const Color(0xFF111111), child: tab==RightTab.inspector ? const InspectorPanel() : const AssetBrowser())),
    ]);

}
class _TabButton extends StatelessWidget {
  const _TabButton({required this.label, required this.active, required this.onTap, super.key});
  final String label; final bool active; final VoidCallback onTap;
  @override Widget build(BuildContext context) => TextButton(onPressed: onTap, child: Text(label, style: TextStyle(color: active? Colors.white : Colors.white70)));
}

class InspectorPanel extends ConsumerWidget {
  const InspectorPanel({super.key});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final sel = ref.watch(selectionProvider);
    final nodes = ref.watch(nodesProvider);
    final node = nodes.where((n)=>n.id==sel).cast<Node?>().firstOrNull;
    if (node==null) return Container(color: const Color(0xFF111111), child: const Center(child: Text('Select a node', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white54))));
    return Container(color: const Color(0xFF111111), padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12), child: ListView(children: [
      Text('Node ${node.id.substring(0,6)}', style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white70)),
      const SizedBox(height: 8),
      if (node.type == NodeType.text) TextField(style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white), decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText:'Text', labelStyle: TextStyle(color: Colors.white70)),
        controller: TextEditingController(text: node.props['text'] ?? '')..selection = TextSelection.collapsed(offset: (node.props['text'] ?? '').toString().length),
        onSubmitted: (v)=>ref.read(nodesProvider.notifier).setProp(node.id,'text',v)),
    ]));
  }
}

class AssetBrowser extends ConsumerWidget {
  const AssetBrowser({super.key});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final assets = ref.watch(assetsProvider);
    return Column(children: [
      Padding(padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8), child: Row(children: [
        const Text('Project Assets', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white70)),
        const Spacer(),
        Text('${assets.length} item(s)', style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white38)),
      ])),
      const Divider(height: 1, color: Colors.white12),
      Expanded(child: ListView.builder(
        itemCount: assets.length,
        itemBuilder: (context, i) {
          final a = assets[i];
          final refs = _findRefs(ref, a.path);
          return ListTile(
            title: Text(a.path, style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white)),
            subtitle: Text('Refs: ${refs.length}', style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white54)),
            trailing: Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: [
              TextButton(onPressed: () => _replaceAsset(context, ref, i), child: const Text('Replace')),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              TextButton(onPressed: () => _renameAsset(context, ref, i), child: const Text('Rename')),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              TextButton(onPressed: () => _showRefs(context, refs), child: const Text('View refs')),
            ]),
          );
        },
      )),
    ]);
  }

  List<String> _findRefs(WidgetRef ref, String path) {
    final nodes = ref.read(nodesProvider);
    final targets = <String>[];
    for (final n in nodes) {
      final src = (n.props['src'] ?? '') as String;
      if (src == 'asset:$path' || src.endsWith('/$path')) targets.add(n.id);
    }
    return targets;
  }
}

Future<void> _replaceAsset(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref, int index) async {
  final assets = ref.read(assetsProvider);
  final item = assets[index];
  final input = html.FileUploadInputElement()..accept='image/*';
  input.click();
  await input.onChange.first;
  if (input.files == null || input.files!.isEmpty) return;
  final file = input.files!.first;
  final reader = html.FileReader(); reader.readAsDataUrl(file); await reader.onLoad.first;
  final dataUri = reader.result as String;
  final comma = dataUri.indexOf(',');
  final base64 = comma >= 0 ? dataUri.substring(comma+1) : '';
  final list = [...assets];
  list[index] = AssetItem(path: item.path, base64: base64, dataUri: dataUri);
  ref.read(assetsProvider.notifier).state = list;
  final nodes = [...ref.read(nodesProvider)];
  for (int i=0;i<nodes.length;i++) {
    final n = nodes[i]; final src = (n.props['src'] ?? '') as String;
    if (src == 'asset:${item.path}' || src.endsWith('/${item.path}')) n.props['dataUri'] = dataUri;
  }
  ref.read(nodesProvider.notifier).state = nodes;
  if (context.mounted) ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(content: Text('Asset replaced')));
}

Future<void> _renameAsset(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref, int index) async {
  final assets = ref.read(assetsProvider);
  final item = assets[index];
  final controller = TextEditingController(text: item.path);
  final newPath = await showDialog<String?>(context: context, builder: (ctx) {
    return AlertDialog(
      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF1E1E1E),
      title: const Text('Rename asset', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white)),
      content: TextField(controller: controller, style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white)),
      actions: [TextButton(onPressed: ()=>Navigator.pop(ctx, null), child: const Text('Cancel')), TextButton(onPressed: ()=>Navigator.pop(ctx, controller.text), child: const Text('Save'))],
    );
  });
  if (newPath == null || newPath.isEmpty || newPath == item.path) return;
  final list = [...assets];
  list[index] = AssetItem(path: newPath, base64: item.base64, dataUri: item.dataUri);
  ref.read(assetsProvider.notifier).state = list;
  final nodes = [...ref.read(nodesProvider)];
  for (int i=0;i<nodes.length;i++) {
    final n = nodes[i]; final src = (n.props['src'] ?? '') as String;
    if (src == 'asset:${item.path}') n.props['src'] = 'asset:$newPath';
    else if (src.endsWith('/${item.path}')) { final prefix = src.substring(0, src.length - item.path.length); n.props['src'] = prefix + newPath; }
  }
  ref.read(nodesProvider.notifier).state = nodes;
  if (context.mounted) ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(content: Text('Asset renamed')));
}

void _showRefs(BuildContext context, List<String> refs) {
  showDialog(context: context, builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
    backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF1E1E1E),
    title: const Text('References', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white)),
    content: SizedBox(width: 380, child: SingleChildScrollView(child: Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
      for (final id in refs) Text('• Node $id', style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white70)),
      if (refs.isEmpty) const Text('No references', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white54)),
    ]))),
    actions: [TextButton(onPressed: ()=>Navigator.pop(ctx), child: const Text('Close'))],
  ));
}

extension FirstOrNull<E> on Iterable<E> { E? get firstOrNull => isEmpty ? null : first; }

Future<void> _pickImages(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) async {
  final input = html.FileUploadInputElement()..accept='image/*'..multiple=true;
  input.click();
  await input.onChange.first;
  if (input.files == null || input.files!.isEmpty) return;
  for (final file in input.files!) {
    final reader = html.FileReader(); reader.readAsDataUrl(file); await reader.onLoad.first;
    final dataUri = reader.result as String;
    final comma = dataUri.indexOf(',');
    final base64 = comma >= 0 ? dataUri.substring(comma+1) : '';
    final assetPath = 'assets/${file.name}';
    ref.read(assetsProvider.notifier).add(AssetItem(path: assetPath, base64: base64, dataUri: dataUri));
    ref.read(nodesProvider.notifier).addImageFromAsset(dataUri: dataUri, assetPath: assetPath);
  }
  if (context.mounted) ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(content: Text('Images added to project')));
}

List<Map<String, String>> collectAssetsFromNodes(List<dynamic> nodes, List<AssetItem> lib) {
  final Map<String, String> libIndex = {for (final a in lib) a.path: a.base64};
  String? _guessExtFromDataUri(String uri) {
    final i = uri.indexOf(';');
    final mime = i > 5 ? uri.substring(5, i) : 'image/bin';
    if (mime == 'image/png') return 'png';
    if (mime == 'image/jpeg') return 'jpg';
    if (mime == 'image/webp') return 'webp';
    if (mime == 'image/gif') return 'gif';
    if (mime == 'image/svg+xml') return 'svg';
    return 'bin';
  }
  String _stripBase64(String uri) {
    final i = uri.indexOf(',');
    return i >= 0 ? uri.substring(i+1) : uri;
  }
  final out = <Map<String, String>>[];
  final seen = <String>{};
  for (final raw in nodes) {
    final n = (raw as Map).cast<String, dynamic>();
    if (n['type'] != 'Image') continue;
    final props = (n['props'] as Map?)?.cast<String, dynamic>() ?? {};
    final src = props['src'] as String?;
    final dataUri = props['dataUri'] as String?;
    if (src != null && src.startsWith('asset:')) {
      final p = src.substring('asset:'.length);
      if (!seen.contains(p)) {
        final b64 = libIndex[p] ?? (dataUri != null ? _stripBase64(dataUri) : '');
        if (b64.isNotEmpty) { out.add({'path': p, 'base64': b64}); seen.add(p); }
      }
      continue;
    }
    if (dataUri != null && dataUri.startsWith('data:')) {
      final ext = _guessExtFromDataUri(dataUri) ?? 'bin';
      final key = dataUri.hashCode.toUnsigned(32).toRadixString(16);
      final path = 'assets/img_%s.%s'.replaceFirst('%s', key).replaceFirst('%s', ext);
      if (!seen.contains(path)) {
        out.add({'path': path, 'base64': _stripBase64(dataUri)});
        props['src'] = 'asset:' + path; n['props'] = props; seen.add(path);
      }
    }
  }
  return out;
}

Future<void> _downloadCtrx(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) async {
  final nodes = ref.read(nodesProvider);
  final nodesJson = nodes.map((n)=>n.toJson()).toList();
  final assets = collectAssetsFromNodes(nodesJson, ref.read(assetsProvider));
  final body = jsonEncode({'snapshot': {'nodes': nodesJson}, 'assets': assets});
  try {
    final res = await http.post(Uri.parse('/api/export/ctrx'), headers: {'content-type':'application/json'}, body: body);
    if (res.statusCode == 200) {
      final blob = html.Blob([res.bodyBytes]);
      final url = html.Url.createObjectUrlFromBlob(blob);
      final a = html.AnchorElement(href: url)..download = 'project.ctrx';
      html.document.body!.append(a); a.click(); a.remove(); html.Url.revokeObjectUrl(url);
      if (context.mounted) ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(content: Text('Downloaded project.ctrx')));
    } else {
      if (context.mounted) ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('Export failed (${res.statusCode})')));
    }
  } catch (e) {
    if (context.mounted) ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('Export error: $e')));
  }
}
""")

import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;

void main() => runApp(const ViewerApp());

class ViewerApp extends StatelessWidget {
  const ViewerApp({super.key});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => MaterialApp(title: 'CreatorX Viewer', theme: ThemeData.dark(useMaterial3: true), home: const ViewerScreen(), debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false);
}

class ViewerScreen extends StatefulWidget { const ViewerScreen({super.key}); @override State<ViewerScreen> createState()=>_ViewerScreenState(); }
class _ViewerScreenState extends State<ViewerScreen> {
  Map<String, dynamic>? snapshot;
  @override void initState(){ super.initState(); _load(); }
  Future<void> _load() async {
    final res = await http.get(Uri.parse('/api/projects/snapshot'));
    if (res.statusCode == 200) setState(()=>snapshot=jsonDecode(res.body));
  }
  @override Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final s = snapshot; if (s==null) return const Scaffold(body: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()));
    final nodes = (s['nodes'] as List).cast<Map<String, dynamic>>();
    return Scaffold(appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('CreatorX Viewer')), body: Stack(children: nodes.where((n)=>n['parentId']==null).map((n)=>_buildNode(n, nodes)).toList()));
  }
  Widget _buildNode(Map<String,dynamic> n, List<Map<String,dynamic>> all) {
    final x=(n['x']??0).toDouble(), y=(n['y']??0).toDouble(), w=(n['w']??100).toDouble(), h=(n['h']??60).toDouble();
    final type = n['type'] as String; final props = (n['props'] as Map?)?.cast<String,dynamic>() ?? {};
    Widget child;
    if (type=='Container') { final color=_color(props['fill'])??const Color(0xFF222222); final r=(props['borderRadius']??8).toDouble(); child=ClipRRect(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(r), child: Container(color: color)); }
    else if (type=='Text') { child=Center(child: Text(props['text']??'', style: TextStyle(fontSize:(props['fontSize']??16).toDouble(), color:_color(props['textColor'])??Colors.white))); }
    else if (type=='AutoLayout') {
      final dir=(props['direction']??'row')=='row'?Axis.horizontal:Axis.vertical; final spacing=(props['spacing']??8).toDouble(); final pad=(props['padding']??0).toDouble();
      final children = all.where((m)=>m['parentId']==n['id']).toList();
      child = Padding(padding: EdgeInsets.all(pad), child: Flex(direction: dir, children: [
        for (int i=0;i<children.length;i++) ...[ Expanded(child: _buildNode(children[i], all)), if (i<children.length-1) SizedBox(width: dir==Axis.horizontal?spacing:0, height: dir==Axis.vertical?spacing:0) ]
      ]));
    } else if (type=='Image') {
      final src = props['src'] as String?;
      Widget img = const SizedBox.shrink();
      if (src != null) {
        if (src.startsWith('ctrx://')) {
          final rest = src.substring(7); final i = rest.indexOf('/');
          if (i>0) { final id = rest.substring(0,i); final path = rest.substring(i+1); final url = Uri(path:'/api/ctrx/asset', queryParameters:{'id':id,'path':path}).toString(); img = Image.network(url, fit: BoxFit.cover); }
        } else if (src.startsWith('data:') || src.startsWith('http')) {
          img = Image.network(src, fit: BoxFit.cover);
        }
      }
      child = ClipRRect(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular((props['radius']??0).toDouble()), child: img);
    } else { child = const SizedBox.shrink(); }
    return Positioned(left:x, top:y, width:w, height:h, child: child);
  }
  Color? _color(dynamic v){ if(v is String && v.startsWith('#')){ final hex = v.length==7? 'FF'+v.substring(1): v.substring(1); return Color(int.parse(hex, radix:16)); } return null; }
}
""")

# FORMAT SPEC
write(os.path.join(creatorx_root, "FORMAT_SPEC.md"), """
# CreatorX Project Format (.ctrx) — v1.1
- `mimetype`: `application/creator_X_project`
- `snapshot.json` (canonical) + `snapshot.cbor` (CBOR mirror; prefer CBOR)
- `assets/*` (binary assets bundled)
- `manifest.json` (id, version, tool, asset table, optional signature block)
- `integrity.sha256` (sha256 lines)
- optional: `signature.sig` (COSE_Sign1, detached Ed25519 over snapshot.json) + `signature.pubkey`
""")

description: Minimal core for dartvel SSR server (types + helpers)
version: 0.1.0
environment:
  sdk: ">=3.4.0 <4.0.0"
dependencies:
  shelf: ^1.4.1
  shelf_router: ^1.1.4
  yaml: ^3.1.2

write(os.path.join(dartvel_root, "packages/dartvel_core/lib/dartvel.dart"), """
library dartvel_core;

import 'package:shelf/shelf.dart' as shelf;
import 'package:shelf_router/shelf_router.dart' as router;
export 'package:shelf/shelf.dart' show Pipeline;

typedef Request = shelf.Request;
typedef ResponseType = shelf.Response;
typedef Handler = Future<ResponseType> Function(Request req);

class Res {
  static ResponseType json(String body, {Map<String, String>? headers}) =>
      shelf.Response(200, body: body, headers: {
        'content-type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8',
        if (headers != null) ...headers,
      });

  static ResponseType html(String body, {Map<String, String>? headers}) =>
      shelf.Response(200, body: body, headers: {
        'content-type': 'text/html; charset=utf-8',
        if (headers != null) ...headers,
      });

  static ResponseType text(String body, {int status = 200, Map<String, String>? headers}) =>
      shelf.Response(status, body: body, headers: {
        'content-type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8',
        if (headers != null) ...headers,
      });

  static ResponseType notFound([String body = 'Not Found']) =>
      shelf.Response.notFound(body);
}

class Server {
  static shelf.Handler mount(Map<String, Handler> apiRoutes, Map<String, Handler> pageRoutes) {
    final r = router.Router();

    apiRoutes.forEach((path, handler) {
      r.add('GET', path, (shelf.Request req) => handler(req));
      r.add('POST', path, (shelf.Request req) => handler(req));
      r.add('OPTIONS', path, (shelf.Request req) => handler(req));
      r.add('DELETE', path, (shelf.Request req) => handler(req));
      r.add('PATCH', path, (shelf.Request req) => handler(req));
    });

    pageRoutes.forEach((path, handler) {
      r.add('GET', path, (shelf.Request req) => handler(req));
    });

    return r;
  }
}
""")

def zip_dir(root_dir, out_zip):
    with zipfile.ZipFile(out_zip, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
        for root, _, files in os.walk(root_dir):
            for f in files:
                p = os.path.join(root, f)
                z.write(p, os.path.relpath(p, root_dir))

def draw_ui_preview(title, elements, size=(1600, 900), outfile="preview.png"):
    img = Image.new("RGB", size, (22,22,22))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    W, H = size
    d.rectangle([(0,0),(W,64)], fill=(17,17,17))
    d.text((24,18), title, fill=(255,255,255))
    for (x,y,w,h), label, color in elements:
        d.rectangle([(x,y),(x+w,y+h)], outline=color, width=3)
        d.text((x+12,y+12), label, fill=color)
    img.save(outfile)

Download

creator_x.zip (the app builder itself: Studio, Viewer, SSR, CTRX format lib)
Download

Unzip both side-by-side like:

/work
  ├─ dartvel/
  └─ creator_x/
How to run
1) Start the SSR backend (dart + shelf)
cd /work/creator_x
dart pub get
dart run .dart_tool/dartvel_server.dart
# → http://localhost:3000
Endpoints (CORS enabled):

GET /api/projects/snapshot

POST /api/export/ctrx

POST /api/import/ctrx

GET /api/ctrx/asset?id=<manifestId>&path=assets/<file>

2) Run the Studio (Flutter web)
cd /work/creator_x/apps/creatorx_studio
flutter pub get
flutter run -d chrome
In the Studio:

Upload images → they appear on the canvas and in Assets tab.

Download .ctrx → exports snapshot + assets automatically.

3) Import to the SSR (register assets)
# base64-encode the .ctrx file you downloaded from Studio and POST it:
b64=$(base64 -w0 project.ctrx)
curl -sX POST http://localhost:3000/api/import/ctrx \
  -H "content-type: application/json" \
  --data "{\"fileBase64\":\"$b64\"}"
Response includes:

id (manifest id used in ctrx://<id>/assets/...)

assetsStored count

snapshotRewritten where Image nodes now use ctrx:// scheme (and drop dataUri)

4) Run the Viewer (Flutter web)
cd /work/creator_x/apps/creatorx_viewer
flutter pub get
flutter run -d chrome
The Viewer loads snapshot data and resolves ctrx:// images via the SSR asset endpoint.

What’s inside (high-level)
creator_x/

packages/ctrx_format/ — CTRX container:

snapshot.json + snapshot.cbor (CBOR), manifest.json, integrity.sha256, assets/*, optional signature.sig + signature.pubkey (COSE Ed25519, detached)

apps/creatorx_site/ — SSR APIs & pages

api/export/ctrx.post.dart — auto-harvests assets from nodes’ dataUri or asset: refs and bundles them

api/import/ctrx.post.dart — registers /assets/* in memory, rewrites Image.src to ctrx://<id>/assets/...

api/ctrx/asset.get.dart — serves asset bytes

pages (/, /studio, /viewer/[projectId]) for simple SSR verification

apps/creatorx_studio/ — Flutter editor (Studio)

Free-canvas nodes: Container, Text, AutoLayout, Image

Assets tab: replace, rename, view refs

Download .ctrx: auto-bundles everything (no manual lists)

apps/creatorx_viewer/ — Flutter viewer

Resolves ctrx://<id>/assets/... via SSR

dartvel/

packages/dartvel_core/ — minimal core used by CreatorX

Exposes Request, ResponseType, and Res.json/html/text(...) helpers

Simple server Server.mount(apiRoutes, pageRoutes) used by .dart_tool/dartvel_server.dart

packages/dartvel_flutter/ — stub so pub get is happy

write(os.path.join(creatorx_root, "packages/ctrx_format/lib/ctrx_format.dart"), r"""
library ctrx_format;

import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:typed_data';
import 'package:archive/archive.dart';
import 'package:crypto/crypto.dart';
import 'package:cryptography/cryptography.dart' as cg;
import 'package:cbor/cbor.dart' as cbor;
import 'package:uuid/uuid.dart';

class CtrX {
  static const String mime = 'application/creator_X_project';
  static const String ext = '.ctrx';
  static const String version = '1.1';

  static Uint8List encode(
    Map<String, dynamic> snapshot, {
    Map<String, Uint8List>? assets,
    Map<String, dynamic>? meta,
  }) {
    final archive = Archive();

    final mimeFile = ArchiveFile('mimetype', mime.length, Uint8List.fromList(utf8.encode(mime)));
    mimeFile.compress = false;
    archive.addFile(mimeFile);

    final jsonBytes = Uint8List.fromList(utf8.encode(jsonEncode(snapshot)));
    archive.addFile(ArchiveFile('snapshot.json', jsonBytes.length, jsonBytes));

    final enc = cbor.CborEncoder()..encode(snapshot);
    final cborBytes = Uint8List.fromList(enc.output.getData());
    archive.addFile(ArchiveFile('snapshot.cbor', cborBytes.length, cborBytes));

    final assetsList = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    assets?.forEach((p, bytes) {
      final path = p.startsWith('assets/') ? p : 'assets/$p';
      archive.addFile(ArchiveFile(path, bytes.length, bytes));
      assetsList.add({'path': path, 'size': bytes.length, 'sha256': sha256.convert(bytes).toString()});
    });

    final lines = <String>['snapshot.json  ${sha256.convert(jsonBytes)}'];
    for (final a in assetsList) { lines.add('${a['path']}  ${a['sha256']}'); }
    final integ = Uint8List.fromList(utf8.encode(lines.join('\n')));
    archive.addFile(ArchiveFile('integrity.sha256', integ.length, integ));

    final manifest = {
      'format': 'ctrx',
      'version': version,
      'id': const Uuid().v4(),
      'createdAt': DateTime.now().toUtc().toIso8601String(),
      'tool': meta ?? {'name': 'CreatorX', 'version': '0.2.0'},
      'snapshot': {'sha256': sha256.convert(jsonBytes).toString(), 'bytes': jsonBytes.length, 'cborBytes': cborBytes.length},
      'assets': assetsList,
      'signature': null,
    };
    final manBytes = Uint8List.fromList(utf8.encode(jsonEncode(manifest)));
    archive.addFile(ArchiveFile('manifest.json', manBytes.length, manBytes));

    return Uint8List.fromList(ZipEncoder().encode(archive)!);
  }

  static Future<Uint8List> encodeSigned(
    Map<String, dynamic> snapshot, {
    Map<String, Uint8List>? assets,
    Map<String, dynamic>? meta,
    required Uint8List ed25519Seed32,
  }) async {
    final base = encode(snapshot, assets: assets, meta: meta);
    final arc = ZipDecoder().decodeBytes(base);
    final snapFile = arc.firstWhere((f) => f.name == 'snapshot.json');
    final payload = Uint8List.fromList(snapFile.content as List<int>);

    final cose = await _coseSignDetached(payload, mime, ed25519Seed32);
    arc.addFile(ArchiveFile('signature.sig', cose.bytes.length, cose.bytes));
    arc.addFile(ArchiveFile('signature.pubkey', cose.publicKey.length, cose.publicKey));

    final mIdx = arc.files.indexWhere((f) => f.name == 'manifest.json');
    final manifest = jsonDecode(utf8.decode(arc.files[mIdx].content as List<int>)) as Map<String, dynamic>;
    manifest['signature'] = {
      'alg': 'EdDSA',
      'protected': {'alg': -8, 'content-type': mime},
      'detached': true,
      'file': 'signature.sig',
      'publicKeyB64': base64Encode(cose.publicKey),
    };
    final manBytes = Uint8List.fromList(utf8.encode(jsonEncode(manifest)));
    arc.files[mIdx] = ArchiveFile('manifest.json', manBytes.length, manBytes);
    return Uint8List.fromList(ZipEncoder().encode(arc)!);
  }

  static ({Map<String, dynamic> snapshot, Map<String, dynamic> manifest}) decode(Uint8List bytes) {
    final arc = ZipDecoder().decodeBytes(bytes);
    ArchiveFile? cborFile, jsonFile, manFile;
    for (final f in arc) {
      if (f.name == 'snapshot.cbor') cborFile = f;
      if (f.name == 'snapshot.json') jsonFile = f;
      if (f.name == 'manifest.json') manFile = f;
    }
    if (manFile == null || (cborFile == null && jsonFile == null)) {
      throw StateError('Invalid CTRX');
    }
    Map<String, dynamic> snapshot;
    if (cborFile != null) {
      final dec = cbor.CborDecoder(cborFile.content as List<int>);
      snapshot = Map<String, dynamic>.from(dec.decode() as Map);
    } else {
      snapshot = jsonDecode(utf8.decode(jsonFile!.content as List<int>)) as Map<String, dynamic>;
    }
    final manifest = jsonDecode(utf8.decode(manFile.content as List<int>)) as Map<String, dynamic>;
    return (snapshot: snapshot, manifest: manifest);
  }

  static Future<bool> verifySignature({required Uint8List ctrxBytes, required Uint8List publicKey}) async {
    final arc = ZipDecoder().decodeBytes(ctrxBytes);
    ArchiveFile? sigFile, snapFile;
    for (final f in arc) {
      if (f.name == 'signature.sig') sigFile = f;
      if (f.name == 'snapshot.json') snapFile = f;
    }
    if (sigFile == null || snapFile == null) return false;
    return _coseVerifyDetached(Uint8List.fromList(sigFile.content as List<int>), Uint8List.fromList(snapFile.content as List<int>), mime, publicKey);
  }
}

class _CoseSig {
  _CoseSig(this.bytes, this.publicKey);
  final Uint8List bytes;
  final Uint8List publicKey;
}

Future<_CoseSig> _coseSignDetached(Uint8List payload, String contentType, Uint8List seed32) async {
  if (seed32.length != 32) throw StateError('ed25519 seed must be 32 bytes');
  const algEdDSA = -8;
  final protected = () {
    final enc = cbor.CborEncoder()..encode({'alg': algEdDSA, 'content-type': contentType});
    return Uint8List.fromList(enc.output.getData());
  }();
  final sigStructBytes = () {
    final enc = cbor.CborEncoder()..encode(['Signature1', protected, Uint8List(0), payload]);
    return Uint8List.fromList(enc.output.getData());
  }();

  final algo = cg.Ed25519();
  final kp = await algo.newKeyPairFromSeed(seed32);
  final signature = await algo.sign(sigStructBytes, keyPair: kp);
  final pub = await kp.extractPublicKey();

  final sign1 = [protected, <String, dynamic>{}, null, Uint8List.fromList(signature.bytes)];
  final enc = cbor.CborEncoder()..encode(sign1);
  return _CoseSig(Uint8List.fromList(enc.output.getData()), Uint8List.fromList(pub.bytes));
}

Future<bool> _coseVerifyDetached(Uint8List sign1, Uint8List payload, String contentType, Uint8List publicKey) async {
  final dec = cbor.CborDecoder(sign1);
  final obj = dec.decode();
  if (obj is! List || obj.length != 4) return false;
  final protected = obj[0];
  final signature = obj[3];
  if (protected is! Uint8List || signature is! Uint8List) return false;

  final map = cbor.CborDecoder(protected).decode() as Map;
  if (map['alg'] != -8) return false;
  if (map['content-type'] != null && map['content-type'] != contentType) return false;

  final sigStructBytes = () {
    final enc = cbor.CborEncoder()..encode(['Signature1', protected, Uint8List(0), payload]);
    return Uint8List.fromList(enc.output.getData());
  }();
  final algo = cg.Ed25519();
  final pub = cg.SimplePublicKey(publicKey, type: cg.KeyPairType.ed25519);
  try {
    return await algo.verify(sigStructBytes, signature: cg.Signature(signature, publicKey: pub));
  } catch (_) {
    return false;
  }
}
""")

write(os.path.join(creatorx_root, "apps/creatorx_site/api/ctrx_store.dart"), """
import 'dart:collection';
import 'dart:typed_data';
class CtrxStore {
  final _assets = HashMap<String, Map<String, Uint8List>>();
  void put(String id, Map<String, Uint8List> assets) => _assets[id] = assets;
  Uint8List? get(String id, String path) => _assets[id]?[path];
}
final ctrxStore = CtrxStore();
""")

write(os.path.join(creatorx_root, "apps/creatorx_site/api/ctrx/asset.get.dart"), """
import 'package:dartvel_core/dartvel.dart';
import '../ctrx_store.dart';

String _ct(String p) {
  p = p.toLowerCase();
  if (p.endsWith('.png')) return 'image/png';
  if (p.endsWith('.jpg') || p.endsWith('.jpeg')) return 'image/jpeg';
  if (p.endsWith('.webp')) return 'image/webp';
  if (p.endsWith('.gif')) return 'image/gif';
  if (p.endsWith('.svg')) return 'image/svg+xml';
  return 'application/octet-stream';
}

Future<ResponseType> handler(Request req) async {
  final id = req.url.queryParameters['id'];
  final path = req.url.queryParameters['path'];
  if (id == null || path == null) return Res.text('id & path required', status: 400);
  final bytes = ctrxStore.get(id, path);
  if (bytes == null) return Res.text('not found', status: 404);
  return Res.text(String.fromCharCodes(bytes), headers: {
    'content-type': _ct(path),
    'cache-control': 'public, max-age=31536000, immutable',
    'access-control-allow-origin': '*',
    'access-control-allow-methods': 'GET,POST,OPTIONS',
    'access-control-allow-headers': 'Content-Type'
  });
}
""")

write(os.path.join(creatorx_root, "apps/creatorx_site/api/export/ctrx.post.dart"), """
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:typed_data';
import 'package:dartvel_core/dartvel.dart';
import 'package:ctrx_format/ctrx_format.dart';

List<Map<String, dynamic>> _harvest(Map<String, dynamic> snap) {
  final out = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
  final nodes = (snap['nodes'] as List?)?.cast<Map<String, dynamic>>() ?? const [];
  String extFrom(String mime) {
    switch (mime) {
      case 'image/png': return 'png';
      case 'image/jpeg': return 'jpg';
      case 'image/webp': return 'webp';
      case 'image/gif': return 'gif';
      case 'image/svg+xml': return 'svg';
      default: return 'bin';
    }
  }
  for (final n in nodes) {
    if (n['type'] != 'Image') continue;
    final props = (n['props'] as Map?)?.cast<String, dynamic>() ?? {};
    final src = props['src'] as String?;
    final dataUri = props['dataUri'] as String?;
    if (src != null && src.startsWith('asset:')) {
      final p = src.substring('asset:'.length);
      out.add({'path': p, 'base64': null});
    } else if (dataUri != null && dataUri.startsWith('data:')) {
      final i = dataUri.indexOf(',');
      final header = dataUri.substring(5, i);
      final mime = header.split(';').first;
      final b64 = dataUri.substring(i+1);
      final key = dataUri.hashCode.toUnsigned(32).toRadixString(16);
      final path = 'assets/img_' + key + '.' + extFrom(mime);
      out.add({'path': path, 'base64': b64});
      props['src'] = 'asset:' + path;
      n['props'] = props;
    }
  }
  return out;
}

Future<ResponseType> handler(Request req) async {
  final body = await req.readAsString();
  Map<String, dynamic> root = {};
  Map<String, dynamic> snapshot = {'nodes': []};
  Uint8List? seed;
  final assets = <String, Uint8List>{};

  try {
    root = jsonDecode(body) as Map<String, dynamic>;
    snapshot = ((root['snapshot'] ?? root) as Map).cast<String, dynamic>();
    final k = root['signingKeyBase64'] as String?;
    if (k != null) seed = Uint8List.fromList(base64Decode(k));
    final list = (root['assets'] as List?) ?? const [];
    for (final a in list) {
      final p0 = (a['path'] as String);
      final p = p0.startsWith('assets/') ? p0 : 'assets/' + p0;
      final b64 = a['base64'] as String;
      assets[p] = Uint8List.fromList(base64Decode(b64));
    }
  } catch (_) {
    if (body.isNotEmpty) snapshot = jsonDecode(body) as Map<String, dynamic>;
  }

  if (assets.isEmpty) {
    final harvest = _harvest(snapshot);
    for (final a in harvest) {
      final p0 = (a['path'] as String);
      final p = p0.startsWith('assets/') ? p0 : 'assets/' + p0;
      final b64 = a['base64'] as String?;
      if (b64 != null) assets[p] = Uint8List.fromList(base64Decode(b64));
    }
  }

  Uint8List bytes;
  if (seed != null) {
    bytes = await CtrX.encodeSigned(snapshot, assets: assets, meta: {'name':'CreatorX','version':'0.2.0'}, ed25519Seed32: seed);
  } else {
    bytes = CtrX.encode(snapshot, assets: assets, meta: {'name':'CreatorX','version':'0.2.0'});
  }

  return Res.text(String.fromCharCodes(bytes), headers: {
    'content-type': CtrX.mime,
    'content-disposition': 'attachment; filename="project.ctrx"',
    'x-ctrx-signed': seed != null ? '1' : '0',
    'access-control-allow-origin': '*',
    'access-control-allow-methods': 'GET,POST,OPTIONS',
    'access-control-allow-headers': 'Content-Type'
  });
}
""")

write(os.path.join(creatorx_root, "apps/creatorx_site/api/import/ctrx.post.dart"), """
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:typed_data';
import 'package:archive/archive.dart';
import 'package:dartvel_core/dartvel.dart';
import 'package:ctrx_format/ctrx_format.dart';
import '../ctrx_store.dart';

Map<String, dynamic> _rewrite(Map<String, dynamic> snap, String id) {
  final nodes = (snap['nodes'] as List?)?.cast<Map<String, dynamic>>() ?? const [];
  for (final n in nodes) {
    if (n['type'] == 'Image') {
      final props = (n['props'] as Map?)?.cast<String, dynamic>() ?? {};
      final src = props['src'] as String?;
      if (src != null && src.startsWith('asset:')) {
        final path = src.substring('asset:'.length);
        props.remove('dataUri');
        props['src'] = 'ctrx://$id/$path';
        n['props'] = props;
      }
    }
  }
  return {'nodes': nodes};
}

Future<ResponseType> handler(Request req) async {
  final Map<String, dynamic> inb = jsonDecode(await req.readAsString());
  final data = base64Decode(inb['fileBase64'] as String);
  final decoded = CtrX.decode(Uint8List.fromList(data));

  final arc = ZipDecoder().decodeBytes(data);
  final assets = <String, Uint8List>{};
  for (final f in arc) {
    if (f.name.startsWith('assets/')) {
      assets[f.name] = Uint8List.fromList(f.content as List<int>);
    }
  }
  final id = (decoded.manifest['id'] ?? 'unknown') as String;
  if (assets.isNotEmpty) ctrxStore.put(id, assets);

  bool? verified;
  final vk = inb['verifyKeyBase64'] as String?;
  if (vk != null) {
    verified = await CtrX.verifySignature(ctrxBytes: Uint8List.fromList(data), publicKey: Uint8List.fromList(base64Decode(vk)));
  }

  return Res.json(jsonEncode({
    'id': id,
    'manifest': decoded.manifest,
    'assetsStored': assets.length,
    'signatureVerified': verified,
    'snapshot': decoded.snapshot,
    'snapshotRewritten': _rewrite(decoded.snapshot, id)
  }));
}
""")

// GENERATED routes (simplified demo)
import 'package:dartvel_core/dartvel.dart';

import 'dart:io';
import 'package:shelf/shelf_io.dart' as io;
import 'package:shelf/shelf.dart' as shelf;
import 'package:dartvel_core/dartvel.dart';
import 'dartvel_routes.g.dart' as rt;

Future<void> main(List<String> args) async {
  final port = int.tryParse(Platform.environment['PORT'] ?? '') ?? 3000;
  final handler = const shelf.Pipeline()
      .addMiddleware(shelf.logRequests())
      .addHandler(Server.mount(rt.apiRoutes, rt.pageRoutes));

  final server = await io.serve(handler, InternetAddress.anyIPv4, port);
  print('CreatorX SSR listening on http://localhost:${server.port}');
}
""")

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

enum NodeType { container, text, autoLayout, image }

class Node {
  Node({
    required this.id,
    required this.type,
    required this.x,
    required this.y,
    required this.w,
    required this.h,
    this.rotation = 0,
    this.props = const {},
    this.parentId,
  });
  final String id;
  final NodeType type;
  double x, y, w, h;
  double rotation;
  Map<String, dynamic> props;
  String? parentId;
}

Widget renderNode(Node n, List<Node> all) {
  switch (n.type) {
    case NodeType.container:
      final fill = _toColor(n.props['fill']) ?? const Color(0xFF222222);
      final radius = (n.props['borderRadius'] ?? 8).toDouble();
      return ClipRRect(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(radius), child: Container(color: fill));
    case NodeType.text:
      return Center(child: Text(n.props['text'] ?? 'Text', style: TextStyle(fontSize: (n.props['fontSize'] ?? 16).toDouble(), color: _toColor(n.props['textColor']) ?? Colors.white)));
    case NodeType.autoLayout:
      final dir = (n.props['direction'] ?? 'row') == 'row' ? Axis.horizontal : Axis.vertical;
      final spacing = (n.props['spacing'] ?? 8).toDouble();
      final pad = (n.props['padding'] ?? 0).toDouble();
      final children = all.where((m) => m.parentId == n.id).toList();
      return Padding(padding: EdgeInsets.all(pad), child: Flex(direction: dir, children: [
        for (int i=0;i<children.length;i++) ...[
          Expanded(child: renderNode(children[i], all)),
          if (i < children.length-1) SizedBox(width: dir==Axis.horizontal?spacing:0, height: dir==Axis.vertical?spacing:0),
        ]
      ]));
    case NodeType.image:
      final dataUri = n.props['dataUri'] as String?;
      if (dataUri != null && dataUri.startsWith('data:')) return Image.network(dataUri, fit: BoxFit.cover);
      return Container(color: const Color(0xFF333333), child: const Center(child: Text('Image', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white70))));
  }
}

Color? _toColor(dynamic v) {
  if (v is Color) return v;
  if (v is String && v.startsWith('#') && (v.length == 9 || v.length == 7)) {
    final hex = v.length == 7 ? 'FF${v.substring(1)}' : v.substring(1);
    return Color(int.parse(hex, radix: 16));
  }
  return null;
}

String _nodeTypeToString(NodeType t) {
  switch (t) {
    case NodeType.container: return 'Container';
    case NodeType.text: return 'Text';
    case NodeType.autoLayout: return 'AutoLayout';
    case NodeType.image: return 'Image';
  }
}

extension NodeSer on Node {
  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
    'id': id, 'parentId': parentId, 'type': _nodeTypeToString(type),
    'x': x, 'y': y, 'w': w, 'h': h, 'rotation': rotation, 'props': props,
  };
}
""")

write(os.path.join(creatorx_root, "apps/creatorx_studio/lib/state.dart"), """
import 'package:hooks_riverpod/hooks_riverpod.dart';
import 'models.dart';
import 'package:uuid/uuid.dart';

final nodesProvider = StateNotifierProvider<NodesNotifier, List<Node>>((ref) => NodesNotifier());
final selectionProvider = StateProvider<String?>((_) => null);

class NodesNotifier extends StateNotifier<List<Node>> {
  NodesNotifier(): super([]);
  final _uuid = const Uuid();

  void add(NodeType type) {
    if (type == NodeType.autoLayout) { addAutoLayout(); return; }
    state = [...state, Node(id: _uuid.v4(), type: type, x: 80, y: 80, w: type == NodeType.text ? 220 : 200, h: type == NodeType.text ? 60 : 120,
      props: type == NodeType.text ? {'text':'Text','fontSize':18,'textColor':'#FFFFFFFF'} : {'fill':'#FF4F46E5','borderRadius':12})];
  }

  void addAutoLayout() {
    final parentId = _uuid.v4();
    final parent = Node(id: parentId, type: NodeType.autoLayout, x: 60, y: 60, w: 360, h: 140, props: {'direction':'row','spacing':12,'padding':12});
    final c1 = Node(id: _uuid.v4(), type: NodeType.text, x:0, y:0, w:160, h:60, props: {'text':'AutoLayout →','fontSize':18,'textColor':'#FFFFFFFF'}, parentId: parentId);
    final c2 = Node(id: _uuid.v4(), type: NodeType.text, x:0, y:0, w:160, h:60, props: {'text':'Children spaced','fontSize':18,'textColor':'#FFB3E5FC'}, parentId: parentId);
    state = [...state, parent, c1, c2];
  }

  void addImageFromAsset({required String dataUri, required String assetPath}) {
    state = [...state, Node(id: _uuid.v4(), type: NodeType.image, x: 80, y: 80, w: 220, h: 160, props: {'src':'asset:$assetPath','dataUri': dataUri})];
  }

  void move(String id, double dx, double dy) {
    state = [for (final n in state) if (n.id == id) Node(id: n.id, type: n.type, x: n.x+dx, y: n.y+dy, w: n.w, h: n.h, rotation:n.rotation, props:n.props, parentId:n.parentId) else n];
  }
  void resize(String id, {double? w, double? h}) {
    state = [for (final n in state) if (n.id == id) Node(id: n.id, type: n.type, x: n.x, y: n.y, w: w ?? n.w, h: h ?? n.h, rotation:n.rotation, props:n.props, parentId:n.parentId) else n];
  }
  void setProp(String id, String key, dynamic value) {
    state = [for (final n in state) if (n.id == id) Node(id: n.id, type: n.type, x: n.x, y: n.y, w: n.w, h: n.h, rotation:n.rotation, props:{...n.props, key:value}, parentId:n.parentId) else n];
  }
}
""")

write(os.path.join(creatorx_root, "apps/creatorx_studio/lib/main.dart"), """
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:hooks_riverpod/hooks_riverpod.dart';
import 'models.dart';
import 'state.dart';
import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
// ignore: avoid_web_libraries_in_flutter
import 'dart:html' as html;

void main() => runApp(const ProviderScope(child: StudioApp()));

class AssetItem {
  AssetItem({required this.path, required this.base64, required this.dataUri});
  final String path;
  final String base64;
  final String dataUri;
}

final assetsProvider = StateNotifierProvider<AssetsNotifier, List<AssetItem>>((ref) => AssetsNotifier());
class AssetsNotifier extends StateNotifier<List<AssetItem>> {
  AssetsNotifier(): super([]);
  void add(AssetItem a) => state = [...state, a];
  void clear() => state = [];
}

enum RightTab { inspector, assets }
final rightTabProvider = StateProvider<RightTab>((_) => RightTab.inspector);

class StudioApp extends StatelessWidget {
  const StudioApp({super.key});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return MaterialApp(title: 'CreatorX Studio', theme: ThemeData.dark(useMaterial3: true), home: const EditorScreen(), debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false);
  }
}

class EditorScreen extends ConsumerWidget {
  const EditorScreen({super.key});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('CreatorX Studio'), actions: [IconButton(tooltip:'Download .ctrx', icon: const Icon(Icons.download), onPressed: () => _downloadCtrx(context, ref))]),
      body: const Row(children: [SizedBox(width:220, child: Palette()), Expanded(child: CanvasView()), SizedBox(width:320, child: RightPanel())]),
    );
  }
}

class Palette extends ConsumerWidget {
  const Palette({super.key});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final nodes = ref.read(nodesProvider.notifier);
    return Container(color: const Color(0xFF111111), child: ListView(padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12), children: [
      ListTile(title: const Text('Upload Images', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white)), onTap: () { _pickImages(context, ref); ref.read(rightTabProvider.notifier).state = RightTab.assets; }),
      ListTile(title: const Text('Add AutoLayout', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white)), onTap: () => nodes.add(NodeType.autoLayout)),
      ListTile(title: const Text('Add Container', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white)), onTap: () => nodes.add(NodeType.container)),
      ListTile(title: const Text('Add Text', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white)), onTap: () => nodes.add(NodeType.text)),
    ]));
  }
}

class CanvasView extends ConsumerStatefulWidget { const CanvasView({super.key}); @override ConsumerState<CanvasView> createState()=>_CanvasViewState(); }
class _CanvasViewState extends ConsumerState<CanvasView> {
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final nodes = ref.watch(nodesProvider);
    final selected = ref.watch(selectionProvider);
    return Container(color: const Color(0xFF1F1F1F), child: Stack(children: [
      for (final n in nodes.where((n) => n.parentId == null))
        Positioned(left: n.x, top: n.y, width: n.w, height: n.h, child: GestureDetector(
          onTap: () => ref.read(selectionProvider.notifier).state = n.id,
          onPanUpdate: (d) { if (n.parentId == null) ref.read(nodesProvider.notifier).move(n.id, d.delta.dx, d.delta.dy); },
          child: Stack(clipBehavior: Clip.none, children: [
            DecoratedBox(decoration: BoxDecoration(border: selected==n.id ? Border.all(color: Colors.blueAccent, width:1.5) : null), child: renderNode(n, nodes)),
            if (selected==n.id && n.parentId==null) Positioned(right:-10,bottom:-10, child: GestureDetector(onPanUpdate:(d)=>ref.read(nodesProvider.notifier).resize(n.id, w:n.w+d.delta.dx, h:n.h+d.delta.dy), child: const _Handle())),
          ]),
        )),
    ]));
  }
}
class _Handle extends StatelessWidget { const _Handle(); @override Widget build(BuildContext c)=>Container(width:16,height:16,decoration:BoxDecoration(color:Colors.white,border:Border.all(color:Colors.blue,width:2))); }

class RightPanel extends ConsumerWidget {
  const RightPanel({super.key});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final tab = ref.watch(rightTabProvider);
    return Column(children: [
      Container(color: const Color(0xFF0E0E0E), padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8), child: Row(children: [
        _TabButton(label: 'Inspector', active: tab==RightTab.inspector, onTap: ()=>ref.read(rightTabProvider.notifier).state = RightTab.inspector),
        const SizedBox(width: 8),
        _TabButton(label: 'Assets', active: tab==RightTab.assets, onTap: ()=>ref.read(rightTabProvider.notifier).state = RightTab.assets),
      ])),
      Expanded(child: Container(color: const Color(0xFF111111), child: tab==RightTab.inspector ? const InspectorPanel() : const AssetBrowser())),
    ]);
  }
}
class _TabButton extends StatelessWidget {
  const _TabButton({required this.label, required this.active, required this.onTap, super.key});
  final String label; final bool active; final VoidCallback onTap;
  @override Widget build(BuildContext context) => TextButton(onPressed: onTap, child: Text(label, style: TextStyle(color: active? Colors.white : Colors.white70)));
}

class InspectorPanel extends ConsumerWidget {
  const InspectorPanel({super.key});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final sel = ref.watch(selectionProvider);
    final nodes = ref.watch(nodesProvider);
    final node = nodes.where((n)=>n.id==sel).cast<Node?>().firstOrNull;
    if (node==null) return Container(color: const Color(0xFF111111), child: const Center(child: Text('Select a node', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white54))));
    return Container(color: const Color(0xFF111111), padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12), child: ListView(children: [
      Text('Node ${node.id.substring(0,6)}', style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white70)),
      const SizedBox(height: 8),
      if (node.type == NodeType.text) TextField(style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white), decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText:'Text', labelStyle: TextStyle(color: Colors.white70)),
        controller: TextEditingController(text: node.props['text'] ?? '')..selection = TextSelection.collapsed(offset: (node.props['text'] ?? '').toString().length),
        onSubmitted: (v)=>ref.read(nodesProvider.notifier).setProp(node.id,'text',v)),
    ]));
  }
}

class AssetBrowser extends ConsumerWidget {
  const AssetBrowser({super.key});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final assets = ref.watch(assetsProvider);
    return Column(children: [
      Padding(padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8), child: Row(children: [
        const Text('Project Assets', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white70)),
        const Spacer(),
        Text('${assets.length} item(s)', style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white38)),
      ])),
      const Divider(height: 1, color: Colors.white12),
      Expanded(child: ListView.builder(
        itemCount: assets.length,
        itemBuilder: (context, i) {
          final a = assets[i];
          final refs = _findRefs(ref, a.path);
          return ListTile(
            title: Text(a.path, style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white)),
            subtitle: Text('Refs: ${refs.length}', style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white54)),
            trailing: Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: [
              TextButton(onPressed: () => _replaceAsset(context, ref, i), child: const Text('Replace')),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              TextButton(onPressed: () => _renameAsset(context, ref, i), child: const Text('Rename')),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              TextButton(onPressed: () => _showRefs(context, refs), child: const Text('View refs')),
            ]),
          );
        },
      )),
    ]);
  }

  List<String> _findRefs(WidgetRef ref, String path) {
    final nodes = ref.read(nodesProvider);
    final targets = <String>[];
    for (final n in nodes) {
      final src = (n.props['src'] ?? '') as String;
      if (src == 'asset:$path' || src.endsWith('/$path')) targets.add(n.id);
    }
    return targets;
  }
}

Future<void> _replaceAsset(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref, int index) async {
  final assets = ref.read(assetsProvider);
  final item = assets[index];
  final input = html.FileUploadInputElement()..accept='image/*';
  input.click();
  await input.onChange.first;
  if (input.files == null || input.files!.isEmpty) return;
  final file = input.files!.first;
  final reader = html.FileReader(); reader.readAsDataUrl(file); await reader.onLoad.first;
  final dataUri = reader.result as String;
  final comma = dataUri.indexOf(',');
  final base64 = comma >= 0 ? dataUri.substring(comma+1) : '';
  final list = [...assets];
  list[index] = AssetItem(path: item.path, base64: base64, dataUri: dataUri);
  ref.read(assetsProvider.notifier).state = list;
  final nodes = [...ref.read(nodesProvider)];
  for (int i=0;i<nodes.length;i++) {
    final n = nodes[i]; final src = (n.props['src'] ?? '') as String;
    if (src == 'asset:${item.path}' || src.endsWith('/${item.path}')) n.props['dataUri'] = dataUri;
  }
  ref.read(nodesProvider.notifier).state = nodes;
  if (context.mounted) ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(content: Text('Asset replaced')));
}

Future<void> _renameAsset(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref, int index) async {
  final assets = ref.read(assetsProvider);
  final item = assets[index];
  final controller = TextEditingController(text: item.path);
  final newPath = await showDialog<String?>(context: context, builder: (ctx) {
    return AlertDialog(
      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF1E1E1E),
      title: const Text('Rename asset', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white)),
      content: TextField(controller: controller, style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white)),
      actions: [TextButton(onPressed: ()=>Navigator.pop(ctx, null), child: const Text('Cancel')), TextButton(onPressed: ()=>Navigator.pop(ctx, controller.text), child: const Text('Save'))],
    );
  });
  if (newPath == null || newPath.isEmpty || newPath == item.path) return;
  final list = [...assets];
  list[index] = AssetItem(path: newPath, base64: item.base64, dataUri: item.dataUri);
  ref.read(assetsProvider.notifier).state = list;
  final nodes = [...ref.read(nodesProvider)];
  for (int i=0;i<nodes.length;i++) {
    final n = nodes[i]; final src = (n.props['src'] ?? '') as String;
    if (src == 'asset:${item.path}') n.props['src'] = 'asset:$newPath';
    else if (src.endsWith('/${item.path}')) { final prefix = src.substring(0, src.length - item.path.length); n.props['src'] = prefix + newPath; }
  }
  ref.read(nodesProvider.notifier).state = nodes;
  if (context.mounted) ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(content: Text('Asset renamed')));
}

void _showRefs(BuildContext context, List<String> refs) {
  showDialog(context: context, builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
    backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF1E1E1E),
    title: const Text('References', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white)),
    content: SizedBox(width: 380, child: SingleChildScrollView(child: Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
      for (final id in refs) Text('• Node $id', style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white70)),
      if (refs.isEmpty) const Text('No references', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white54)),
    ]))),
    actions: [TextButton(onPressed: ()=>Navigator.pop(ctx), child: const Text('Close'))],
  ));
}

extension FirstOrNull<E> on Iterable<E> { E? get firstOrNull => isEmpty ? null : first; }

Future<void> _pickImages(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) async {
  final input = html.FileUploadInputElement()..accept='image/*'..multiple=true;
  input.click();
  await input.onChange.first;
  if (input.files == null || input.files!.isEmpty) return;
  for (final file in input.files!) {
    final reader = html.FileReader(); reader.readAsDataUrl(file); await reader.onLoad.first;
    final dataUri = reader.result as String;
    final comma = dataUri.indexOf(',');
    final base64 = comma >= 0 ? dataUri.substring(comma+1) : '';
    final assetPath = 'assets/${file.name}';
    ref.read(assetsProvider.notifier).add(AssetItem(path: assetPath, base64: base64, dataUri: dataUri));
    ref.read(nodesProvider.notifier).addImageFromAsset(dataUri: dataUri, assetPath: assetPath);
  }
  if (context.mounted) ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(content: Text('Images added to project')));
}

List<Map<String, String>> collectAssetsFromNodes(List<dynamic> nodes, List<AssetItem> lib) {
  final Map<String, String> libIndex = {for (final a in lib) a.path: a.base64};
  String? _guessExtFromDataUri(String uri) {
    final i = uri.indexOf(';');
    final mime = i > 5 ? uri.substring(5, i) : 'image/bin';
    if (mime == 'image/png') return 'png';
    if (mime == 'image/jpeg') return 'jpg';
    if (mime == 'image/webp') return 'webp';
    if (mime == 'image/gif') return 'gif';
    if (mime == 'image/svg+xml') return 'svg';
    return 'bin';
  }
  String _stripBase64(String uri) {
    final i = uri.indexOf(',');
    return i >= 0 ? uri.substring(i+1) : uri;
  }
  final out = <Map<String, String>>[];
  final seen = <String>{};
  for (final raw in nodes) {
    final n = (raw as Map).cast<String, dynamic>();
    if (n['type'] != 'Image') continue;
    final props = (n['props'] as Map?)?.cast<String, dynamic>() ?? {};
    final src = props['src'] as String?;
    final dataUri = props['dataUri'] as String?;
    if (src != null && src.startsWith('asset:')) {
      final p = src.substring('asset:'.length);
      if (!seen.contains(p)) {
        final b64 = libIndex[p] ?? (dataUri != null ? _stripBase64(dataUri) : '');
        if (b64.isNotEmpty) { out.add({'path': p, 'base64': b64}); seen.add(p); }
      }
      continue;
    }
    if (dataUri != null && dataUri.startsWith('data:')) {
      final ext = _guessExtFromDataUri(dataUri) ?? 'bin';
      final key = dataUri.hashCode.toUnsigned(32).toRadixString(16);
      final path = 'assets/img_%s.%s'.replaceFirst('%s', key).replaceFirst('%s', ext);
      if (!seen.contains(path)) {
        out.add({'path': path, 'base64': _stripBase64(dataUri)});
        props['src'] = 'asset:' + path; n['props'] = props; seen.add(path);
      }
    }
  }
  return out;
}

Future<void> _downloadCtrx(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) async {
  final nodes = ref.read(nodesProvider);
  final nodesJson = nodes.map((n)=>n.toJson()).toList();
  final assets = collectAssetsFromNodes(nodesJson, ref.read(assetsProvider));
  final body = jsonEncode({'snapshot': {'nodes': nodesJson}, 'assets': assets});
  try {
    final res = await http.post(Uri.parse('/api/export/ctrx'), headers: {'content-type':'application/json'}, body: body);
    if (res.statusCode == 200) {
      final blob = html.Blob([res.bodyBytes]);
      final url = html.Url.createObjectUrlFromBlob(blob);
      final a = html.AnchorElement(href: url)..download = 'project.ctrx';
      html.document.body!.append(a); a.click(); a.remove(); html.Url.revokeObjectUrl(url);
      if (context.mounted) ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(content: Text('Downloaded project.ctrx')));
    } else {
      if (context.mounted) ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('Export failed (${res.statusCode})')));
    }
  } catch (e) {
    if (context.mounted) ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('Export error: $e')));
  }
}
""")

import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;

void main() => runApp(const ViewerApp());

class ViewerApp extends StatelessWidget {
  const ViewerApp({super.key});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => MaterialApp(title: 'CreatorX Viewer', theme: ThemeData.dark(useMaterial3: true), home: const ViewerScreen(), debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false);
}

class ViewerScreen extends StatefulWidget { const ViewerScreen({super.key}); @override State<ViewerScreen> createState()=>_ViewerScreenState(); }
class _ViewerScreenState extends State<ViewerScreen> {
  Map<String, dynamic>? snapshot;
  @override void initState(){ super.initState(); _load(); }
  Future<void> _load() async {
    final res = await http.get(Uri.parse('/api/projects/snapshot'));
    if (res.statusCode == 200) setState(()=>snapshot=jsonDecode(res.body));
  }
  @override Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final s = snapshot; if (s==null) return const Scaffold(body: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()));
    final nodes = (s['nodes'] as List).cast<Map<String, dynamic>>();
    return Scaffold(appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('CreatorX Viewer')), body: Stack(children: nodes.where((n)=>n['parentId']==null).map((n)=>_buildNode(n, nodes)).toList()));
  }
  Widget _buildNode(Map<String,dynamic> n, List<Map<String,dynamic>> all) {
    final x=(n['x']??0).toDouble(), y=(n['y']??0).toDouble(), w=(n['w']??100).toDouble(), h=(n['h']??60).toDouble();
    final type = n['type'] as String; final props = (n['props'] as Map?)?.cast<String,dynamic>() ?? {};
    Widget child;
    if (type=='Container') { final color=_color(props['fill'])??const Color(0xFF222222); final r=(props['borderRadius']??8).toDouble(); child=ClipRRect(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(r), child: Container(color: color)); }
    else if (type=='Text') { child=Center(child: Text(props['text']??'', style: TextStyle(fontSize:(props['fontSize']??16).toDouble(), color:_color(props['textColor'])??Colors.white))); }
    else if (type=='AutoLayout') {
      final dir=(props['direction']??'row')=='row'?Axis.horizontal:Axis.vertical; final spacing=(props['spacing']??8).toDouble(); final pad=(props['padding']??0).toDouble();
      final children = all.where((m)=>m['parentId']==n['id']).toList();
      child = Padding(padding: EdgeInsets.all(pad), child: Flex(direction: dir, children: [
        for (int i=0;i<children.length;i++) ...[ Expanded(child: _buildNode(children[i], all)), if (i<children.length-1) SizedBox(width: dir==Axis.horizontal?spacing:0, height: dir==Axis.vertical?spacing:0) ]
      ]));
    } else if (type=='Image') {
      final src = props['src'] as String?;
      Widget img = const SizedBox.shrink();
      if (src != null) {
        if (src.startsWith('ctrx://')) {
          final rest = src.substring(7); final i = rest.indexOf('/');
          if (i>0) { final id = rest.substring(0,i); final path = rest.substring(i+1); final url = Uri(path:'/api/ctrx/asset', queryParameters:{'id':id,'path':path}).toString(); img = Image.network(url, fit: BoxFit.cover); }
        } else if (src.startsWith('data:') || src.startsWith('http')) {
          img = Image.network(src, fit: BoxFit.cover);
        }
      }
      child = ClipRRect(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular((props['radius']??0).toDouble()), child: img);
    } else { child = const SizedBox.shrink(); }
    return Positioned(left:x, top:y, width:w, height:h, child: child);
  }
  Color? _color(dynamic v){ if(v is String && v.startsWith('#')){ final hex = v.length==7? 'FF'+v.substring(1): v.substring(1); return Color(int.parse(hex, radix:16)); } return null; }
}
""")

write(os.path.join(creatorx_root, "FORMAT_SPEC.md"), """
# CreatorX Project Format (.ctrx) — v1.1
- `mimetype`: `application/creator_X_project`
- `snapshot.json` (canonical) + `snapshot.cbor` (CBOR mirror; prefer CBOR)
- `assets/*` (binary assets bundled)
- `manifest.json` (id, version, tool, asset table, optional signature block)
- `integrity.sha256` (sha256 lines)
- optional: `signature.sig` (COSE_Sign1, detached Ed25519 over snapshot.json) + `signature.pubkey`
""")

library dartvel_core;

import 'package:shelf/shelf.dart' as shelf;
import 'package:shelf_router/shelf_router.dart' as router;
export 'package:shelf/shelf.dart' show Pipeline;

typedef Request = shelf.Request;
typedef ResponseType = shelf.Response;
typedef Handler = Future<ResponseType> Function(Request req);

class Res {
  static ResponseType json(String body, {Map<String, String>? headers}) =>
      shelf.Response(200, body: body, headers: {
        'content-type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8',
        if (headers != null) ...headers,
      });

  static ResponseType html(String body, {Map<String, String>? headers}) =>
      shelf.Response(200, body: body, headers: {
        'content-type': 'text/html; charset=utf-8',
        if (headers != null) ...headers,
      });

  static ResponseType text(String body, {int status = 200, Map<String, String>? headers}) =>
      shelf.Response(status, body: body, headers: {
        'content-type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8',
        if (headers != null) ...headers,
      });

  static ResponseType notFound([String body = 'Not Found']) =>
      shelf.Response.notFound(body);
}

class Server {
  static shelf.Handler mount(Map<String, Handler> apiRoutes, Map<String, Handler> pageRoutes) {
    final r = router.Router();

    apiRoutes.forEach((path, handler) {
      r.add('GET', path, (shelf.Request req) => handler(req));
      r.add('POST', path, (shelf.Request req) => handler(req));
      r.add('OPTIONS', path, (shelf.Request req) => handler(req));
      r.add('DELETE', path, (shelf.Request req) => handler(req));
      r.add('PATCH', path, (shelf.Request req) => handler(req));
    });

    pageRoutes.forEach((path, handler) {
      r.add('GET', path, (shelf.Request req) => handler(req));
    });

    return r;
  }
}
""")

    img = Image.new("RGB", size, (22,22,22))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    W, H = size
    d.rectangle([(0,0),(W,64)], fill=(17,17,17))
    d.text((24,18), title, fill=(255,255,255))
    for (x,y,w,h), label, color in elements:
        d.rectangle([(x,y),(x+w,y+h)], outline=color, width=3)
        d.text((x+12,y+12), label, fill=color)
    img.save(outfile)
