library dartvel_core;

import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:shelf/shelf.dart' as shelf;
import 'package:shelf_router/shelf_router.dart' as router;
export 'package:shelf/shelf.dart' show Pipeline;

typedef Request = shelf.Request;
typedef ResponseType = shelf.Response;
typedef Handler = Future<ResponseType> Function(Request req);

class Res {
  static ResponseType json(String body, {Map<String, String>? headers, int status = 200}) =>
      shelf.Response(status, body: body, headers: {
        'content-type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8',
        if (headers != null) ...headers,
      });

  static ResponseType html(String body, {Map<String, String>? headers, int status = 200}) =>
      shelf.Response(status, body: body, headers: {
        'content-type': 'text/html; charset=utf-8',
        if (headers != null) ...headers,
      });

  static ResponseType text(String body, {Map<String, String>? headers, int status = 200}) =>
      shelf.Response(status, body: body, headers: {
        'content-type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8',
        if (headers != null) ...headers,
      });

  static ResponseType bytes(List<int> bytes, {Map<String, String>? headers, int status = 200}) =>
      shelf.Response(status, body: bytes, headers: {
        if (headers != null) ...headers,
      });

  static ResponseType notFound([String body = 'Not Found']) =>
      shelf.Response.notFound(body);
}

class Server {
  static shelf.Handler mount(Map<String, Handler> apiRoutes, Map<String, Handler> pageRoutes) {
    final r = router.Router();

    // Allow OPTIONS to pass CORS
    r.add('OPTIONS', <String>['<ignored>'], (shelf.Request req) {
      return shelf.Response.ok('', headers: {
        'access-control-allow-origin': req.headers['origin'] ?? '*',
        'access-control-allow-methods': 'GET,POST,OPTIONS,PUT,PATCH,DELETE',
        'access-control-allow-headers': 'Content-Type,Authorization',
      });
    });

    apiRoutes.forEach((path, handler) {
      r.add('GET', path, (shelf.Request req) => handler(req));
      r.add('POST', path, (shelf.Request req) => handler(req));
      r.add('PUT', path, (shelf.Request req) => handler(req));
      r.add('PATCH', path, (shelf.Request req) => handler(req));
      r.add('DELETE', path, (shelf.Request req) => handler(req));
      r.add('OPTIONS', path, (shelf.Request req) => shelf.Response.ok('', headers: {
        'access-control-allow-origin': req.headers['origin'] ?? '*',
        'access-control-allow-methods': 'GET,POST,OPTIONS,PUT,PATCH,DELETE',
        'access-control-allow-headers': 'Content-Type,Authorization',
      }));
    });

    pageRoutes.forEach((path, handler) {
      r.add('GET', path, (shelf.Request req) => handler(req));
    });

    return r;
  }
}
""")

# CreatorX (Studio + Viewer + SSR)

- **Stack**: Flutter (Studio & Viewer), Dart server (shelf) for SSR/API.
- **Format**: `.ctrx` (ZIP-based: `snapshot.json` + `snapshot.cbor` + `assets/*` + `manifest.json` + optional `signature.*`).  
  MIME: `application/creator_X_project`

## Run
/work
├─ dartvel_full/
└─ creator_x_full/

Always show details


### Server
```bash
cd creator_x_full
dart pub get
dart run .dart_tool/dartvel_server.dart
# -> http://localhost:3000
Studio (Flutter web)
Always show details

cd creator_x_full/apps/creatorx_studio
flutter pub get
flutter create .   # generates web scaffolding if needed
flutter run -d chrome
Viewer (Flutter web)
Always show details

cd creator_x_full/apps/creatorx_viewer
flutter pub get
flutter create .   # generates web scaffolding if needed
flutter run -d chrome
Flow
Studio: Upload images, design → Download .ctrx (assets auto-bundled).

Import: Base64 the file and POST /api/import/ctrx → registers assets in memory and rewrites Image.src to ctrx://<id>/assets/....

Viewer: Loads snapshot and resolves images via /api/ctrx/asset?id=<id>&path=....
""")

w(os.path.join(creatorx, "packages/ctrx_format/lib/ctrx_format.dart"), """
library ctrx_format;

import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:typed_data';
import 'package:archive/archive.dart';
import 'package:crypto/crypto.dart';
import 'package:cryptography/cryptography.dart' as cg;
import 'package:cbor/cbor.dart' as cbor;
import 'package:uuid/uuid.dart';

class CtrX {
static const String mime = 'application/creator_X_project';
static const String ext = '.ctrx';
static const String version = '1.1';

static Uint8List encode(
Map<String, dynamic> snapshot, {
Map<String, Uint8List>? assets,
Map<String, dynamic>? meta,
}) {
final archive = Archive();

Always show details

// 0) Explicit mimetype file (no compression)
final mimeBytes = Uint8List.fromList(utf8.encode(mime));
final mimeFile = ArchiveFile('mimetype', mimeBytes.length, mimeBytes)..compress = false;
archive.addFile(mimeFile);

// 1) JSON snapshot (canonical)
final jsonBytes = Uint8List.fromList(utf8.encode(jsonEncode(snapshot)));
archive.addFile(ArchiveFile('snapshot.json', jsonBytes.length, jsonBytes));

// 2) CBOR snapshot (space-efficient, preferred at runtime)
final enc = cbor.CborEncoder()..encode(snapshot);
final cborBytes = Uint8List.fromList(enc.output.getData());
archive.addFile(ArchiveFile('snapshot.cbor', cborBytes.length, cborBytes));

// 3) Assets
final assetsList = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
assets?.forEach((p, bytes) {
  final path = p.startsWith('assets/') ? p : 'assets/$p';
  archive.addFile(ArchiveFile(path, bytes.length, bytes));
  assetsList.add({'path': path, 'size': bytes.length, 'sha256': sha256.convert(bytes).toString()});
});

// 4) Integrity
final lines = <String>['snapshot.json  ${sha256.convert(jsonBytes)}'];
for (final a in assetsList) { lines.add('${a['path']}  ${a['sha256']}'); }
final integ = Uint8List.fromList(utf8.encode(lines.join('\\n')));
archive.addFile(ArchiveFile('integrity.sha256', integ.length, integ));

// 5) Manifest
final manifest = {
  'format': 'ctrx',
  'version': version,
  'id': const Uuid().v4(),
  'createdAt': DateTime.now().toUtc().toIso8601String(),
  'tool': meta ?? {'name': 'CreatorX', 'version': '1.0.0'},
  'snapshot': {'sha256': sha256.convert(jsonBytes).toString(), 'bytes': jsonBytes.length, 'cborBytes': cborBytes.length},
  'assets': assetsList,
  'signature': null,
};
final manBytes = Uint8List.fromList(utf8.encode(jsonEncode(manifest)));
archive.addFile(ArchiveFile('manifest.json', manBytes.length, manBytes));

return Uint8List.fromList(ZipEncoder().encode(archive)!);
}

static Future<Uint8List> encodeSigned(
Map<String, dynamic> snapshot, {
Map<String, Uint8List>? assets,
Map<String, dynamic>? meta,
required Uint8List ed25519Seed32,
}) async {
final base = encode(snapshot, assets: assets, meta: meta);
final arc = ZipDecoder().decodeBytes(base);
final snapFile = arc.firstWhere((f) => f.name == 'snapshot.json');
final payload = Uint8List.fromList(snapFile.content as List<int>);

Always show details

final cose = await _coseSignDetached(payload, mime, ed25519Seed32);
arc.addFile(ArchiveFile('signature.sig', cose.bytes.length, cose.bytes));
arc.addFile(ArchiveFile('signature.pubkey', cose.publicKey.length, cose.publicKey));

final mIdx = arc.files.indexWhere((f) => f.name == 'manifest.json');
final manifest = jsonDecode(utf8.decode(arc.files[mIdx].content as List<int>)) as Map<String, dynamic>;
manifest['signature'] = {
  'alg': 'EdDSA',
  'protected': {'alg': -8, 'content-type': mime},
  'detached': true,
  'file': 'signature.sig',
  'publicKeyB64': base64Encode(cose.publicKey),
};
final manBytes = Uint8List.fromList(utf8.encode(jsonEncode(manifest)));
arc.files[mIdx] = ArchiveFile('manifest.json', manBytes.length, manBytes);
return Uint8List.fromList(ZipEncoder().encode(arc)!);
}

static ({Map<String, dynamic> snapshot, Map<String, dynamic> manifest}) decode(Uint8List bytes) {
final arc = ZipDecoder().decodeBytes(bytes);
ArchiveFile? cborFile, jsonFile, manFile;
for (final f in arc) {
if (f.name == 'snapshot.cbor') cborFile = f;
if (f.name == 'snapshot.json') jsonFile = f;
if (f.name == 'manifest.json') manFile = f;
}
if (manFile == null || (cborFile == null && jsonFile == null)) {
throw StateError('Invalid CTRX');
}
Map<String, dynamic> snapshot;
if (cborFile != null) {
final dec = cbor.CborDecoder(cborFile.content as List<int>);
snapshot = Map<String, dynamic>.from(dec.decode() as Map);
} else {
snapshot = jsonDecode(utf8.decode(jsonFile!.content as List<int>)) as Map<String, dynamic>;
}
final manifest = jsonDecode(utf8.decode(manFile.content as List<int>)) as Map<String, dynamic>;
return (snapshot: snapshot, manifest: manifest);
}

static Future<bool> verifySignature({required Uint8List ctrxBytes, required Uint8List publicKey}) async {
final arc = ZipDecoder().decodeBytes(ctrxBytes);
ArchiveFile? sigFile, snapFile;
for (final f in arc) {
if (f.name == 'signature.sig') sigFile = f;
if (f.name == 'snapshot.json') snapFile = f;
}
if (sigFile == null || snapFile == null) return false;
return _coseVerifyDetached(Uint8List.fromList(sigFile.content as List<int>), Uint8List.fromList(snapFile.content as List<int>), mime, publicKey);
}
}

class _CoseSig {
_CoseSig(this.bytes, this.publicKey);
final Uint8List bytes;
final Uint8List publicKey;
}

Future<_CoseSig> _coseSignDetached(Uint8List payload, String contentType, Uint8List seed32) async {
if (seed32.length != 32) throw StateError('ed25519 seed must be 32 bytes');
const algEdDSA = -8; // COSE alg for Ed25519

// Protected header (CBOR-encoded map)
final protected = () {
final enc = cbor.CborEncoder()..encode({'alg': algEdDSA, 'content-type': contentType});
return Uint8List.fromList(enc.output.getData());
}();

// Sig_structure per COSE_Sign1
final sigStructBytes = () {
final enc = cbor.CborEncoder()..encode(['Signature1', protected, Uint8List(0), payload]);
return Uint8List.fromList(enc.output.getData());
}();

final algo = cg.Ed25519();
final kp = await algo.newKeyPairFromSeed(seed32);
final signature = await algo.sign(sigStructBytes, keyPair: kp);
final pub = await kp.extractPublicKey();

final sign1 = [protected, <String, dynamic>{}, null, Uint8List.fromList(signature.bytes)];
final enc = cbor.CborEncoder()..encode(sign1);
return _CoseSig(Uint8List.fromList(enc.output.getData()), Uint8List.fromList(pub.bytes));
}

Future<bool> _coseVerifyDetached(Uint8List sign1, Uint8List payload, String contentType, Uint8List publicKey) async {
final dec = cbor.CborDecoder(sign1);
final obj = dec.decode();
if (obj is! List || obj.length != 4) return false;
final protected = obj[0];
final signature = obj[3];
if (protected is! Uint8List || signature is! Uint8List) return false;

final map = cbor.CborDecoder(protected).decode() as Map;
if (map['alg'] != -8) return false;
if (map['content-type'] != null && map['content-type'] != contentType) return false;

final sigStructBytes = () {
final enc = cbor.CborEncoder()..encode(['Signature1', protected, Uint8List(0), payload]);
return Uint8List.fromList(enc.output.getData());
}();
final algo = cg.Ed25519();
final pub = cg.SimplePublicKey(publicKey, type: cg.KeyPairType.ed25519);
try {
return await algo.verify(sigStructBytes, signature: cg.Signature(signature, publicKey: pub));
} catch (_) {
return false;
}
}
""")

w(os.path.join(creatorx, "apps/creatorx_site/api/ctrx_store.dart"), """
import 'dart:collection';
import 'dart:typed_data';

class CtrxStore {
final _assets = HashMap<String, Map<String, Uint8List>>();
void put(String id, Map<String, Uint8List> assets) => _assets[id] = assets;
Uint8List? get(String id, String path) => _assets[id]?[path];
}
final ctrxStore = CtrxStore();
""")

w(os.path.join(creatorx, "apps/creatorx_site/api/ctrx/asset.get.dart"), """
import 'package:dartvel_core/dartvel.dart';
import '../ctrx_store.dart';

String _ct(String p) {
p = p.toLowerCase();
if (p.endsWith('.png')) return 'image/png';
if (p.endsWith('.jpg') || p.endsWith('.jpeg')) return 'image/jpeg';
if (p.endsWith('.webp')) return 'image/webp';
if (p.endsWith('.gif')) return 'image/gif';
if (p.endsWith('.svg')) return 'image/svg+xml';
return 'application/octet-stream';
}

Future<ResponseType> handler(Request req) async {
final id = req.url.queryParameters['id'];
final path = req.url.queryParameters['path'];
if (id == null || path == null) return Res.text('id & path required', status: 400);
final bytes = ctrxStore.get(id, path);
if (bytes == null) return Res.text('not found', status: 404);
return Res.bytes(bytes, headers: {
'content-type': _ct(path),
'cache-control': 'public, max-age=31536000, immutable',
'access-control-allow-origin': '*',
'access-control-allow-methods': 'GET,POST,OPTIONS',
'access-control-allow-headers': 'Content-Type'
});
}
""")

w(os.path.join(creatorx, "apps/creatorx_site/api/export/ctrx.post.dart"), """
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:typed_data';
import 'package:dartvel_core/dartvel.dart';
import 'package:ctrx_format/ctrx_format.dart';

List<Map<String, dynamic>> harvest(Map<String, dynamic> snap) {
final out = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
final nodes = (snap['nodes'] as List?)?.cast<Map<String, dynamic>>() ?? const [];
String extFrom(String mime) {
switch (mime) {
case 'image/png': return 'png';
case 'image/jpeg': return 'jpg';
case 'image/webp': return 'webp';
case 'image/gif': return 'gif';
case 'image/svg+xml': return 'svg';
default: return 'bin';
}
}
for (final n in nodes) {
if (n['type'] != 'Image') continue;
final props = (n['props'] as Map?)?.cast<String, dynamic>() ?? {};
final src = props['src'] as String?;
final dataUri = props['dataUri'] as String?;
if (src != null && src.startsWith('asset:')) {
final p = src.substring('asset:'.length);
out.add({'path': p, 'base64': null});
} else if (dataUri != null && dataUri.startsWith('data:')) {
final i = dataUri.indexOf(',');
final header = dataUri.substring(5, i);
final mime = header.split(';').first;
final b64 = dataUri.substring(i+1);
final key = dataUri.hashCode.toUnsigned(32).toRadixString(16);
final path = 'assets/img' + key + '.' + extFrom(mime);
out.add({'path': path, 'base64': b64});
props['src'] = 'asset:' + path;
n['props'] = props;
}
}
return out;
}

Future<ResponseType> handler(Request req) async {
final body = await req.readAsString();
Map<String, dynamic> root = {};
Map<String, dynamic> snapshot = {'nodes': []};
Uint8List? seed;
final assets = <String, Uint8List>{};

try {
root = jsonDecode(body) as Map<String, dynamic>;
snapshot = ((root['snapshot'] ?? root) as Map).cast<String, dynamic>();
final k = root['signingKeyBase64'] as String?;
if (k != null) seed = Uint8List.fromList(base64Decode(k));
final list = (root['assets'] as List?) ?? const [];
for (final a in list) {
final p0 = (a['path'] as String);
final p = p0.startsWith('assets/') ? p0 : 'assets/' + p0;
final b64 = a['base64'] as String?;
if (b64 != null) {
assets[p] = Uint8List.fromList(base64Decode(b64));
}
}
} catch (_) {
if (body.isNotEmpty) snapshot = jsonDecode(body) as Map<String, dynamic>;
}

if (assets.isEmpty) {
final harvest = _harvest(snapshot);
for (final a in harvest) {
final p0 = (a['path'] as String);
final p = p0.startsWith('assets/') ? p0 : 'assets/' + p0;
final b64 = a['base64'] as String?;
if (b64 != null) assets[p] = Uint8List.fromList(base64Decode(b64));
}
}

Uint8List bytes;
if (seed != null) {
bytes = await CtrX.encodeSigned(snapshot, assets: assets, meta: {'name':'CreatorX','version':'1.0.0'}, ed25519Seed32: seed);
} else {
bytes = CtrX.encode(snapshot, assets: assets, meta: {'name':'CreatorX','version':'1.0.0'});
}

return Res.bytes(bytes, headers: {
'content-type': CtrX.mime,
'content-disposition': 'attachment; filename="project.ctrx"',
'x-ctrx-signed': seed != null ? '1' : '0',
'access-control-allow-origin': '*',
'access-control-allow-methods': 'GET,POST,OPTIONS',
'access-control-allow-headers': 'Content-Type'
});
}
""")

w(os.path.join(creatorx, "apps/creatorx_site/api/import/ctrx.post.dart"), """
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:typed_data';
import 'package:archive/archive.dart';
import 'package:dartvel_core/dartvel.dart';
import 'package:ctrx_format/ctrx_format.dart';
import '../ctrx_store.dart';

Map<String, dynamic> _rewrite(Map<String, dynamic> snap, String id) {
final nodes = (snap['nodes'] as List?)?.cast<Map<String, dynamic>>() ?? const [];
for (final n in nodes) {
if (n['type'] == 'Image') {
final props = (n['props'] as Map?)?.cast<String, dynamic>() ?? {};
final src = props['src'] as String?;
if (src != null && src.startsWith('asset:')) {
final path = src.substring('asset:'.length);
props.remove('dataUri');
props['src'] = 'ctrx://$id/$path';
n['props'] = props;
}
}
}
return {'nodes': nodes};
}

Future<ResponseType> handler(Request req) async {
final Map<String, dynamic> inb = jsonDecode(await req.readAsString());
final data = base64Decode(inb['fileBase64'] as String);
final decoded = CtrX.decode(Uint8List.fromList(data));

final arc = ZipDecoder().decodeBytes(data);
final assets = <String, Uint8List>{};
for (final f in arc) {
if (f.name.startsWith('assets/')) {
assets[f.name] = Uint8List.fromList(f.content as List<int>);
}
}
final id = (decoded.manifest['id'] ?? 'unknown') as String;
if (assets.isNotEmpty) ctrxStore.put(id, assets);

bool? verified;
final vk = inb['verifyKeyBase64'] as String?;
if (vk != null) {
verified = await CtrX.verifySignature(ctrxBytes: Uint8List.fromList(data), publicKey: Uint8List.fromList(base64Decode(vk)));
}

return Res.json(jsonEncode({
'id': id,
'manifest': decoded.manifest,
'assetsStored': assets.length,
'signatureVerified': verified,
'snapshot': decoded.snapshot,
'snapshotRewritten': _rewrite(decoded.snapshot, id)
}), headers: {'access-control-allow-origin':'*'});
}
""")

import 'dart:io';
import 'package:shelf/shelf_io.dart' as io;
import 'package:shelf/shelf.dart' as shelf;
import 'package:dartvel_core/dartvel.dart';
import 'dartvel_routes.g.dart' as rt;

Future<void> main(List<String> args) async {
final port = int.tryParse(Platform.environment['PORT'] ?? '') ?? 3000;
final handler = const shelf.Pipeline()
.addMiddleware(shelf.logRequests())
.addHandler(Server.mount(rt.apiRoutes, rt.pageRoutes));

final server = await io.serve(handler, InternetAddress.anyIPv4, port);
print('CreatorX SSR listening on http://localhost:${server.port}');
}
""")

w(os.path.join(creatorx, "apps/creatorx_studio/lib/models.dart"), """
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

enum NodeType { container, text, autoLayout, image }

class Node {
Node({
required this.id,
required this.type,
required this.x,
required this.y,
required this.w,
required this.h,
this.rotation = 0,
this.props = const {},
this.parentId,
});
final String id;
final NodeType type;
double x, y, w, h;
double rotation;
Map<String, dynamic> props;
String? parentId;
}

Widget renderNode(Node n, List<Node> all) {
switch (n.type) {
case NodeType.container:
final fill = _toColor(n.props['fill']) ?? const Color(0xFF222222);
final radius = (n.props['borderRadius'] ?? 8).toDouble();
return ClipRRect(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(radius), child: Container(color: fill));
case NodeType.text:
return Center(child: Text(n.props['text'] ?? 'Text', style: TextStyle(fontSize: (n.props['fontSize'] ?? 16).toDouble(), color: _toColor(n.props['textColor']) ?? Colors.white)));
case NodeType.autoLayout:
final dir = (n.props['direction'] ?? 'row') == 'row' ? Axis.horizontal : Axis.vertical;
final spacing = (n.props['spacing'] ?? 8).toDouble();
final pad = (n.props['padding'] ?? 0).toDouble();
final children = all.where((m) => m.parentId == n.id).toList();
return Padding(padding: EdgeInsets.all(pad), child: Flex(direction: dir, children: [
for (int i=0;i<children.length;i++) ...[
Expanded(child: renderNode(children[i], all)),
if (i < children.length-1) SizedBox(width: dir==Axis.horizontal?spacing:0, height: dir==Axis.vertical?spacing:0),
]
]));
case NodeType.image:
final dataUri = n.props['dataUri'] as String?;
if (dataUri != null && dataUri.startsWith('data:')) return Image.network(dataUri, fit: BoxFit.cover);
return Container(color: const Color(0xFF333333), child: const Center(child: Text('Image', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white70))));
}
}

Color? _toColor(dynamic v) {
if (v is Color) return v;
if (v is String && v.startsWith('#') && (v.length == 9 || v.length == 7)) {
final hex = v.length == 7 ? 'FF${v.substring(1)}' : v.substring(1);
return Color(int.parse(hex, radix: 16));
}
return null;
}

String _nodeTypeToString(NodeType t) {
switch (t) {
case NodeType.container: return 'Container';
case NodeType.text: return 'Text';
case NodeType.autoLayout: return 'AutoLayout';
case NodeType.image: return 'Image';
}
}

extension NodeSer on Node {
Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
'id': id, 'parentId': parentId, 'type': _nodeTypeToString(type),
'x': x, 'y': y, 'w': w, 'h': h, 'rotation': rotation, 'props': props,
};
}
""")

import 'package:hooks_riverpod/hooks_riverpod.dart';
import 'models.dart';
import 'package:uuid/uuid.dart';

final nodesProvider = StateNotifierProvider<NodesNotifier, List<Node>>((ref) => NodesNotifier());
final selectionProvider = StateProvider<String?>((_) => null);

class NodesNotifier extends StateNotifier<List<Node>> {
NodesNotifier(): super([]);
final _uuid = const Uuid();

void add(NodeType type) {
if (type == NodeType.autoLayout) { addAutoLayout(); return; }
state = [...state, Node(id: _uuid.v4(), type: type, x: 80, y: 80, w: type == NodeType.text ? 220 : 200, h: type == NodeType.text ? 60 : 120,
props: type == NodeType.text ? {'text':'Text','fontSize':18,'textColor':'#FFFFFFFF'} : {'fill':'#FF4F46E5','borderRadius':12})];
}

void addAutoLayout() {
final parentId = _uuid.v4();
final parent = Node(id: parentId, type: NodeType.autoLayout, x: 60, y: 60, w: 360, h: 140, props: {'direction':'row','spacing':12,'padding':12});
final c1 = Node(id: _uuid.v4(), type: NodeType.text, x:0, y:0, w:160, h:60, props: {'text':'AutoLayout →','fontSize':18,'textColor':'#FFFFFFFF'}, parentId: parentId);
final c2 = Node(id: _uuid.v4(), type: NodeType.text, x:0, y:0, w:160, h:60, props: {'text':'Children spaced','fontSize':18,'textColor':'#FFB3E5FC'}, parentId: parentId);
state = [...state, parent, c1, c2];
}

void addImageFromAsset({required String dataUri, required String assetPath}) {
state = [...state, Node(id: _uuid.v4(), type: NodeType.image, x: 80, y: 80, w: 220, h: 160, props: {'src':'asset:$assetPath','dataUri': dataUri})];
}

void move(String id, double dx, double dy) {
state = [for (final n in state) if (n.id == id) Node(id: n.id, type: n.type, x: n.x+dx, y: n.y+dy, w: n.w, h: n.h, rotation:n.rotation, props:n.props, parentId:n.parentId) else n];
}
void resize(String id, {double? w, double? h}) {
state = [for (final n in state) if (n.id == id) Node(id: n.id, type: n.type, x: n.x, y: n.y, w: w ?? n.w, h: h ?? n.h, rotation:n.rotation, props:n.props, parentId:n.parentId) else n];
}
void setProp(String id, String key, dynamic value) {
state = [for (final n in state) if (n.id == id) Node(id: n.id, type: n.type, x: n.x, y: n.y, w: n.w, h: n.h, rotation:n.rotation, props:{...n.props, key:value}, parentId:n.parentId) else n];
}
}
""")

void clear() => state = [];

class CanvasView extends ConsumerStatefulWidget { const CanvasView({super.key}); @override ConsumerState<CanvasView> createState()=>_CanvasViewState(); }
class _CanvasViewState extends ConsumerState<CanvasView> {

return Container(color: const Color(0xFF1F1F1F), child: Stack(children: [

child: Stack(clipBehavior: Clip.none, children: [
DecoratedBox(decoration: BoxDecoration(border: selected==n.id ? Border.all(color: Colors.blueAccent, width:1.5) : null), child: renderNode(n, nodes)),
if (selected==n.id && n.parentId==null) Positioned(right:-10,bottom:-10, child: GestureDetector(onPanUpdate:(d)=>ref.read(nodesProvider.notifier).resize(n.id, w:n.w+d.delta.dx, h:n.h+d.delta.dy), child: const _Handle())),

List<String> _findRefs(WidgetRef ref, String path) {
final nodes = ref.read(nodesProvider);
final targets = <String>[];
for (final n in nodes) {
final src = (n.props['src'] ?? '') as String;
if (src == 'asset:$path' || src.endsWith('/$path')) targets.add(n.id);
}
return targets;
}
}

Future<void> _replaceAsset(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref, int index) async {
final assets = ref.read(assetsProvider);
final item = assets[index];
final input = html.FileUploadInputElement()..accept='image/*';
input.click();
await input.onChange.first;
if (input.files == null || input.files!.isEmpty) return;
final file = input.files!.first;
final reader = html.FileReader(); reader.readAsDataUrl(file); await reader.onLoad.first;
final dataUri = reader.result as String;
final comma = dataUri.indexOf(',');
final base64 = comma >= 0 ? dataUri.substring(comma+1) : '';
final list = [...assets];
list[index] = AssetItem(path: item.path, base64: base64, dataUri: dataUri);
ref.read(assetsProvider.notifier).state = list;
final nodes = [...ref.read(nodesProvider)];
for (int i=0;i<nodes.length;i++) {
final n = nodes[i]; final src = (n.props['src'] ?? '') as String;
if (src == 'asset:${item.path}' || src.endsWith('/${item.path}')) n.props['dataUri'] = dataUri;
}
ref.read(nodesProvider.notifier).state = nodes;
if (context.mounted) ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(content: Text('Asset replaced')));
}

Future<void> _renameAsset(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref, int index) async {
final assets = ref.read(assetsProvider);
final item = assets[index];
final controller = TextEditingController(text: item.path);
final newPath = await showDialog<String?>(context: context, builder: (ctx) {
return AlertDialog(
backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF1E1E1E),
title: const Text('Rename asset', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white)),
content: TextField(controller: controller, style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white)),
actions: [TextButton(onPressed: ()=>Navigator.pop(ctx, null), child: const Text('Cancel')), TextButton(onPressed: ()=>Navigator.pop(ctx, controller.text), child: const Text('Save'))],
);
});
if (newPath == null || newPath.isEmpty || newPath == item.path) return;
final list = [...assets];
list[index] = AssetItem(path: newPath, base64: item.base64, dataUri: item.dataUri);
ref.read(assetsProvider.notifier).state = list;
final nodes = [...ref.read(nodesProvider)];
for (int i=0;i<nodes.length;i++) {
final n = nodes[i]; final src = (n.props['src'] ?? '') as String;
if (src == 'asset:${item.path}') n.props['src'] = 'asset:$newPath';
else if (src.endsWith('/${item.path}')) { final prefix = src.substring(0, src.length - item.path.length); n.props['src'] = prefix + newPath; }
}
ref.read(nodesProvider.notifier).state = nodes;
if (context.mounted) ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(content: Text('Asset renamed')));
}

void _showRefs(BuildContext context, List<String> refs) {
showDialog(context: context, builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF1E1E1E),
title: const Text('References', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white)),
content: SizedBox(width: 380, child: SingleChildScrollView(child: Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
for (final id in refs) Text('• Node $id', style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white70)),
if (refs.isEmpty) const Text('No references', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white54)),
]))),
actions: [TextButton(onPressed: ()=>Navigator.pop(ctx), child: const Text('Close'))],
));
}

extension FirstOrNull<E> on Iterable<E> { E? get firstOrNull => isEmpty ? null : first; }

Future<void> _pickImages(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) async {
final input = html.FileUploadInputElement()..accept='image/*'..multiple=true;
input.click();
await input.onChange.first;
if (input.files == null || input.files!.isEmpty) return;
for (final file in input.files!) {
final reader = html.FileReader(); reader.readAsDataUrl(file); await reader.onLoad.first;
final dataUri = reader.result as String;
final comma = dataUri.indexOf(',');
final base64 = comma >= 0 ? dataUri.substring(comma+1) : '';
final assetPath = 'assets/${file.name}';
ref.read(assetsProvider.notifier).add(AssetItem(path: assetPath, base64: base64, dataUri: dataUri));
ref.read(nodesProvider.notifier).addImageFromAsset(dataUri: dataUri, assetPath: assetPath);
}
if (context.mounted) ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(content: Text('Images added to project')));
}

List<Map<String, String>> collectAssetsFromNodes(List<dynamic> nodes, List<AssetItem> lib) {
final Map<String, String> libIndex = {for (final a in lib) a.path: a.base64};
String? _guessExtFromDataUri(String uri) {
final i = uri.indexOf(';');
final mime = i > 5 ? uri.substring(5, i) : 'image/bin';
if (mime == 'image/png') return 'png';
if (mime == 'image/jpeg') return 'jpg';
if (mime == 'image/webp') return 'webp';
if (mime == 'image/gif') return 'gif';
if (mime == 'image/svg+xml') return 'svg';
return 'bin';
}
String _stripBase64(String uri) {
final i = uri.indexOf(',');
return i >= 0 ? uri.substring(i+1) : uri;
}
final out = <Map<String, String>>[];
final seen = <String>{};
for (final raw in nodes) {
final n = (raw as Map).cast<String, dynamic>();
if (n['type'] != 'Image') continue;
final props = (n['props'] as Map?)?.cast<String, dynamic>() ?? {};
final src = props['src'] as String?;
final dataUri = props['dataUri'] as String?;
if (src != null && src.startsWith('asset:')) {
final p = src.substring('asset:'.length);
if (!seen.contains(p)) {
final b64 = libIndex[p] ?? (dataUri != null ? _stripBase64(dataUri) : '');
if (b64.isNotEmpty) { out.add({'path': p, 'base64': b64}); seen.add(p); }
}
continue;
}
if (dataUri != null && dataUri.startsWith('data:')) {
final ext = guessExtFromDataUri(dataUri) ?? 'bin';
final key = dataUri.hashCode.toUnsigned(32).toRadixString(16);
final path = 'assets/img%s.%s'.replaceFirst('%s', key).replaceFirst('%s', ext);
if (!seen.contains(path)) {
out.add({'path': path, 'base64': _stripBase64(dataUri)});
props['src'] = 'asset:' + path; n['props'] = props; seen.add(path);
}
}
}
return out;
}

Future<void> _downloadCtrx(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) async {
final nodes = ref.read(nodesProvider);
final nodesJson = nodes.map((n)=>n.toJson()).toList();
final assets = collectAssetsFromNodes(nodesJson, ref.read(assetsProvider));
final body = jsonEncode({'snapshot': {'nodes': nodesJson}, 'assets': assets});
try {
final res = await http.post(Uri.parse('/api/export/ctrx'), headers: {'content-type':'application/json'}, body: body);
if (res.statusCode == 200) {
final blob = html.Blob([res.bodyBytes]);
final url = html.Url.createObjectUrlFromBlob(blob);
final a = html.AnchorElement(href: url)..download = 'project.ctrx';
html.document.body!.append(a); a.click(); a.remove(); html.Url.revokeObjectUrl(url);
if (context.mounted) ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(content: Text('Downloaded project.ctrx')));
} else {
if (context.mounted) ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('Export failed (${res.statusCode})')));
}
} catch (e) {
if (context.mounted) ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('Export error: $e')));
}
}
""")

import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;

void main() => runApp(const ViewerApp());

class ViewerApp extends StatelessWidget {
const ViewerApp({super.key});
@override
Widget build(BuildContext context) => MaterialApp(title: 'CreatorX Viewer', theme: ThemeData.dark(useMaterial3: true), home: const ViewerScreen(), debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false);
}

class ViewerScreen extends StatefulWidget { const ViewerScreen({super.key}); @override State<ViewerScreen> createState()=>_ViewerScreenState(); }
class _ViewerScreenState extends State<ViewerScreen> {
Map<String, dynamic>? snapshot;
@override void initState(){ super.initState(); _load(); }
Future<void> _load() async {
final res = await http.get(Uri.parse('/api/projects/snapshot'));
if (res.statusCode == 200) setState(()=>snapshot=jsonDecode(res.body));
}
@override Widget build(BuildContext context) {
final s = snapshot; if (s==null) return const Scaffold(body: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()));
final nodes = (s['nodes'] as List).cast<Map<String, dynamic>>();
return Scaffold(appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('CreatorX Viewer')), body: Stack(children: nodes.where((n)=>n['parentId']==null).map((n)=>_buildNode(n, nodes)).toList()));
}
Widget _buildNode(Map<String,dynamic> n, List<Map<String,dynamic>> all) {
final x=(n['x']??0).toDouble(), y=(n['y']??0).toDouble(), w=(n['w']??100).toDouble(), h=(n['h']??60).toDouble();
final type = n['type'] as String; final props = (n['props'] as Map?)?.cast<String,dynamic>() ?? {};
Widget child;
if (type=='Container') { final color=_color(props['fill'])??const Color(0xFF222222); final r=(props['borderRadius']??8).toDouble(); child=ClipRRect(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(r), child: Container(color: color)); }
else if (type=='Text') { child=Center(child: Text(props['text']??'', style: TextStyle(fontSize:(props['fontSize']??16).toDouble(), color:_color(props['textColor'])??Colors.white))); }
else if (type=='AutoLayout') {
final dir=(props['direction']??'row')=='row'?Axis.horizontal:Axis.vertical; final spacing=(props['spacing']??8).toDouble(); final pad=(props['padding']??0).toDouble();
final children = all.where((m)=>m['parentId']==n['id']).toList();
child = Padding(padding: EdgeInsets.all(pad), child: Flex(direction: dir, children: [
for (int i=0;i<children.length;i++) ...[ Expanded(child: _buildNode(children[i], all)), if (i<children.length-1) SizedBox(width: dir==Axis.horizontal?spacing:0, height: dir==Axis.vertical?spacing:0) ]
]));
} else if (type=='Image') {
final src = props['src'] as String?;
Widget img = const SizedBox.shrink();
if (src != null) {
if (src.startsWith('ctrx://')) {
final rest = src.substring(7); final i = rest.indexOf('/');
if (i>0) { final id = rest.substring(0,i); final path = rest.substring(i+1); final url = Uri(path:'/api/ctrx/asset', queryParameters:{'id':id,'path':path}).toString(); img = Image.network(url, fit: BoxFit.cover); }
} else if (src.startsWith('data:') || src.startsWith('http')) {
img = Image.network(src, fit: BoxFit.cover);
}
}
child = ClipRRect(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular((props['radius']??0).toDouble()), child: img);
} else { child = const SizedBox.shrink(); }
return Positioned(left:x, top:y, width:w, height:h, child: child);
}
Color? _color(dynamic v){ if(v is String && v.startsWith('#')){ final hex = v.length==7? 'FF'+v.substring(1): v.substring(1); return Color(int.parse(hex, radix:16)); } return null; }
}

w(os.path.join(creatorx, "FORMAT_SPEC.md"), """

CreatorX Project Format (.ctrx) — v1.1
mimetype: application/creator_X_project

snapshot.json (canonical) + snapshot.cbor (CBOR mirror; prefer CBOR)

assets/* (binary assets bundled)

manifest.json (id, version, tool, asset table, optional signature block)

integrity.sha256 (sha256 lines)

optional: signature.sig (COSE_Sign1, detached Ed25519 over snapshot.json) + signature.pubkey

Endpoints (CORS on)
GET /api/projects/snapshot

POST /api/export/ctrx → returns application/creator_X_project (binary).
Body shape (Studio calls this automatically):

{
  "snapshot": { "nodes": [ ... ] },
  "assets": [ { "path": "assets/foo.png", "base64": "..." }, ... ],
  "signingKeyBase64": "AAAAAAAA...32b-ed25519-seed-...AAAA"
}
POST /api/import/ctrx

{ "fileBase64": "<base64-of-.ctrx>", "verifyKeyBase64": "<optional-ed25519-pubkey>" }
Response includes id, assetsStored, signatureVerified, snapshotRewritten (with ctrx://<id>/assets/...).

GET /api/ctrx/asset?id=<manifestId>&path=assets/<file> (binary-safe)

Notes
CTRX file includes:

mimetype (application/creator_X_project)

snapshot.json + snapshot.cbor (CBOR = smaller, preferred)

assets/*

integrity.sha256

manifest.json (id, tool, asset table, optional signature)

optional signature.sig (COSE_Sign1, Ed25519 detached over snapshot.json) + signature.pubkey

Studio auto-bundles any Image nodes that use data: URIs or asset: refs. Export uses binary-safe response.

Import registers assets in-memory and rewrites Image.src to ctrx://<id>/assets/... for Viewer.

import 'dart:collection';
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:typed_data';

class ProjectState {
  final projects = HashMap<String, Map<String, dynamic>>(); // id -> snapshot
  final assets = HashMap<String, Map<String, Uint8List>>(); // id -> path->bytes

  Map<String, dynamic> createOrUpdate({String? id, required Map<String, dynamic> snapshot}) {
    id ??= DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch.toString();
    projects[id] = snapshot;
    return {'id': id, 'snapshot': snapshot};
  }
}
final projectState = ProjectState();

class CmsState {
  final collections = HashMap<String, Map<String, dynamic>>(); // id -> {name, schema, entries:{}}
  String _id() => DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch.toString();

  Map<String, dynamic> createCollection(String name, Map<String, dynamic> schema) {
    final id = _id();
    collections[id] = {'id': id, 'name': name, 'schema': schema, 'entries': HashMap<String, Map<String, dynamic>>()};
    return collections[id]!;
  }
  Map<String, dynamic>? getCollection(String id) => collections[id];

  Map<String, dynamic> createEntry(String colId, Map<String, dynamic> data) {
    final col = collections[colId]; if (col == null) throw StateError('Collection not found');
    final id = _id();
    (col['entries'] as HashMap<String, Map<String, dynamic>>)[id] = {'id': id, ...data};
    return (col['entries'] as HashMap)[id]!;
  }
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> listEntries(String colId) {
    final col = collections[colId]; if (col == null) throw StateError('Collection not found');
    return List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from((col['entries'] as HashMap).values);
  }
}
final cmsState = CmsState();
""")

# CMS unified endpoint
w(os.path.join(proj, "apps/site/api/cms/cms.dispatch.dart"), """
import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:dartvel_core/dartvel.dart';
import '../state.dart';

Future<ResponseType> handler(Request req) async {
  final seg = req.url.pathSegments;
  // /api/cms
  if (seg.length==2) {
    // list collections
    if (req.method=='GET') {
      final list = cmsState.collections.values.toList();
      return Res.json(jsonEncode({'collections': list}), headers:{'access-control-allow-origin':'*'});
    }
    if (req.method=='POST') {
      final b = jsonDecode(await req.readAsString()) as Map<String, dynamic>;
      final c = cmsState.createCollection(b['name'] as String, (b['schema'] as Map).cast<String,dynamic>());
      return Res.json(jsonEncode(c), headers:{'access-control-allow-origin':'*'});
    }
  }
  // /api/cms/<cid>[/entries[/<eid>]]
  if (seg.length>=3) {
    final cid = seg[2];
    if (seg.length==3) {
      if (req.method=='GET') {
        final c = cmsState.getCollection(cid);
        if (c==null) return Res.text('not found', status:404);
        return Res.json(jsonEncode(c), headers:{'access-control-allow-origin':'*'});
      }
    }
    if (seg.length>=4 && seg[3]=='entries') {
      if (seg.length==4) {
        if (req.method=='GET') {
          final entries = cmsState.listEntries(cid);
          return Res.json(jsonEncode({'entries': entries}), headers:{'access-control-allow-origin':'*'});
        }
        if (req.method=='POST') {
          final data = (jsonDecode(await req.readAsString()) as Map).cast<String,dynamic>();
          final e = cmsState.createEntry(cid, data);
          return Res.json(jsonEncode(e), headers:{'access-control-allow-origin':'*'});
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return Res.text('not found', status:404);
}
""")

Future<ResponseType> handler(Request req) async {

name: creatorx_export_app

dependencies: { flutter: { sdk: flutter } }
flutter: { uses-material-design: true }
'''.codeUnits));
  final bytes = ZipEncoder().encode(arc)!;
  return Res.bytes(bytes, headers: {
    'content-type': 'application/zip',
    'content-disposition': 'attachment; filename="creatorx_export_flutter.zip"',
    'access-control-allow-origin': '*',
  });
}

ROOT = "/mnt/data"
max_root = os.path.join(ROOT, "creator_x_max")

def w(path, content):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(textwrap.dedent(content).lstrip() + ("\n" if not content.endswith("\n") else ""))

environment:

library dartvel_core;

import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:shelf/shelf.dart' as shelf;
import 'package:shelf_router/shelf_router.dart' as router;
export 'package:shelf/shelf.dart' show Pipeline;

typedef Request = shelf.Request;
typedef ResponseType = shelf.Response;
typedef Handler = Future<ResponseType> Function(Request req);

class Res {
  static ResponseType json(String body, {Map<String, String>? headers, int status = 200}) =>
      shelf.Response(status, body: body, headers: {
        'content-type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8',
        if (headers != null) ...headers,
      });

  static ResponseType html(String body, {Map<String, String>? headers, int status = 200}) =>
      shelf.Response(status, body: body, headers: {
        'content-type': 'text/html; charset=utf-8',
        if (headers != null) ...headers,
      });

  static ResponseType text(String body, {Map<String, String>? headers, int status = 200}) =>
      shelf.Response(status, body: body, headers: {
        'content-type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8',
        if (headers != null) ...headers,
      });

  static ResponseType bytes(List<int> bytes, {Map<String, String>? headers, int status = 200}) =>
      shelf.Response(status, body: bytes, headers: {
        if (headers != null) ...headers,
      });

  static ResponseType notFound([String body = 'Not Found']) =>
      shelf.Response.notFound(body);
}

class Server {
  static shelf.Handler mount(Map<String, Handler> apiRoutes, Map<String, Handler> pageRoutes) {
    final r = router.Router();

    apiRoutes.forEach((path, handler) {
      r.add('GET', path, (shelf.Request req) => handler(req));
      r.add('POST', path, (shelf.Request req) => handler(req));
      r.add('PUT', path, (shelf.Request req) => handler(req));
      r.add('PATCH', path, (shelf.Request req) => handler(req));
      r.add('DELETE', path, (shelf.Request req) => handler(req));
      r.add('OPTIONS', path, (shelf.Request req) => shelf.Response.ok('', headers: {
        'access-control-allow-origin': req.headers['origin'] ?? '*',
        'access-control-allow-methods': 'GET,POST,OPTIONS,PUT,PATCH,DELETE',
        'access-control-allow-headers': 'Content-Type,Authorization',
      }));
    });

    pageRoutes.forEach((path, handler) {
      r.add('GET', path, (shelf.Request req) => handler(req));
    });

    return r;
  }
}
""")

w(os.path.join(max_root, "packages/ctrx_format/lib/ctrx_format.dart"), """
library ctrx_format;

import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:typed_data';
import 'package:archive/archive.dart';
import 'package:crypto/crypto.dart';
import 'package:cryptography/cryptography.dart' as cg;
import 'package:cbor/cbor.dart' as cbor;
import 'package:uuid/uuid.dart';

class CtrX {
  static const String mime = 'application/creator_X_project';
  static const String ext = '.ctrx';
  static const String version = '1.2';

  static Uint8List encode(
    Map<String, dynamic> snapshot, {
    Map<String, Uint8List>? assets,
    Map<String, dynamic>? meta,
  }) {
    final archive = Archive();

    final mimeBytes = Uint8List.fromList(utf8.encode(mime));
    final mimeFile = ArchiveFile('mimetype', mimeBytes.length, mimeBytes)..compress = false;
    archive.addFile(mimeFile);

    final jsonBytes = Uint8List.fromList(utf8.encode(jsonEncode(snapshot)));
    archive.addFile(ArchiveFile('snapshot.json', jsonBytes.length, jsonBytes));

    final enc = cbor.CborEncoder()..encode(snapshot);
    final cborBytes = Uint8List.fromList(enc.output.getData());
    archive.addFile(ArchiveFile('snapshot.cbor', cborBytes.length, cborBytes));

    final assetsList = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    assets?.forEach((p, bytes) {
      final path = p.startsWith('assets/') ? p : 'assets/$p';
      archive.addFile(ArchiveFile(path, bytes.length, bytes));
      assetsList.add({'path': path, 'size': bytes.length, 'sha256': sha256.convert(bytes).toString()});
    });

    final lines = <String>['snapshot.json  ${sha256.convert(jsonBytes)}'];
    for (final a in assetsList) { lines.add('${a['path']}  ${a['sha256']}'); }
    final integ = Uint8List.fromList(utf8.encode(lines.join('\\n')));
    archive.addFile(ArchiveFile('integrity.sha256', integ.length, integ));

    final manifest = {
      'format': 'ctrx',
      'version': version,
      'id': const Uuid().v4(),
      'createdAt': DateTime.now().toUtc().toIso8601String(),
      'tool': meta ?? {'name': 'CreatorX', 'version': '2.0.0'},
      'snapshot': {'sha256': sha256.convert(jsonBytes).toString(), 'bytes': jsonBytes.length, 'cborBytes': cborBytes.length},
      'assets': assetsList,
      'signature': null,
    };
    final manBytes = Uint8List.fromList(utf8.encode(jsonEncode(manifest)));
    archive.addFile(ArchiveFile('manifest.json', manBytes.length, manBytes));

    return Uint8List.fromList(ZipEncoder().encode(archive)!);
  }

  static Future<Uint8List> encodeSigned(
    Map<String, dynamic> snapshot, {
    Map<String, Uint8List>? assets,
    Map<String, dynamic>? meta,
    required Uint8List ed25519Seed32,
  }) async {
    final base = encode(snapshot, assets: assets, meta: meta);
    final arc = ZipDecoder().decodeBytes(base);
    final snapFile = arc.firstWhere((f) => f.name == 'snapshot.json');
    final payload = Uint8List.fromList(snapFile.content as List<int>);

    final cose = await _coseSignDetached(payload, mime, ed25519Seed32);
    arc.addFile(ArchiveFile('signature.sig', cose.bytes.length, cose.bytes));
    arc.addFile(ArchiveFile('signature.pubkey', cose.publicKey.length, cose.publicKey));

    final mIdx = arc.files.indexWhere((f) => f.name == 'manifest.json');
    final manifest = jsonDecode(utf8.decode(arc.files[mIdx].content as List<int>)) as Map<String, dynamic>;
    manifest['signature'] = {
      'alg': 'EdDSA',
      'protected': {'alg': -8, 'content-type': mime},
      'detached': true,
      'file': 'signature.sig',
      'publicKeyB64': base64Encode(cose.publicKey),
    };
    final manBytes = Uint8List.fromList(utf8.encode(jsonEncode(manifest)));
    arc.files[mIdx] = ArchiveFile('manifest.json', manBytes.length, manBytes);
    return Uint8List.fromList(ZipEncoder().encode(arc)!);
  }

  static ({Map<String, dynamic> snapshot, Map<String, dynamic> manifest}) decode(Uint8List bytes) {
    final arc = ZipDecoder().decodeBytes(bytes);
    ArchiveFile? cborFile, jsonFile, manFile;
    for (final f in arc) {
      if (f.name == 'snapshot.cbor') cborFile = f;
      if (f.name == 'snapshot.json') jsonFile = f;
      if (f.name == 'manifest.json') manFile = f;
    }
    if (manFile == null || (cborFile == null && jsonFile == null)) {
      throw StateError('Invalid CTRX');
    }
    Map<String, dynamic> snapshot;
    if (cborFile != null) {
      final dec = cbor.CborDecoder(cborFile.content as List<int>);
      snapshot = Map<String, dynamic>.from(dec.decode() as Map);
    } else {
      snapshot = jsonDecode(utf8.decode(jsonFile!.content as List<int>)) as Map<String, dynamic>;
    }
    final manifest = jsonDecode(utf8.decode(manFile.content as List<int>)) as Map<String, dynamic>;
    return (snapshot: snapshot, manifest: manifest);
  }

  static Future<bool> verifySignature({required Uint8List ctrxBytes, required Uint8List publicKey}) async {
    final arc = ZipDecoder().decodeBytes(ctrxBytes);
    ArchiveFile? sigFile, snapFile;
    for (final f in arc) {
      if (f.name == 'signature.sig') sigFile = f;
      if (f.name == 'snapshot.json') snapFile = f;
    }
    if (sigFile == null || snapFile == null) return false;
    return _coseVerifyDetached(Uint8List.fromList(sigFile.content as List<int>), Uint8List.fromList(snapFile.content as List<int>), mime, publicKey);
  }
}

class _CoseSig {
  _CoseSig(this.bytes, this.publicKey);
  final Uint8List bytes;
  final Uint8List publicKey;
}

Future<_CoseSig> _coseSignDetached(Uint8List payload, String contentType, Uint8List seed32) async {
  if (seed32.length != 32) throw StateError('ed25519 seed must be 32 bytes');
  const algEdDSA = -8;
  final protected = () {
    final enc = cbor.CborEncoder()..encode({'alg': algEdDSA, 'content-type': contentType});
    return Uint8List.fromList(enc.output.getData());
  }();
  final sigStructBytes = () {
    final enc = cbor.CborEncoder()..encode(['Signature1', protected, Uint8List(0), payload]);
    return Uint8List.fromList(enc.output.getData());
  }();

  final algo = cg.Ed25519();
  final kp = await algo.newKeyPairFromSeed(seed32);
  final signature = await algo.sign(sigStructBytes, keyPair: kp);
  final pub = await kp.extractPublicKey();

  final sign1 = [protected, <String, dynamic>{}, null, Uint8List.fromList(signature.bytes)];
  final enc = cbor.CborEncoder()..encode(sign1);
  return _CoseSig(Uint8List.fromList(enc.output.getData()), Uint8List.fromList(pub.bytes));
}

Future<bool> _coseVerifyDetached(Uint8List sign1, Uint8List payload, String contentType, Uint8List publicKey) async {
  final dec = cbor.CborDecoder(sign1);
  final obj = dec.decode();
  if (obj is! List || obj.length != 4) return false;
  final protected = obj[0];
  final signature = obj[3];
  if (protected is! Uint8List || signature is! Uint8List) return false;

  final map = cbor.CborDecoder(protected).decode() as Map;
  if (map['alg'] != -8) return false;
  if (map['content-type'] != null && map['content-type'] != contentType) return false;

  final sigStructBytes = () {
    final enc = cbor.CborEncoder()..encode(['Signature1', protected, Uint8List(0), payload]);
    return Uint8List.fromList(enc.output.getData());
  }();
  final algo = cg.Ed25519();
  final pub = cg.SimplePublicKey(publicKey, type: cg.KeyPairType.ed25519);
  try {
    return await algo.verify(sigStructBytes, signature: cg.Signature(signature, publicKey: pub));
  } catch (_) {
    return false;
  }
}
""")

import 'dart:collection';
import 'dart:typed_data';

class ProjectStore {
  final projects = HashMap<String, Map<String, dynamic>>(); // id -> snapshot
  final published = HashMap<String, String>(); // slug -> projectId
  final assets = HashMap<String, Map<String, Uint8List>>(); // projectId -> path->bytes
}
final store = ProjectStore();

String newId() => DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch.toString();

class CmsStore {
  final collections = HashMap<String, Map<String, dynamic>>(); // id -> {id,name,schema,entries:{}}
  String _id() => DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch.toString();
  Map<String, dynamic> createCollection(String name, Map<String, dynamic> schema) {
    final id = _id();
    collections[id] = {'id': id, 'name': name, 'schema': schema, 'entries': HashMap<String, Map<String, dynamic>>()};
    return collections[id]!;
  }
  Map<String, dynamic>? getCollection(String id) => collections[id];
  Map<String, dynamic> createEntry(String colId, Map<String, dynamic> data) {
    final col = collections[colId]; if (col == null) { throw StateError('Collection not found'); }
    final id = _id();
    (col['entries'] as HashMap<String, Map<String, dynamic>>)[id] = {'id': id, ...data};
    return (col['entries'] as HashMap)[id]!;
  }
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> listEntries(String colId) {
    final col = collections[colId]; if (col == null) throw StateError('Collection not found');
    return List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from((col['entries'] as HashMap).values);
  }
}
final cms = CmsStore();
""")

# --- CMS endpoint ---
w(os.path.join(max_root, "apps/site/api/cms/cms.dispatch.dart"), """
import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:dartvel_core/dartvel.dart';
import '../state.dart';

Future<ResponseType> handler(Request req) async {
  final parts = req.url.pathSegments;
  // /api/cms
  if (parts.length == 2) {
    if (req.method == 'GET') {
      return Res.json(jsonEncode({'collections': cms.collections.values.toList()}), headers: {'access-control-allow-origin':'*'});
    }
    if (req.method == 'POST') {
      final b = jsonDecode(await req.readAsString()) as Map<String, dynamic>;
      final c = cms.createCollection(b['name'] as String, (b['schema'] as Map).cast<String,dynamic>());
      return Res.json(jsonEncode(c), headers: {'access-control-allow-origin':'*'});
    }
  }
  // /api/cms/<cid>/entries
  if (parts.length >= 4 && parts[3] == 'entries') {
    final colId = parts[2];
    if (req.method == 'GET') {
      final list = cms.listEntries(colId);
      return Res.json(jsonEncode({'entries': list}), headers: {'access-control-allow-origin':'*'});
    }
    if (req.method == 'POST') {
      final data = (jsonDecode(await req.readAsString()) as Map).cast<String,dynamic>();
      final e = cms.createEntry(colId, data);
      return Res.json(jsonEncode(e), headers: {'access-control-allow-origin':'*'});
    }
  }
  // /api/cms/<cid>
  if (parts.length == 3) {
    final cid = parts[2];
    if (req.method == 'GET') {
      final c = cms.getCollection(cid);
      if (c == null) return Res.text('not found', status: 404);
      return Res.json(jsonEncode(c), headers: {'access-control-allow-origin':'*'});
    }
  }
  return Res.text('not found', status: 404);
}
""")

import 'package:dartvel_core/dartvel.dart';
import '../ctrx_store.dart';

String _ct(String p) {
  p = p.toLowerCase();
  if (p.endsWith('.png')) return 'image/png';
  if (p.endsWith('.jpg') || p.endsWith('.jpeg')) return 'image/jpeg';
  if (p.endsWith('.webp')) return 'image/webp';
  if (p.endsWith('.gif')) return 'image/gif';
  if (p.endsWith('.svg')) return 'image/svg+xml';
  return 'application/octet-stream';
}

Future<ResponseType> handler(Request req) async {
  final id = req.url.queryParameters['id'];
  final path = req.url.queryParameters['path'];
  if (id == null || path == null) return Res.text('id & path required', status: 400);
  final bytes = getCtrxAsset(id, path);
  if (bytes == null) return Res.text('not found', status: 404);
  return Res.bytes(bytes, headers: {
    'content-type': _ct(path),
    'cache-control': 'public, max-age=31536000, immutable',
    'access-control-allow-origin': '*',
    'access-control-allow-methods': 'GET,POST,OPTIONS',
    'access-control-allow-headers': 'Content-Type'
  });
}
""")

# --- Export CTRX (auto-bundle + optional signing) ---
w(os.path.join(max_root, "apps/site/api/export/ctrx.post.dart"), """
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:typed_data';
import 'package:dartvel_core/dartvel.dart';
import 'package:ctrx_format/ctrx_format.dart';

List<Map<String, dynamic>> _harvest(Map<String, dynamic> snap) {
  final out = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
  final nodes = (snap['nodes'] as List?)?.cast<Map<String, dynamic>>() ?? const [];
  String extFrom(String mime) {
    switch (mime) {
      case 'image/png': return 'png';
      case 'image/jpeg': return 'jpg';
      case 'image/webp': return 'webp';
      case 'image/gif': return 'gif';
      case 'image/svg+xml': return 'svg';
      default: return 'bin';
    }
  }
  for (final n in nodes) {
    if (n['type'] != 'Image') continue;
    final props = (n['props'] as Map?)?.cast<String, dynamic>() ?? {};
    final src = props['src'] as String?;
    final dataUri = props['dataUri'] as String?;
    if (src != null && src.startsWith('asset:')) {
      final p = src.substring('asset:'.length);
      out.add({'path': p, 'base64': null});
    } else if (dataUri != null && dataUri.startsWith('data:')) {
      final i = dataUri.indexOf(',');
      final header = dataUri.substring(5, i);
      final mime = header.split(';').first;
      final b64 = dataUri.substring(i+1);
      final key = dataUri.hashCode.toUnsigned(32).toRadixString(16);
      final path = 'assets/img_' + key + '.' + extFrom(mime);
      out.add({'path': path, 'base64': b64});
      props['src'] = 'asset:' + path;
      n['props'] = props;
    }
  }
  return out;
}

Future<ResponseType> handler(Request req) async {
  final body = await req.readAsString();
  Map<String, dynamic> root = {};
  Map<String, dynamic> snapshot = {'nodes': []};
  Uint8List? seed;
  final assets = <String, Uint8List>{};

  try {
    root = jsonDecode(body) as Map<String, dynamic>;
    snapshot = ((root['snapshot'] ?? root) as Map).cast<String, dynamic>();
    final k = root['signingKeyBase64'] as String?;
    if (k != null) seed = Uint8List.fromList(base64Decode(k));
    final list = (root['assets'] as List?) ?? const [];
    for (final a in list) {
      final p0 = (a['path'] as String);
      final p = p0.startsWith('assets/') ? p0 : 'assets/' + p0;
      final b64 = a['base64'] as String?;
      if (b64 != null) {
        assets[p] = Uint8List.fromList(base64Decode(b64));
      }
    }
  } catch (_) {
    if (body.isNotEmpty) snapshot = jsonDecode(body) as Map<String, dynamic>;
  }

  if (assets.isEmpty) {
    final harvest = _harvest(snapshot);
    for (final a in harvest) {
      final p0 = (a['path'] as String);
      final p = p0.startsWith('assets/') ? p0 : 'assets/' + p0;
      final b64 = a['base64'] as String?;
      if (b64 != null) assets[p] = Uint8List.fromList(base64Decode(b64));
    }
  }

  Uint8List bytes;
  if (seed != null) {
    bytes = await CtrX.encodeSigned(snapshot, assets: assets, meta: {'name':'CreatorX','version':'3.0.0'}, ed25519Seed32: seed);
  } else {
    bytes = CtrX.encode(snapshot, assets: assets, meta: {'name':'CreatorX','version':'3.0.0'});
  }

  return Res.bytes(bytes, headers: {
    'content-type': CtrX.mime,
    'content-disposition': 'attachment; filename="project.ctrx"',
    'x-ctrx-signed': seed != null ? '1' : '0',
    'access-control-allow-origin': '*',
    'access-control-allow-methods': 'GET,POST,OPTIONS',
    'access-control-allow-headers': 'Content-Type'
  });
}
""")

# --- Import CTRX (register assets + rewrite to ctrx://id/...) ---
w(os.path.join(max_root, "apps/site/api/import/ctrx.post.dart"), """
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:typed_data';
import 'package:archive/archive.dart';
import 'package:dartvel_core/dartvel.dart';
import 'package:ctrx_format/ctrx_format.dart';
import '../state.dart';
import '../ctrx_store.dart';

Map<String, dynamic> _rewrite(Map<String, dynamic> snap, String id) {
  final nodes = (snap['nodes'] as List?)?.cast<Map<String, dynamic>>() ?? const [];
  for (final n in nodes) {
    if (n['type'] == 'Image') {
      final props = (n['props'] as Map?)?.cast<String, dynamic>() ?? {};
      final src = props['src'] as String?;
      if (src != null && src.startsWith('asset:')) {
        final path = src.substring('asset:'.length);
        props.remove('dataUri');
        props['src'] = 'ctrx://$id/$path';
        n['props'] = props;
      }
    }
  }
  return {...snap, 'nodes': nodes};
}

Future<ResponseType> handler(Request req) async {
  final Map<String, dynamic> inb = jsonDecode(await req.readAsString());
  final data = base64Decode(inb['fileBase64'] as String);
  final decoded = CtrX.decode(Uint8List.fromList(data));

  final arc = ZipDecoder().decodeBytes(data);
  final assets = <String, Uint8List>{};
  for (final f in arc) {
    if (f.name.startsWith('assets/')) {
      assets[f.name] = Uint8List.fromList(f.content as List<int>);
    }
  }
  final id = (decoded.manifest['id'] ?? newId()) as String;
  if (assets.isNotEmpty) putCtrxAssets(id, assets);
  store.projects[id] = decoded.snapshot;

  bool? verified;
  final vk = inb['verifyKeyBase64'] as String?;
  if (vk != null) {
    verified = await CtrX.verifySignature(ctrxBytes: Uint8List.fromList(data), publicKey: Uint8List.fromList(base64Decode(vk)));
  }

  return Res.json(jsonEncode({
    'id': id,
    'manifest': decoded.manifest,
    'assetsStored': assets.length,
    'signatureVerified': verified,
    'snapshot': decoded.snapshot,
    'snapshotRewritten': _rewrite(decoded.snapshot, id)
  }), headers: {'access-control-allow-origin':'*'});
}
""")

w(os.path.join(max_root, "apps/site/api/export/flutter.post.dart"), """
import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:archive/archive.dart';
import 'package:dartvel_core/dartvel.dart';

String _dartEscape(String s) => s.replaceAll(r'$','\\$');

String _flutterMainDart(Map<String, dynamic> snapshot) {
  return '''
import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

void main() => runApp(const ExportedApp());

class ExportedApp extends StatelessWidget {
  const ExportedApp({super.key});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => MaterialApp(title: 'CreatorX Export', theme: ThemeData.dark(useMaterial3: true), home: const ExportedScreen());
}

class ExportedScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  const ExportedScreen({super.key});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final Map<String, dynamic> snapshot = jsonDecode(r\"\"\"${_dartEscape(jsonEncode(snapshot))}\"\"\");
    final nodes = (snapshot['nodes'] as List).cast<Map<String, dynamic>>();
    return Scaffold(appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Exported from CreatorX')), body: Stack(children: nodes.where((n)=>n['parentId']==null).map((n)=>_render(n, nodes)).toList()));
  }

  Widget _render(Map<String,dynamic> n, List<Map<String,dynamic>> all) {
    final x=(n['x']??0).toDouble(), y=(n['y']??0).toDouble(), w=(n['w']??100).toDouble(), h=(n['h']??60).toDouble();
    final type = n['type'] as String; final props = (n['props'] as Map?)?.cast<String,dynamic>() ?? {};
    Widget child;
    if (type=='Container') {
      final color=_color(_resolveToken(props['fill'], snapshot['tokens']))??const Color(0xFF222222);
      final r=(props['borderRadius']??8).toDouble();
      child=ClipRRect(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(r), child: Container(color: color));
    } else if (type=='Text') {
      final txt = (props['text']??'') as String;
      child=Center(child: Text(txt, style: TextStyle(fontSize:(props['fontSize']??16).toDouble(), color:_color(_resolveToken(props['textColor'], snapshot['tokens']))??Colors.white)));
    } else { child = const SizedBox.shrink(); }
    return Positioned(left:x, top:y, width:w, height:h, child: child);
  }
  static dynamic _resolveToken(dynamic v, Map? tokens){ if (v is String && v.startsWith('token:')){ final path=v.substring(6).split('.'); dynamic cur=tokens; for (final k in path){ if (cur is Map) cur=cur[k]; } return cur ?? v; } return v; }
  static Color? _color(dynamic v){ if(v is String && v.startsWith('#')){ final hex = v.length==7? 'FF'+v.substring(1): v.substring(1); return Color(int.parse(hex, radix:16)); } return null; }
}
''';
}

Future<ResponseType> handler(Request req) async {
  final body = await req.readAsString();
  final snap = (jsonDecode(body) as Map).cast<String,dynamic>();
  final arc = Archive();
  final mainDart = _flutterMainDart(snap);
  arc.addFile(ArchiveFile('lib/main.dart', mainDart.length, mainDart.codeUnits));
  final pubspec = '''
name: creatorx_export_app
environment: { sdk: ">=3.4.0 <4.0.0" }
dependencies: { flutter: { sdk: flutter } }
flutter: { uses-material-design: true }
''';
  arc.addFile(ArchiveFile('pubspec.yaml', pubspec.length, pubspec.codeUnits));
  final bytes = ZipEncoder().encode(arc)!;
  return Res.bytes(bytes, headers: {
    'content-type': 'application/zip',
    'content-disposition': 'attachment; filename="creatorx_export_flutter.zip"',
    'access-control-allow-origin': '*',
  });
}
""")

w(os.path.join(max_root, "apps/studio/lib/commands.dart"), """
class Command<T> {
  Command(this.label, this.apply, this.revert);
  final String label;
  final T Function() apply;
  final void Function(T) revert;
}

class CommandStack<T> {
  final _undo = <Command<T>>[];
  final _redo = <Command<T>>[];
  T state;
  CommandStack(this.state);

  void run(Command<T> cmd) {
    final prev = state;
    state = cmd.apply();
    _undo.add(Command(cmd.label, ()=>prev, (s){}));
    _redo.clear();
  }

  bool canUndo() => _undo.isNotEmpty;
  bool canRedo() => _redo.isNotEmpty;

  void undo() {
    if (!canUndo()) return;
    final last = _undo.removeLast();
    final prev = last.apply();
    _redo.add(Command(last.label, ()=>prev, (s){}));
    state = prev;
  }

  void redo() {
    if (!canRedo()) return;
    final last = _redo.removeLast();
    final next = last.apply();
    _undo.add(Command(last.label, ()=>next, (s){}));
    state = next;
  }
}
""")

w(os.path.join(max_root, "apps/studio/lib/models.dart"), """
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

enum NodeType { container, text, image, component, code }

class Node {
  Node({
    required this.id,
    required this.pageId,
    required this.type,
    required this.x, required this.y, required this.w, required this.h,
    this.rotation = 0, this.props = const {}, this.parentId,
  });
  final String id;
  final String pageId;
  final NodeType type;
  double x, y, w, h;
  double rotation;
  Map<String, dynamic> props;
  String? parentId;
}

class Breakpoint { Breakpoint(this.name, this.min); final String name; final double min; }
class PageDef { PageDef(this.id, this.name); final String id; final String name; }

class ComponentDef { ComponentDef(this.id, this.props, this.variants); final String id; final Map<String,dynamic> props; final Map<String,Map<String,dynamic>> variants; }

class Tokens {
  Tokens(this.color, this.spacing, this.type);
  final Map<String, dynamic> color;
  final Map<String, dynamic> spacing;
  final Map<String, dynamic> type;
}

Color? colorFrom(dynamic v, Tokens tokens) {
  if (v is String && v.startsWith('token:')) {
    final path = v.substring(6).split('.');
    dynamic cur = {'color': tokens.color, 'spacing': tokens.spacing, 'type': tokens.type};
    for (final k in path) { if (cur is Map) cur = cur[k]; }
    v = cur;
  }
  if (v is String && v.startsWith('#')) {
    final hex = v.length == 7 ? 'FF${v.substring(1)}' : v.substring(1);
    return Color(int.parse(hex, radix: 16));
  }
  return null;
}
""")

w(os.path.join(max_root, "apps/studio/lib/state.dart"), """
import 'package:hooks_riverpod/hooks_riverpod.dart';
import 'models.dart';
import 'package:uuid/uuid.dart';

class ProjectState {
  ProjectState({
    required this.tokens,
    required this.breakpoints,
    required this.pages,
    required this.components,
    required this.nodes,
    required this.currentPageId,
  });
  Tokens tokens;
  List<Breakpoint> breakpoints;
  List<PageDef> pages;
  List<ComponentDef> components;
  List<Node> nodes;
  String currentPageId;
}

final projectProvider = StateNotifierProvider<ProjectNotifier, ProjectState>((ref) {
  final t = Tokens({'primary':'#FF4F46E5','onPrimary':'#FFFFFFFF','bg':'#FF121212'},{'s':8,'m':16,'l':24},{'h1':32,'body':16});
  final bps = [Breakpoint('desktop',1024),Breakpoint('tablet',768),Breakpoint('mobile',0)];
  final pages = [PageDef('home','Home'), PageDef('about','About')];
  final components = [ComponentDef('Button', {'text':'Button','fill':'token:color.primary','textColor':'token:color.onPrimary','padding':12}, {'primary':{'fill':'token:color.primary'}, 'ghost':{'fill':'#00000000','textColor':'#FFFFFFFF'}})];
  final nodes = <Node>[
    Node(id: const Uuid().v4(), pageId: 'home', type: NodeType.container, x:40,y:40,w:560,h:220, props:{'fill':'token:color.bg','borderRadius':16}),
    Node(id: const Uuid().v4(), pageId: 'home', type: NodeType.text, x:60,y:70,w:520,h:60, props:{'text':'CreatorX Max','fontSize':'token:type.h1','textColor':'#FFFFFFFF','animation':{'appear':{'type':'spring','duration':500,'from':{'opacity':0.0,'y':20},'to':{'opacity':1.0,'y':0}}}}),
  ];
  return ProjectNotifier(ProjectState(tokens: t, breakpoints: bps, pages: pages, components: components, nodes: nodes, currentPageId: 'home'));
});

class ProjectNotifier extends StateNotifier<ProjectState> {
  ProjectNotifier(super.state);
  final _uuid = const Uuid();
  void addNode(NodeType type) {
    final id = _uuid.v4();
    state = ProjectState(tokens: state.tokens, breakpoints: state.breakpoints, pages: state.pages, components: state.components,
      nodes: [...state.nodes, Node(id: id, pageId: state.currentPageId, type: type, x:80, y:80, w: type==NodeType.text?240:200, h: type==NodeType.text?60:120, props: type==NodeType.text? {'text':'Text','fontSize':18,'textColor':'#FFFFFFFF'} : {'fill':'#FF4F46E5','borderRadius':12})],
      currentPageId: state.currentPageId);
  }
  void move(String id, double dx, double dy) => _mutate(id, (n)=>n..x += dx ..y += dy);
  void resize(String id, {double? w, double? h}) => _mutate(id, (n){ n.w = w ?? n.w; n.h = h ?? n.h; return n; });
  void setProp(String id, String key, dynamic value) => _mutate(id, (n){ n.props = {...n.props, key: value}; return n; });
  void _mutate(String id, Node Function(Node) f) {
    final nodes = [...state.nodes];
    final idx = nodes.indexWhere((n)=>n.id==id);
    if (idx>=0) nodes[idx] = f(nodes[idx]);
    state = ProjectState(tokens: state.tokens, breakpoints: state.breakpoints, pages: state.pages, components: state.components, nodes: nodes, currentPageId: state.currentPageId);
  }
  Map<String, dynamic> toSnapshot() => {
    'tokens': {'color': state.tokens.color, 'spacing': state.tokens.spacing, 'type': state.tokens.type},
    'breakpoints': [for (final bp in state.breakpoints) {'name': bp.name, 'min': bp.min}],
    'pages': [for (final p in state.pages) {'id': p.id, 'name': p.name}],
    'components': [for (final c in state.components) {'id': c.id, 'props': c.props, 'variants': c.variants}],
    'nodes': [for (final n in state.nodes) {'id': n.id, 'pageId': n.pageId, 'type': _t(n.type), 'x': n.x, 'y': n.y, 'w': n.w, 'h': n.h, 'rotation': n.rotation, 'props': n.props, 'parentId': n.parentId}],
  };
  String _t(NodeType t) => switch (t) { NodeType.container=>'Container', NodeType.text=>'Text', NodeType.image=>'Image', NodeType.component=>'Component', NodeType.code=>'Code' };
}
""")

w(os.path.join(max_root, "apps/studio/lib/main.dart"), """
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:hooks_riverpod/hooks_riverpod.dart';
import 'state.dart';
import 'models.dart';
import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
// ignore: avoid_web_libraries_in_flutter
import 'dart:html' as html;

void main() => runApp(const ProviderScope(child: StudioApp()));

class StudioApp extends StatelessWidget {
  const StudioApp({super.key});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => MaterialApp(title: 'CreatorX Studio', theme: ThemeData.dark(useMaterial3: true), home: const Editor(), debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false);
}

class Editor extends ConsumerStatefulWidget { const Editor({super.key}); @override ConsumerState<Editor> createState()=>_EditorState(); }
class _EditorState extends ConsumerState<Editor> {
  double deviceW = 1200; double deviceH = 800; final grid=8.0;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final proj = ref.watch(projectProvider);
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('CreatorX Studio'), actions: [
        TextButton(onPressed: () => _publish(ref), child: const Text('Publish')),
        const SizedBox(width: 12),
        TextButton(onPressed: () => _downloadCtrx(ref), child: const Text('Download .ctrx')),
        const SizedBox(width: 12),
      ]),
      body: Row(children: [
        SizedBox(width: 240, child: _LeftPanel(onAdd: (t)=>ref.read(projectProvider.notifier).addNode(t))),
        Expanded(child: Center(child: Container(
          width: deviceW, height: deviceH, decoration: BoxDecoration(border: Border.all(color: Colors.white24)),
          child: _Canvas(deviceW: deviceW, deviceH: deviceH, grid: grid),
        ))),
        SizedBox(width: 320, child: _RightPanel(onDevice: (w,h)=>setState(()=>{deviceW=w, deviceH=h})))
      ]),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _downloadCtrx(WidgetRef ref) async {
    final snap = ref.read(projectProvider.notifier).toSnapshot();
    // collect assets from Image nodes (dataUri->assets) (basic; UI for upload omitted here)
    final body = jsonEncode({'snapshot': snap, 'assets': []});
    final res = await http.post(Uri.parse('/api/export/ctrx'), headers: {'content-type':'application/json'}, body: body);
    if (res.statusCode == 200) {
      final blob = html.Blob([res.bodyBytes], 'application/creator_X_project');
      final url = html.Url.createObjectUrlFromBlob(blob);
      final a = html.AnchorElement(href: url)..download = 'project.ctrx'; html.document.body!.append(a); a.click(); a.remove(); html.Url.revokeObjectUrl(url);
      if (mounted) ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(content: Text('project.ctrx downloaded')));
    } else {
      if (mounted) ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('Export failed: ${res.statusCode}')));
    }
  }

  Future<void> _publish(WidgetRef ref) async {
    final snap = ref.read(projectProvider.notifier).toSnapshot();
    final res = await http.post(Uri.parse('/api/publish'), headers: {'content-type': 'application/json'}, body: jsonEncode(snap));
    if (res.statusCode == 200) {
      final json = jsonDecode(res.body) as Map<String, dynamic>;
      final url = json['viewUrl'] as String;
      if (mounted) ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('Published → $url')));
    } else {
      if (mounted) ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('Publish failed: ${res.statusCode}')));
    }
  }
}

class _LeftPanel extends StatelessWidget {
  const _LeftPanel({required this.onAdd});
  final void Function(NodeType) onAdd;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Container(color: const Color(0xFF111111), child: ListView(padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12), children: [
      const Text('Insert', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white70)),
      const SizedBox(height: 8),
      Wrap(spacing: 8, runSpacing: 8, children: [
        ElevatedButton(onPressed: ()=>onAdd(NodeType.text), child: const Text('Text')),
        ElevatedButton(onPressed: ()=>onAdd(NodeType.container), child: const Text('Container')),
        ElevatedButton(onPressed: ()=>onAdd(NodeType.image), child: const Text('Image')),
        ElevatedButton(onPressed: ()=>onAdd(NodeType.component), child: const Text('Component')),
      ]),
    ]));
  }
}

class _Canvas extends ConsumerWidget {
  const _Canvas({required this.deviceW, required this.deviceH, required this.grid});
  final double deviceW, deviceH, grid;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final proj = ref.watch(projectProvider);
    final nodes = proj.nodes.where((n)=>n.pageId==proj.currentPageId && n.parentId==null).toList();
    return GestureDetector(
      onPanStart: (_){},
      child: CustomPaint(
        painter: _GridPainter(grid: grid),
        child: Stack(children: [
          for (final n in nodes) Positioned(left: n.x, top: n.y, width: n.w, height: n.h, child: _NodeWidget(node: n, grid: grid)),
        ]),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _GridPainter extends CustomPainter {
  const _GridPainter({required this.grid});
  final double grid;
  @override void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final p = Paint()..color = const Color(0x11111111)..strokeWidth=1;
    for (double x=0;x<size.width;x+=grid) canvas.drawLine(Offset(x,0), Offset(x,size.height), p);
    for (double y=0;y<size.height;y+=grid) canvas.drawLine(Offset(0,y), Offset(size.width,y), p);
  }
  @override bool shouldRepaint(covariant CustomPainter oldDelegate) => false;
}

class _NodeWidget extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const _NodeWidget({required this.node, required this.grid});
  final Node node; final double grid;
  @override ConsumerState<_NodeWidget> createState()=>_NodeWidgetState();
}
class _NodeWidgetState extends ConsumerState<_NodeWidget> {
  bool hover=false;
  @override Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final n = widget.node;
    final proj = ref.watch(projectProvider);
    Widget child;
    switch (n.type) {
      case NodeType.container:
        final c = colorFrom(n.props['fill'], proj.tokens) ?? const Color(0xFF222222);
        child = Container(decoration: BoxDecoration(color: c, borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular((n.props['borderRadius']??8).toDouble())));
        break;
      case NodeType.text:
        child = Center(child: Text(n.props['text'] ?? 'Text', style: TextStyle(fontSize: (n.props['fontSize'] is String? (proj.tokens.type[(n.props['fontSize'] as String).split('.').last] ?? 16) : (n.props['fontSize'] ?? 16)).toDouble(), color: colorFrom(n.props['textColor'], proj.tokens) ?? Colors.white)));
        break;
      default:
        child = Container(decoration: BoxDecoration(color: const Color(0xFF2A2A2A), border: Border.all(color: Colors.white10)));
    }
    return MouseRegion(
      onEnter: (_)=>setState(()=>hover=true),
      onExit: (_)=>setState(()=>hover=false),
      child: Stack(clipBehavior: Clip.none, children: [
        child,
        if (hover) Positioned(right:-10,bottom:-10, child: GestureDetector(
          onPanUpdate:(d){ ref.read(projectProvider.notifier).resize(n.id, w: n.w + d.delta.dx, h: n.h + d.delta.dy); },
          child: Container(width:16,height:16,decoration: BoxDecoration(color: Colors.white, border: Border.all(color: Colors.blue,width:2)))
        )),
        Positioned.fill(child: GestureDetector(
          onPanUpdate: (d){ final dx=(d.delta.dx/widget.grid).roundToDouble()*widget.grid; final dy=(d.delta.dy/widget.grid).roundToDouble()*widget.grid; ref.read(projectProvider.notifier).move(n.id, dx, dy); },
        )),
      ]),
    );
  }
}
""")
