# A) Build **dartvel** (framework)

**Goal**: an Expo/Next-like framework for Dart/Shelf with file-based routes (pages + api) and a CLI to develop and build apps.

### A1. Repository Layout

dartvel/
├─ README.md
├─ LICENSE
├─ CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md
├─ AI_AGENT.md
└─ packages/
├─ dartvel_core/
│ ├─ pubspec.yaml
│ └─ lib/dartvel.dart # Server.mount, Res helpers, CORS, static helper
├─ dartvel_cli/
│ ├─ pubspec.yaml
│ └─ bin/dartvel.dart # CLI: dev, routes, build, doctor, new
└─ dartvel_flutter/
│ ├─ pubspec.yaml
│ └─ lib/dartvel_flutter.dart # Placeholder for Flutter helpers
└─ examples/
└─ minapp/
├─ pubspec.yaml
├─ dartvel.yaml
├─ pages/index.page.dart
├─ api/hello.get.dart
└─ static/index.html

Always show details


### A2. Features

- **dartvel_core**
  - `Server.mount(apiRoutes, pageRoutes)`: mounts routes with all verbs (and OPTIONS+CORS).
  - `Res` helpers: `json`, `html`, `text`, `bytes`, `notFound` (sets correct content-type, utf-8).
  - `cors()` middleware (configurable origins/headers/methods).
  - `staticHandler(root, defaultDocument)` wrapper over `shelf_static`.
- **dartvel_cli**
  - `dev`: parse **`dartvel.yaml`**, generate `.dart_tool/dartvel_routes.g.dart`, ensure `.dart_tool/dartvel_server.dart`, run server, log URL.
  - `routes`: regenerate route file only.
  - `build`: emit a production server entry into `dist/` and copy `/static/**` (if present); honor `--port`, `--host`.
  - `doctor`: check Dart SDK, parse/validate yaml, port availability.
  - `new <name>`: scaffold a new app with `dartvel.yaml`, example page/api, and `static/`.
  - **Dynamic routes**: support `[id]` and `[...slug]` style routes.
  - **Watch mode** in `dev`: watches `dartvel.yaml`, `/pages`, `/api`, regenerates routes, restarts server.
- **examples/minapp**:
  - Demonstrates pages/api/static and dynamic route `[id].page.dart`.
  - `README` snippet with `dartvel dev` quick start.

### A3. `dartvel.yaml` schema (documented in README and validated in CLI)

```yaml
app: { name: MyApp, slug: myapp }
runtime: { port: 3000 }
static: static/
routes:
  pages:
    "/": pages/index.page.dart
    "/users/[id]": pages/users/[id].page.dart
  api:
    "/api/hello": api/hello.get.dart
A4. Acceptance Criteria (CLI)
dartvel dev → generates routes, starts server, logs URL, hot-reloads on route/yaml changes.

dartvel routes → regenerates route file without starting server.

dartvel build → creates dist/ with a production entry and copies static assets.

dartvel doctor → prints diagnostics; returns non-zero on schema error.

Example app works: / returns HTML, /api/hello returns JSON, /users/42 works.

w(cx / "api" / "import" / "flutter_project.post.dart", r"""
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:typed_data';
import 'package:archive/archive.dart';
import 'package:dartvel_core/dartvel.dart';

class _Conv {
  static Map<String, dynamic> parsePubspec(String s) {
    final lines = const LineSplitter().convert(s);
    final assets = <String>[];
    String? name;
    for (var i=0;i<lines.length;i++) {
      final l = lines[i].trimRight();
      final mName = RegExp(r'^name:\s*([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*$').firstMatch(l);
      if (mName != null) name = mName.group(1);
      if (l.trim() == 'assets:' or l.trim() == '  assets:' or l.trim() == 'flutter:' or l.trim().startsWith('assets:')) {}
    }
    // extremely naive asset block scan
    bool inFlutter=false, inAssets=false;
    for (final l0 in lines) {
      final l=l0.trimRight();
      if (l.startsWith('flutter:')) { inFlutter=true; continue; }
      if (inFlutter && l.trimLeft().startsWith('assets:')) { inAssets=true; continue; }
      if (inFlutter && inAssets) {
        if (l.trimLeft().startsWith('- ')) {
          final path = l.trimLeft().substring(2).trim();
          if (path.isNotEmpty) assets.add(path);
        } else if (l.trimLeft().isEmpty) {
          // ignore
        } else if (!l.startsWith(' ')) {
          // dedent -> out of assets
          inAssets=false; inFlutter=false;
        }
      }
    }
    return {'name': name ?? 'flutter_app', 'assets': assets};
  }

  static Map<String, dynamic> convertDartToNodes(String code) {
    // Very naive heuristic parser extracting Text/Container/Image.asset occurrences in main.dart
    final nodes = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    final pageId = 'main';
    int i = 0;
    for (final m in RegExp(r'Text\(\s*([\"\\\'])(.+?)\1').allMatches(code)) {
      nodes.add({'id':'n_text_${i++}','pageId':pageId,'type':'Text','x':40,'y':40+ i*60,'w':360,'h':40,'props':{'text':m.group(2),'fontSize':18,'textColor':'#FFFFFFFF'}});
    }
    for (final m in RegExp(r'Image\.asset\(\s*([\"\\\'])(.+?)\1').allMatches(code)) {
      final path = m.group(2);
      nodes.add({'id':'n_img_${i++}','pageId':pageId,'type':'Image','x':60,'y':40+ i*60,'w':160,'h':120,'props':{'src':path}});
    }
    // Container with color (0xFF... or Colors.xxx)
    for (final m in RegExp(r'Container\(\s*.*?color:\s*(0x[0-9A-Fa-f]{8}|Colors\.[A-Za-z_]+)', dotAll: true).allMatches(code)) {
      nodes.add({'id':'n_box_${i++}','pageId':pageId,'type':'Container','x':30,'y':40+ i*60,'w':240,'h':100,'props':{'fill':'#FF333333','borderRadius':8}});
    }
    return {'pageId':pageId, 'nodes':nodes};
  }
}

Future<ResponseType> handler(Request req) async {
  final Map<String, dynamic> inb = jsonDecode(await req.readAsString());
  final data = base64Decode(inb['zipBase64'] as String);
  final arc = ZipDecoder().decodeBytes(data);

  String? pubspec;
  String mainDart = '';
  final assetFiles = <String, List<int>>{};

  for (final f in arc) {
    if (f.isFile) {
      final name = f.name.replaceAll('\\', '/');
      if (name.endsWith('pubspec.yaml')) {
        pubspec = utf8.decode(f.content as List<int>);
      } else if (name.endsWith('lib/main.dart')) {
        mainDart = utf8.decode(f.content as List<int>);
      } else if (name.startsWith('assets/') || name.contains('/assets/')) {
        assetFiles[name] = (f.content as List<int>);
      }
    }
  }

  if (pubspec == null) {
    return Res.text('pubspec.yaml not found', status: 400);
  }

  final spec = _Conv.parsePubspec(pubspec);
  final conv = _Conv.convertDartToNodes(mainDart);

  final snapshot = {
    'tokens': {
      'color': {'primary': '#FF6750A4', 'bg': '#FF121212', 'onPrimary': '#FFFFFFFF'},
      'spacing': {'s':8,'m':16,'l':24},
      'type': {'h1':32,'body':16}
    },
    'pages': [{'id': conv['pageId'], 'name': spec['name'] ?? 'Main'}],
    'nodes': List<Map<String,dynamic>>.from(conv['nodes'] as List)
  };

  final warnings = <String>[];
  if ((conv['nodes'] as List).isEmpty) {
    warnings.add('No recognizable widgets found (Text, Image.asset, Container with color) in lib/main.dart. Snapshot uses defaults.');
  }

  return Res.json(jsonEncode({
    'snapshot': snapshot,
    'assetsFound': assetFiles.keys.toList(),
    'warnings': warnings,
  }), headers: {'access-control-allow-origin':'*'});
}
""")

import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:typed_data';
import 'package:archive/archive.dart';
import 'package:dartvel_core/dartvel.dart';
import '../lib_bridge/ctrx_format_bridge.dart' as bridge;

Future<ResponseType> handler(Request req) async {
  final Map<String, dynamic> inb = jsonDecode(await req.readAsString());
  final snapshot = (inb['snapshot'] as Map).cast<String, dynamic>();
  final assetsArr = (inb['assets'] as List?) ?? const [];
  final assets = <String, Uint8List>{};
  for (final a in assetsArr) {
    final path = (a['path'] as String);
    final b64 = a['base64'] as String?;
    if (b64 != null) {
      final key = path.startsWith('assets/') ? path : 'assets/$path';
      assets[key] = Uint8List.fromList(base64Decode(b64));
    }
  }
  final signing = inb['signingKeyBase64'] as String?;
  final bytes = await bridge.encodeCtrx(snapshot, assets: assets, signingKeyBase64: signing);
  return Res.bytes(bytes, headers: {
    'content-type': 'application/creator_X_project',
    'content-disposition': 'attachment; filename="converted.ctrx"',
    'access-control-allow-origin': '*'
  });
}
""")

w("api/import/flutter_project.post.dart", r"""
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:typed_data';
import 'package:archive/archive.dart';
import 'package:dartvel_core/dartvel.dart';

class _Conv {
  static Map<String, dynamic> parsePubspec(String s) {
    final lines = const LineSplitter().convert(s);
    final assets = <String>[];
    String? name;
    bool inFlutter=false, inAssets=false;
    for (final l0 in lines) {
      final l=l0;
      final mName = RegExp(r'^name:\s*([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*$').firstMatch(l.trim());
      if (mName != null) name = mName.group(1);
      if (l.startsWith('flutter:')) { inFlutter=true; continue; }
      if (inFlutter && l.trimLeft().startsWith('assets:')) { inAssets=true; continue; }
      if (inFlutter && inAssets) {
        if (l.trimLeft().startsWith('- ')) {
          final path = l.trimLeft().substring(2).trim();
          if (path.isNotEmpty) assets.add(path);
        } else if (l.isEmpty) {
        } else if (!l.startsWith(' ')) {
          inAssets=false; inFlutter=false;
        }
      }
    }
    return {'name': name ?? 'flutter_app', 'assets': assets};
  }

  static Map<String, dynamic> convertDartToNodes(String code) {
    final nodes = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    final pageId = 'main';
    int i = 0;
    for (final m in RegExp(r'Text\(\s*([\"\\\'])(.+?)\1').allMatches(code)) {
      nodes.add({'id':'n_text_${i}','pageId':pageId,'type':'Text','x':40,'y':40+ i*60,'w':360,'h':40,'props':{'text':m.group(2),'fontSize':18,'textColor':'#FFFFFFFF'}});
      i++;
    }
    for (final m in RegExp(r'Image\.asset\(\s*([\"\\\'])(.+?)\1').allMatches(code)) {
      final path = m.group(2);
      nodes.add({'id':'n_img_${i}','pageId':pageId,'type':'Image','x':60,'y':40+ i*60,'w':160,'h':120,'props':{'src':path}});
      i++;
    }
    for (final m in RegExp(r'Container\(\s*.*?color:\s*(0x[0-9A-Fa-f]{8}|Colors\.[A-Za-z_]+)', dotAll: true).allMatches(code)) {
      nodes.add({'id':'n_box_${i}','pageId':pageId,'type':'Container','x':30,'y':40+ i*60,'w':240,'h':100,'props':{'fill':'#FF333333','borderRadius':8}});
      i++;
    }
    return {'pageId':pageId, 'nodes':nodes};
  }
}

Future<ResponseType> handler(Request req) async {
  final Map<String, dynamic> inb = jsonDecode(await req.readAsString());
  final data = base64Decode(inb['zipBase64'] as String);
  final arc = ZipDecoder().decodeBytes(data);

  String? pubspec;
  String mainDart = '';
  final assetFiles = <String, List<int>>{};

  for (final f in arc) {
    if (f.isFile) {
      final name = f.name.replaceAll('\\', '/');
      if (name.endswith('pubspec.yaml')) {
        pubspec = utf8.decode(f.content as List<int>);
      } else if (name.endswith('lib/main.dart')) {
        mainDart = utf8.decode(f.content as List[int>);
      } else if (name.startsWith('assets/') or name.contains('/assets/')) {
        assetFiles[name] = (f.content as List[int>);
      }
    }
  }

  if (pubspec == null) {
    return Res.text('pubspec.yaml not found', status: 400);
  }

  final spec = _Conv.parsePubspec(pubspec);
  final conv = _Conv.convertDartToNodes(mainDart);

  final snapshot = {
    'tokens': {
      'color': {'primary': '#FF6750A4', 'bg': '#FF121212', 'onPrimary': '#FFFFFFFF'},
      'spacing': {'s':8,'m':16,'l':24},
      'type': {'h1':32,'body':16}
    },
    'pages': [{'id': conv['pageId'], 'name': spec['name'] ?? 'Main'}],
    'nodes': List<Map<String,dynamic>>.from(conv['nodes'] as List)
  };

  final warnings = <String>[];
  if ((conv['nodes'] as List).isEmpty) {
    warnings.add('No recognizable widgets found (Text, Image.asset, Container with color) in lib/main.dart. Snapshot uses defaults.');
  }

  return Res.json(jsonEncode({
    'snapshot': snapshot,
    'assetsFound': assetFiles.keys.toList(),
    'warnings': warnings,
  }), headers: {'access-control-allow-origin':'*'});
}
""")

w("api/convert/flutter_project.post.dart", r"""
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:typed_data';
import 'package:dartvel_core/dartvel.dart';
import '../lib_bridge/ctrx_format_bridge.dart' as bridge;

Future<ResponseType> handler(Request req) async {
  final Map<String, dynamic> inb = jsonDecode(await req.readAsString());
  final snapshot = (inb['snapshot'] as Map).cast<String, dynamic>();
  final assetsArr = (inb['assets'] as List?) ?? const [];
  final assets = <String, Uint8List>{};
  for (final a in assetsArr) {
    final path = (a['path'] as String);
    final b64 = a['base64'] as String?;
    if (b64 != null) {
      final key = path.startsWith('assets/') ? path : 'assets/$path';
      assets[key] = Uint8List.fromList(base64Decode(b64));
    }
  }
  final signing = inb['signingKeyBase64'] as String?;
  final bytes = await bridge.encodeCtrx(snapshot, assets: assets, signingKeyBase64: signing);
  return Res.bytes(bytes, headers: {
    'content-type': 'application/creator_X_project',
    'content-disposition': 'attachment; filename="converted.ctrx"',
    'access-control-allow-origin': '*'
  });
}
""")

How the import/convert works
1) Import a Flutter project ZIP
Endpoint: POST /api/import/flutter_project

Body:

{ "zipBase64": "<base64 of a zipped Flutter project>" }
What it does:

Reads pubspec.yaml to detect the app name and assets block.

Heuristically parses lib/main.dart to find Text(...), Image.asset(...), and Container(color: ...) and builds a first-pass CreatorX snapshot.

Returns:

{
  "snapshot": { ... },          // a ready-to-load CreatorX snapshot
  "assetsFound": ["assets/..."],
  "warnings": ["..."]           // if nothing recognizable was found, etc.
}
Note: First pass = heuristic. It’s deliberately conservative and won’t try to decompile complex widget trees. It gives you a runnable head start you can then refine in the editor.

2) Convert to .ctrx
Endpoint: POST /api/convert/flutter_project

Body:

{
  "snapshot": { ... },               // snapshot, e.g. from the import step
  "assets": [{ "path": "assets/foo.png", "base64": "..." }],
  "signingKeyBase64": "..."          // optional Ed25519 seed for COSE
}
What it returns: .ctrx file bytes with MIME application/creator_X_project, including snapshot.json, snapshot.cbor, optional signature.sig, and bundled assets/**.

Love it — here’s a clean, dartvel v2 design that matches your vision exactly.

dartvel v2 — pubspec-driven, normal Dart project layout
1) What changes
No dartvel.yaml. All config now lives inside pubspec.yaml under a top-level dartvel: key.

Normal package layout. Your app uses the regular lib/ folder. Inside it, dartvel expects:

lib/pages/ → file-system routed pages (.page.dart)

lib/backend/ → backend surface:

functions/ → HTTP functions (.get.dart, .post.dart, …)

dbCollections/ → collection schemas & hooks

authentication.dart

web_push.dart

remoteFileStorageConfig.dart

Generated files go exclusively under .dart_tool/ (e.g. dartvel_routes.g.dart, dartvel_backend.g.dart, server entry).

All of the above are configurable via pubspec.yaml: dartvel: { … } (e.g., you can rename pagesDir/backendDir).

2) Example pubspec.yaml (with dartvel: key)
name: my_app
description: Example dartvel v2 app
version: 0.1.0
environment:
  sdk: ">=3.4.0 <4.0.0"

dependencies:
  shelf: ^1.4.1
  shelf_router: ^1.1.4
  shelf_static: ^1.1.2
  yaml: ^3.1.2
  path: ^1.9.0
  # dartvel core runtime
  dartvel_core:
    path: ../dartvel/packages/dartvel_core

dev_dependencies:
  lints: ^4.0.0
  # dartvel CLI (generates routes & server entry)
  dartvel_cli:
    path: ../dartvel/packages/dartvel_cli

dartvel:
  # dev server
  port: 3000
  host: 0.0.0.0
  staticDir: web_build              # optional; served at /static/*
  # directories (default pagesDir: lib/pages, backendDir: lib/backend)
  pagesDir: lib/pages
  backendDir: lib/backend
  # URL bases
  basePath: /
  apiBasePath: /api
  # routing options
  routing:
    dynamicSegments: true           # [id], [[...slug]]
    decodeUriParameters: true
  # SSR (optional; pluggable adapter – future-friendly)
  ssr:
    enabled: false
    engine: jaspr
  # auth & storage knobs (consumed by your backend modules)
  auth:
    sessionCookieName: dv_session
    providers: [email_password, oauth_google]
  storage:
    provider: local                 # local | s3 | gcs
    localDir: runtime_uploads
3) Project layout (default)
my_app/
├─ pubspec.yaml
├─ .dart_tool/
│  ├─ dartvel_routes.g.dart          # generated: pages + backend HTTP
│  ├─ dartvel_backend.g.dart         # generated: auth/hooks, collections wiring
│  └─ dartvel_server.dart            # generated: dev/prod entry
├─ lib/
│  ├─ pages/
│  │  ├─ index.page.dart
│  │  └─ blog/[id].page.dart         # dynamic segment
│  └─ backend/
│     ├─ functions/
│     │  ├─ hello.get.dart
│     │  └─ upload.post.dart
│     ├─ dbCollections/
│     │  ├─ users.collection.dart
│     │  └─ posts.collection.dart
│     ├─ authentication.dart
│     ├─ web_push.dart
│     └─ remoteFileStorageConfig.dart
└─ web_build/                         # (optional) static assets you want served at /static/*
Change pagesDir, backendDir, staticDir in pubspec.yaml: dartvel: if you prefer a different structure.

4) File-system routing rules
Pages (lib/pages/**.page.dart)
Maps files to routes:

index.page.dart → /

about.page.dart → /about

blog/[id].page.dart → /blog/:id

docs/[...slug].page.dart → /docs/*slug (catch-all)

Nested folders mirror URL segments.

Signature:

// lib/pages/index.page.dart
import 'package:dartvel_core/dartvel.dart';

Future<ResponseType> handler(Request req) async {
  return Res.html('<h1>Hello from dartvel v2</h1>');
}
Backend functions (lib/backend/functions/**)
HTTP endpoints under apiBasePath (default /api).

Filename drives method + path:

functions/hello.get.dart → GET /api/hello

functions/user.post.dart → POST /api/user

Nested: functions/admin/users.get.dart → GET /api/admin/users

Optional .any.dart to accept all methods.

Signature:

// lib/backend/functions/hello.get.dart
import 'package:dartvel_core/dartvel.dart';

Future<ResponseType> handler(Request req) async {
  return Res.json({'message': 'hello'});
}
5) Backend surface (firebase-like)
These are first-class files under lib/backend/ that the generator wires via .dart_tool/dartvel_backend.g.dart:

authentication.dart
Declares providers (email/password, OAuth…), session cookie name, optional JWT secret (never hardcode; read from env).

Exposes middleware helpers: requireAuth(), currentUser(req).

// lib/backend/authentication.dart
class AuthConfig {
  final List<String> providers;
  final String sessionCookieName;
  const AuthConfig({required this.providers, required this.sessionCookieName});
}

const authConfig = AuthConfig(
  providers: ['email_password', 'oauth_google'],
  sessionCookieName: 'dv_session',
);

// Minimal stub; you’d implement signIn/verify, etc.
dbCollections/*
Define collections (schema + hooks). Start simple: shape and basic constraints.

// lib/backend/dbCollections/users.collection.dart
class Users {
  static const name = 'users';
  static Map<String, dynamic> schema() => {
    'id': 'string',
    'email': 'string',
    'displayName': 'string?',
    'createdAt': 'int',
  };
}
web_push.dart
Declare VAPID/public key pair config and subscribe endpoint wiring (the CLI can expose a default /api/push/subscribe if present).

remoteFileStorageConfig.dart
Choose storage provider (local/S3/GCS). The server mounts upload + serving helpers based on this.

// lib/backend/remoteFileStorageConfig.dart
class StorageConfig {
  final String provider;   // local | s3 | gcs
  final String localDir;
  const StorageConfig({this.provider = 'local', this.localDir = 'runtime_uploads'});
}
const storage = StorageConfig();
6) What the CLI does (v2)
Commands keep the Expo/Next-like flow, but now read pubspec.yaml: dartvel:.

dartvel dev

Reads config from pubspec.yaml.

Scans lib/pages & lib/backend/functions and generates:

.dart_tool/dartvel_routes.g.dart (pages + HTTP functions map)

.dart_tool/dartvel_backend.g.dart (auth, storage, collections bootstrap)

.dart_tool/dartvel_server.dart (server entry)

Starts the dev server with watch mode. Regenerates & hot-restarts on file changes.

dartvel routes

Re-generate routes without running the server.

dartvel build

Emit a production server entry under .dart_tool/ and copy staticDir to dist/static (optional).

Print a route table with methods/paths.

dartvel doctor

Validate pubspec.yaml: dartvel: schema, check port availability, SDK, and that mandatory dirs exist.

dartvel new <name>

Scaffold a new app using the v2 layout and config.

Generated server entry (shape):

// .dart_tool/dartvel_server.dart
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:shelf/shelf.dart' as shelf;
import 'package:shelf/shelf_io.dart' as io;
import 'package:dartvel_core/dartvel.dart';
import 'dartvel_routes.g.dart' as rt;
import 'dartvel_backend.g.dart' as bk;

Future<void> main(List<String> args) async {
  final app = Server.mount(rt.apiRoutes, rt.pageRoutes,
      staticDir: bk.staticDir, apiBasePath: bk.apiBasePath);

  final port = bk.port;
  final server = await io.serve(
    const shelf.Pipeline()
      .addMiddleware(cors())
      .addMiddleware(shelf.logRequests())
      .addHandler(app),
    InternetAddress.anyIPv4,
    port,
  );
  print('dartvel v2 running: http://localhost:${server.port}');
}
7) Minimal dartvel_core surface (v2)
Server.mount(Map<String,Handler> api, Map<String,Handler> pages, {String? staticDir, String apiBasePath = "/api"})

Res helpers: json(), html(), text(), bytes(), notFound()

cors() middleware

staticHandler(root, {defaultDocument})

Handlers use the same signature everywhere:

typedef Handler = Future<ResponseType> Function(Request req);
8) Example pages & functions
// lib/pages/index.page.dart

dartvel v2.1 (pubspec-driven, Flutter pages)
What changed
Pages are Flutter widgets, not server responses. Each file in lib/pages/**/<name>.page.dart must export a class that extends DartvelPage.

The CLI generates a tiny Flutter runner and router (in .dart_tool/dartvel_client/) that imports your pages and wires file-system routes → Flutter routes.

Backend stays Shelf/Dart for APIs only (JSON/bytes etc.). No HTML rendering from the server at all.

Config is still under pubspec.yaml → dartvel: (no dartvel.yaml).

pubspec.yaml (snippet)
name: my_app
description: Example dartvel v2.1 app

  dartvel_flutter:
    path: ../dartvel/packages/dartvel_flutter

dev_dependencies:

    sdk: flutter
  dartvel_cli:
    path: ../dartvel/packages/dartvel_cli
  lints: ^4.0.0

flutter:
  uses-material-design: true

dartvel:
  port: 3000
  host: 0.0.0.0
  staticDir: web_build
  pagesDir: lib/pages
  backendDir: lib/backend
  basePath: /
  apiBasePath: /api

    dynamicSegments: true      # [id], [...slug]

Pages API (Flutter)
Base class (in dartvel_flutter)
// package:dartvel_flutter/dartvel_flutter.dart
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';

/// Marker base class for all dartvel pages.
abstract class DartvelPage extends StatelessWidget {
  const DartvelPage({super.key});
}

/// Route state injected by the router so pages can read params/query.
class DartvelRouteState extends InheritedWidget {
  final Map<String, String> params;   // e.g. {'id': '42'}
  final Map<String, String> query;    // e.g. {'q': 'search'}
  const DartvelRouteState({
    super.key,
    required this.params,
    required this.query,
    required Widget child,
  }) : super(child: child);

  static DartvelRouteState of(BuildContext context) =>
      context.dependOnInheritedWidgetOfExactType<DartvelRouteState>()!;
  @override
  bool updateShouldNotify(DartvelRouteState old) =>
      params != old.params || query != old.query;
}

extension DartvelRouteX on BuildContext {
  Map<String, String> get dvParams => DartvelRouteState.of(this).params;
  Map<String, String> get dvQuery => DartvelRouteState.of(this).query;
}

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Home')),
      body: Center(
        child: Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: [
          const Text('Hello from dartvel v2.1 (Flutter pages)'),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          FilledButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pushNamed('/blog/42'),

}
lib/pages/blog/[id].page.dart

You don’t specify the route path in code; it’s derived from the file path.
The CLI finds class .* extends DartvelPage in each *.page.dart and generates the router.

What the CLI generates for pages
.dart_tool/dartvel_client/pubspec.yaml — a tiny Flutter app depending on your package (by name/path).

.dart_tool/dartvel_client/lib/main.dart — a MaterialApp.router using go_router, imports your page files via package:<your_pkg>/pages/....

.dart_tool/dartvel_client/lib/router.g.dart — route table compiled from filesystem:

lib/pages/index.page.dart → /

lib/pages/about.page.dart → /about

lib/pages/blog/[id].page.dart → /blog/:id

lib/pages/docs/[...slug].page.dart → /docs/*slug

The router builder wraps each page in a DartvelRouteState so you can read context.dvParams and context.dvQuery.

The CLI then runs:

flutter run -d chrome -t .dart_tool/dartvel_client/lib/main.dart --web-port <auto>
…and starts the backend server too (below), proxying /api/* to the Shelf server.

Backend (Shelf) remains API-only
Keep your server code under lib/backend/:

functions/**.get.dart|post.dart|… → HTTP handlers (JSON/bytes), no HTML.

dbCollections/*, authentication.dart, web_push.dart, remoteFileStorageConfig.dart.

CLI generates:

.dart_tool/dartvel_routes.g.dart (HTTP function map)

.dart_tool/dartvel_backend.g.dart (auth/storage bootstrap)

.dart_tool/dartvel_server.dart (Shelf entry)

The dev command runs this server on your configured dartvel.port and proxies /api/* from the Flutter dev server to it.

Example function:

// lib/backend/functions/hello.get.dart
import 'package:dartvel_core/dartvel.dart';

Future<ResponseType> handler(Request req) async {
  return Res.json({'ok': true, 'hello': 'world'});
}
Dynamic & catch-all routing (pages)
[id].page.dart → /segment/:id (params via context.dvParams['id'])

[...slug].page.dart → /segment/*slug (array split by / available via dvParams['slug'], decoded)

Commands
# dev: runs Flutter (web) router + Shelf backend, with watch/restart
dart run dartvel_cli:dev

# regen routes only (pages+backend)
dart run dartvel_cli:routes

# build (produces a dist server, copies staticDir)
dart run dartvel_cli:build

Config lives in pubspec.yaml → dartvel:.

Absolutely—locking this in.

Here’s the dartvel v2.1 config update and the exact code you’ll need so Flutter knows which backend URL to call in dev vs production, plus the server binds to the right host/port.

1) pubspec.yaml (under dartvel:)
Replace the old host/port with:

dartvel:
  # Where the Shelf backend binds locally during dev/build
  backendHost: 0.0.0.0        # (this replaces 'host')
  backendPort: 3000           # (this replaces 'port')

  # Which URL the Flutter app should call at runtime:
  # - dev: while running from 'flutter run' (web/simulator/device)
  # - prod: a fixed URL baked into a release build
  devBackendHost: http://localhost:3000
  prodBackendHost: https://api.example.com

  # Usual dirs (configurable)
  pagesDir: lib/pages
  backendDir: lib/backend
  apiBasePath: /api
  routing:
    dynamicSegments: true
    decodeUriParameters: true
Tip (emulators/devices): if you run the app on an Android emulator, set
devBackendHost: http://10.0.2.2:3000.
On iOS simulator, http://localhost:3000 is fine. On a real device, use your machine’s LAN IP.

2) What the CLI generates for Flutter (compile-time constants)
The CLI reads pubspec.yaml → dartvel and emits:

.dart_tool/dartvel_client/dartvel_config.g.dart

// GENERATED – do not edit by hand.
library dartvel_client_config;

const String dvBackendBindHost = '0.0.0.0';       // dartvel.backendHost
const int    dvBackendPort      = 3000;            // dartvel.backendPort
const String dvDevBackendHost   = 'http://localhost:3000';
const String dvProdBackendHost  = 'https://api.example.com';
const String dvApiBasePath      = '/api';
.dart_tool/dartvel_client/dartvel_runtime.dart

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart' show kReleaseMode;
import 'dartvel_config.g.dart' as cfg;

/// Runtime helper for the Flutter side.
class DartvelRuntime {
  /// Allows `--dart-define=DARTVEL_BACKEND_URL=...` to override at build/run time.
  static const String _override =
      String.fromEnvironment('DARTVEL_BACKEND_URL', defaultValue: '');

  /// Base URL the Flutter app should use for API calls.
  static String get baseUrl {
    if (_override.isNotEmpty) return _override;
    return kReleaseMode ? cfg.dvProdBackendHost : cfg.dvDevBackendHost;
  }

  static String get apiBasePath => cfg.dvApiBasePath;
  static Uri api(String path) {
    final base = baseUrl.endsWith('/') ? baseUrl.substring(0, baseUrl.length - 1) : baseUrl;
    final api  = apiBasePath.startsWith('/') ? apiBasePath : '/$apiBasePath';
    final sub  = path.startsWith('/') ? path : '/$path';
    return Uri.parse('$base$api$sub');
  }
}
The CLI also keeps generating the Shelf server entry that uses backendHost + backendPort for binding.

3) Backend server bind (Shelf entry uses the new keys)
.dart_tool/dartvel_server.dart (generated)

import 'dart:io';
import 'package:shelf/shelf.dart' as shelf;
import 'package:shelf/shelf_io.dart' as io;
import 'dartvel_routes.g.dart' as rt;     // generated HTTP function map
import 'dartvel_backend.g.dart' as bk;    // generated config snapshot (host/port)

Future<void> main(List<String> args) async {
  final handler = const shelf.Pipeline()
      .addMiddleware(shelf.logRequests())
      .addHandler(rt.backendHandler);

  final server = await io.serve(
    handler,
    InternetAddress.tryParse(bk.backendHost) ?? InternetAddress.anyIPv4,
    bk.backendPort,
  );
  print('dartvel backend → http://${server.address.address}:${server.port}');
}
.dart_tool/dartvel_backend.g.dart (generated)

// GENERATED – do not edit by hand.
library dartvel_backend_config;

const String backendHost = '0.0.0.0';
const int    backendPort = 3000;
4) Using it in Flutter (one-liner base URL)
Anywhere in your app (or in dartvel_flutter helpers), just use:

import '.dart_tool/dartvel_client/dartvel_runtime.dart';

final uri = DartvelRuntime.api('/hello'); // -> dev: http://localhost:3000/api/hello
Example with Dio:

import 'package:dio/dio.dart';
import '.dart_tool/dartvel_client/dartvel_runtime.dart';

final dio = Dio(BaseOptions(baseUrl: DartvelRuntime.baseUrl));
final r = await dio.get(DartvelRuntime.api('/hello').toString());
Release builds will automatically use prodBackendHost.
You can force any build to a specific backend with:

flutter run --dart-define=DARTVEL_BACKEND_URL=https://staging.example.com
# or
flutter build web --dart-define=DARTVEL_BACKEND_URL=https://staging.example.com
5) CLI changes (what we’ll implement)
Parse from pubspec.yaml → dartvel:

backendHost (default 0.0.0.0)

backendPort (default 3000)

devBackendHost (default http://localhost:<backendPort>)

prodBackendHost (no default; error if missing when doing build)

Generate:

.dart_tool/dartvel_backend.g.dart (backend bind values)

.dart_tool/dartvel_client/dartvel_config.g.dart + dartvel_runtime.dart (Flutter constants & helpers)

Dev:

Start Shelf on backendHost:backendPort

Start flutter run and do not rewrite assets; app talks to devBackendHost

Build:

Validate prodBackendHost is set; emit production server entry; app uses prodBackendHost by default (unless overridden by --dart-define)

6) Backwards-compat migration (one line)
Rename port → backendPort

Add devBackendHost and prodBackendHost

Optionally set backendHost (replaces host; default 0.0.0.0)

Awesome—let’s bake SEO + transitions directly into the Flutter-side page model, while keeping pages as normal widgets.

Below is a drop-in API for dartvel_flutter plus how the generated router uses it. No HTML responses; pages are standard Flutter widgets that extend DartvelPage. SEO is applied at runtime on web only (no-op elsewhere) using a safe conditional import; transitions are applied through go_router custom transitions.

1) pubspec.yaml (new keys you already asked for + defaults for SEO/Transitions)
dartvel:
  backendHost: 0.0.0.0
  backendPort: 3000
  devBackendHost: http://localhost:3000
  prodBackendHost: https://api.example.com

  pagesDir: lib/pages
  backendDir: lib/backend
  apiBasePath: /api

  # Optional project-wide defaults (pages can override)
  seoDefaults:
    siteName: MyApp
    defaultTitle: MyApp
    defaultDescription: A beautiful app built with dartvel.
    defaultImage: assets/og_default.png          # normal Flutter asset; your app decides how to publish
    twitterHandle: "@myapp"

  transitions:
    default: fade                                # none | fade | slideLeft | slideUp | scale | sharedAxis
    durationMs: 220
    curve: easeInOut
The CLI will read these at generation time (for defaults) but page instances always win if they override.

2) dartvel_flutter — add SEO + Transition surfaces
Create/extend package:dartvel_flutter/dartvel_flutter.dart like this:

// lib/dartvel_flutter.dart
library dartvel_flutter;

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart' show kIsWeb;
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';

// Conditional SEO platform (web does real work, others no-op)
import 'src/seo_platform_stub.dart'
  if (dart.library.html) 'src/seo_platform_web.dart' as seo_platform;

/// Route state injected so pages can read params & query easily.
class DartvelRouteState extends InheritedWidget {
  final Map<String, String> params;
  final Map<String, String> query;
  const DartvelRouteState({
    super.key,
    required this.params,
    required this.query,
    required Widget child,
  }) : super(child: child);

  static DartvelRouteState of(BuildContext context) =>
      context.dependOnInheritedWidgetOfExactType<DartvelRouteState>()!;

  @override
  bool updateShouldNotify(DartvelRouteState old) =>
      params != old.params || query != old.query;
}

extension DartvelRouteX on BuildContext {
  Map<String, String> get dvParams => DartvelRouteState.of(this).params;
  Map<String, String> get dvQuery  => DartvelRouteState.of(this).query;
}

/// SEO props the page can return (web only; other platforms no-op).
class SeoProps {
  final String? title;
  final String? description;
  final String? canonicalUrl;      // absolute URL
  final String? imageUrl;          // absolute or cdn URL
  final String? siteName;
  final String? twitterHandle;     // e.g. @myapp
  final Map<String, String> extraMeta; // name->content for custom tags

  const SeoProps({
    this.title,
    this.description,
    this.canonicalUrl,
    this.imageUrl,
    this.siteName,
    this.twitterHandle,
    this.extraMeta = const {},
  });

  SeoProps merge(SeoProps other) => SeoProps(
    title: other.title ?? title,
    description: other.description ?? description,
    canonicalUrl: other.canonicalUrl ?? canonicalUrl,
    imageUrl: other.imageUrl ?? imageUrl,
    siteName: other.siteName ?? siteName,
    twitterHandle: other.twitterHandle ?? twitterHandle,
    extraMeta: {...extraMeta, ...other.extraMeta},
  );

  static const empty = SeoProps();
}

/// Transition types we support out of the box.
enum DvTransition { none, fade, slideLeft, slideUp, scale, sharedAxis }

class PageTransitionSpec {
  final DvTransition type;
  final Duration duration;
  final Curve curve;

  const PageTransitionSpec({
    this.type = DvTransition.fade,
    this.duration = const Duration(milliseconds: 220),
    this.curve = Curves.easeInOut,
  });

  static const none = PageTransitionSpec(type: DvTransition.none, duration: Duration(milliseconds: 0));
}

/// Base class for all Flutter pages in dartvel.
abstract class DartvelPage extends StatelessWidget {
  const DartvelPage({super.key});

  /// Pages can compute SEO based on params/query.
  /// Return `SeoProps.empty` to accept project defaults.
  SeoProps buildSeo(Map<String, String> params, Map<String, String> query) => SeoProps.empty;

  /// Pages can customize transitions.
  PageTransitionSpec get transition => const PageTransitionSpec();
}

/// Widget that applies SEO on web (no-op elsewhere).
class DartvelSeo extends StatelessWidget {
  final SeoProps props;
  final SeoProps defaults;
  final Widget child;
  const DartvelSeo({super.key, required this.props, required this.defaults, required this.child});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (kIsWeb) {
      final merged = defaults.merge(props);
      seo_platform.applySeo(merged);
    }
    return child;
  }
}

/// Helper to produce a page with the given transition spec.
/// (Used by the generated router.)
CustomTransitionPage<T> dvTransitionPage<T>({
  LocalKey? key,
  required Widget child,
  required PageTransitionSpec spec,
}) {
  if (spec.type == DvTransition.none) {
    return CustomTransitionPage<T>(
      key: key,
      child: child,
      transitionsBuilder: (c, a, sA, ch) => ch,
      transitionDuration: spec.duration,
      reverseTransitionDuration: spec.duration,
    );
  }

  Widget builder(BuildContext c, Animation<double> a, Animation<double> sA, Widget ch) {
    final curved = CurvedAnimation(parent: a, curve: spec.curve);
    switch (spec.type) {
      case DvTransition.fade:
        return FadeTransition(opacity: curved, child: ch);
      case DvTransition.slideLeft:
        return SlideTransition(position: Tween<Offset>(begin: const Offset(0.1, 0), end: Offset.zero).animate(curved), child: ch);
      case DvTransition.slideUp:
        return SlideTransition(position: Tween<Offset>(begin: const Offset(0, 0.08), end: Offset.zero).animate(curved), child: ch);
      case DvTransition.scale:
        return ScaleTransition(scale: Tween<double>(begin: 0.98, end: 1).animate(curved), child: ch);
      case DvTransition.sharedAxis:
        // Simplified shared-axis (fade+slideUp). You can swap for animated package later.
        final slide = SlideTransition(position: Tween<Offset>(begin: const Offset(0, 0.04), end: Offset.zero).animate(curved), child: ch);
        return FadeTransition(opacity: curved, child: slide);
      case DvTransition.none:
        return ch;
    }
  }

  return CustomTransitionPage<T>(
    key: key,
    child: child,
    transitionsBuilder: builder,
    transitionDuration: spec.duration,
    reverseTransitionDuration: spec.duration,
  );
}
Platform SEO helpers:

// lib/src/seo_platform_stub.dart  (used on mobile/desktop)
import '../dartvel_flutter.dart';
void applySeo(SeoProps _) {/* no-op off web */}
// lib/src/seo_platform_web.dart  (only compiled on web)
import 'dart:html' as html;
import '../dartvel_flutter.dart';

void _upsertMeta(String name, String content, {String attr = 'name'}) {
  if (content.isEmpty) return;
  final doc = html.document;
  final selector = 'meta[$attr="$name"]';
  html.MetaElement? el = doc.head!.querySelector(selector) as html.MetaElement?;
  el ??= html.MetaElement()..setAttribute(attr, name)..appendTo(doc.head!);
  el.content = content;
}

extension on html.Element {
  void appendTo(html.Element parent) => parent.append(this);
}

void applySeo(SeoProps p) {
  final doc = html.document;
  if (p.title != null) doc.title = p.title!;
  _upsertMeta('description', p.description ?? '');
  if (p.canonicalUrl != null) {
    // canonical link
    final head = doc.head!;
    final existing = head.querySelector('link[rel="canonical"]') as html.LinkElement?;
    final link = existing ?? (html.LinkElement()..rel = 'canonical')..href = p.canonicalUrl!;
    if (existing == null) head.append(link);
  }
  // OpenGraph
  _upsertMeta('og:title', p.title ?? '', attr: 'property');
  _upsertMeta('og:description', p.description ?? '', attr: 'property');
  if (p.imageUrl != null) _upsertMeta('og:image', p.imageUrl!, attr: 'property');
  if (p.siteName != null) _upsertMeta('og:site_name', p.siteName!, attr: 'property');

  // Twitter
  if (p.twitterHandle != null) _upsertMeta('twitter:site', p.twitterHandle!);
  _upsertMeta('twitter:title', p.title ?? '');
  _upsertMeta('twitter:description', p.description ?? '');
  if (p.imageUrl != null) _upsertMeta('twitter:image', p.imageUrl!);

  // Extras
  for (final e in p.extraMeta.entries) {
    _upsertMeta(e.key, e.value);
  }
}
If you prefer seo_renderer (or another library), you can swap the internals of seo_platform_web.dart to delegate to it—the public API above doesn’t change.

3) How the generated router uses it
The CLI generates a router that:

Parses params/query from GoRouterState.

Instantiates your page.

Wraps it with DartvelRouteState.

Applies project SEO defaults (from pubspec.yaml → dartvel.seoDefaults) merged with the page’s buildSeo.

Wraps the final widget in a transition page built from page.transition (or project default when unchanged).

Illustrative snippet from .dart_tool/dartvel_client/router.g.dart:

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import 'package:dartvel_flutter/dartvel_flutter.dart';
import 'dartvel_config.g.dart' as cfg; // generated consts (defaults)
import 'package:my_app/pages/index.page.dart' as p0;
import 'package:my_app/pages/blog/[id].page.dart' as p1;

final _defaultSeo = SeoProps(
  siteName: '{{siteName}}',                 // filled from pubspec
  title:    '{{defaultTitle}}',
  description: '{{defaultDescription}}',
  imageUrl: '{{defaultImage}}',
  twitterHandle: '{{twitterHandle}}',
);

final _projectDefaultTransition = PageTransitionSpec(
  type: DvTransition.{{defaultTransitionType}}, // e.g. fade
  duration: Duration(milliseconds: {{durationMs}}),
  curve: Curves.{{curveName}},                  // e.g. easeInOut
);

GoRouter createRouter() => GoRouter(
  routes: [
    GoRoute(
      path: '/',
      pageBuilder: (context, state) {
        final page = const p0.IndexPage();
        final params = Map<String, String>.from(state.pathParameters);
        final query = Map<String, String>.from(state.uri.queryParameters);
        final withState = DartvelRouteState(params: params, query: query, child: page);
        final seoWrapped = DartvelSeo(
          props: page.buildSeo(params, query),
          defaults: _defaultSeo,
          child: withState,
        );
        return dvTransitionPage(
          key: state.pageKey,
          child: seoWrapped,
          spec: page.transition == const PageTransitionSpec() ? _projectDefaultTransition : page.transition,
        );
      },
    ),
    GoRoute(
      path: '/blog/:id',
      pageBuilder: (context, state) {
        final page = const p1.BlogIdPage();
        final params = Map<String, String>.from(state.pathParameters);
        final query = Map<String, String>.from(state.uri.queryParameters);
        final withState = DartvelRouteState(params: params, query: query, child: page);
        final seoWrapped = DartvelSeo(
          props: page.buildSeo(params, query),
          defaults: _defaultSeo,
          child: withState,
        );
        return dvTransitionPage(
          key: state.pageKey,
          child: seoWrapped,
          spec: page.transition == const PageTransitionSpec() ? _projectDefaultTransition : page.transition,
        );
      },
    ),
  ],
);
The generator fills the {{…}} placeholders from your pubspec.yaml.
If a page returns SeoProps.empty, the defaults supply the full meta kit. If the page overrides only title, it’ll merge with the defaults for other fields.

4) Example pages using SEO + transitions
// lib/pages/index.page.dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:dartvel_flutter/dartvel_flutter.dart';

class IndexPage extends DartvelPage {
  const IndexPage({super.key});

  @override
  SeoProps buildSeo(Map<String, String> params, Map<String, String> query) =>
      const SeoProps(title: 'Home • MyApp', description: 'Welcome to MyApp!');

  @override
  PageTransitionSpec get transition =>
      const PageTransitionSpec(type: DvTransition.fade, duration: Duration(milliseconds: 180));

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Home')),
      body: Center(
        child: FilledButton(
          onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pushNamed('/blog/42'),
          child: const Text('Go to /blog/42'),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
// lib/pages/blog/[id].page.dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:dartvel_flutter/dartvel_flutter.dart';

class BlogIdPage extends DartvelPage {
  const BlogIdPage({super.key});

  @override
  SeoProps buildSeo(Map<String, String> params, Map<String, String> query) {
    final id = params['id']!;
    return SeoProps(
      title: 'Blog $id • MyApp',
      description: 'Reading blog post $id on MyApp.',
      canonicalUrl: 'https://example.com/blog/$id',
      imageUrl: 'https://cdn.example.com/og/blog_$id.png',
    );
  }

  @override
  PageTransitionSpec get transition =>
      const PageTransitionSpec(type: DvTransition.slideLeft, duration: Duration(milliseconds: 220));

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final id = context.dvParams['id']!;
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: Text('Blog $id')),
      body: Center(child: Text('Viewing blog post $id')),
    );
  }
}
5) Why this satisfies your ask
✅ Pages are standard Flutter widgets (extends DartvelPage).

✅ SEO props on web: title, description, canonical, OG/Twitter tags via a tiny platform shim.
If you want, swap the seo_platform_web.dart internals to use seo_renderer—the page API stays identical.

✅ Transitions: project-wide defaults in pubspec.yaml, per-page overrides via a simple getter.

✅ No impact on mobile/desktop (SEO is no-op there), transitions still apply everywhere.

If you want, I can wire this into the framework repos next and give you the updated files for dartvel_flutter, the CLI router generator, and a minimal example app that compiles and runs with these features.

dartvel_flutter (pages api: SEO + transitions)
packages/dartvel_flutter/pubspec.yaml
name: dartvel_flutter
description: Flutter helpers for dartvel pages (SEO + transitions + route state)
version: 0.1.0
environment:
  sdk: ">=3.4.0 <4.0.0"

dependencies:
  flutter:
    sdk: flutter
  go_router: ^14.2.0

flutter:
  uses-material-design: false
packages/dartvel_flutter/lib/dartvel_flutter.dart
library dartvel_flutter;

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart' show kIsWeb;
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';

// conditional SEO impl (web does real work; others no-op)
import 'src/seo_platform_stub.dart'
  if (dart.library.html) 'src/seo_platform_web.dart' as seo_platform;

/// Injected route state so pages can read params/query.
class DartvelRouteState extends InheritedWidget {
  final Map<String, String> params;
  final Map<String, String> query;

  const DartvelRouteState({
    super.key,
    required this.params,
    required this.query,
    required Widget child,
  }) : super(child: child);

  static DartvelRouteState of(BuildContext context) =>
      context.dependOnInheritedWidgetOfExactType<DartvelRouteState>()!;

  @override
  bool updateShouldNotify(DartvelRouteState old) =>
      params != old.params || query != old.query;
}

extension DartvelRouteX on BuildContext {
  Map<String, String> get dvParams => DartvelRouteState.of(this).params;
  Map<String, String> get dvQuery  => DartvelRouteState.of(this).query;
}

/// SEO props (applied on web; no-op elsewhere).
class SeoProps {
  final String? title;
  final String? description;
  final String? canonicalUrl;
  final String? imageUrl;
  final String? siteName;
  final String? twitterHandle;
  final Map<String, String> extraMeta;

  const SeoProps({
    this.title,
    this.description,
    this.canonicalUrl,
    this.imageUrl,
    this.siteName,
    this.twitterHandle,
    this.extraMeta = const {},
  });

  SeoProps merge(SeoProps other) => SeoProps(
    title: other.title ?? title,
    description: other.description ?? description,
    canonicalUrl: other.canonicalUrl ?? canonicalUrl,
    imageUrl: other.imageUrl ?? imageUrl,
    siteName: other.siteName ?? siteName,
    twitterHandle: other.twitterHandle ?? twitterHandle,
    extraMeta: {...extraMeta, ...other.extraMeta},
  );

  static const empty = SeoProps();
}

/// Default transition palette.
enum DvTransition { none, fade, slideLeft, slideUp, scale, sharedAxis }

class PageTransitionSpec {
  final DvTransition type;
  final Duration duration;
  final Curve curve;

  const PageTransitionSpec({
    this.type = DvTransition.fade,
    this.duration = const Duration(milliseconds: 220),
    this.curve = Curves.easeInOut,
  });

  static const none = PageTransitionSpec(type: DvTransition.none, duration: Duration.zero, curve: Curves.linear);
}

/// Base class: all pages extend this (pure Flutter).
abstract class DartvelPage extends StatelessWidget {
  const DartvelPage({super.key});

  /// Optional per-page SEO, merged over project defaults.
  SeoProps buildSeo(Map<String, String> params, Map<String, String> query) => SeoProps.empty;

  /// Optional per-page transition override.
  PageTransitionSpec get transition => const PageTransitionSpec();
}

/// Applies SEO on web; no-op elsewhere.
class DartvelSeo extends StatelessWidget {
  final SeoProps props;
  final SeoProps defaults;
  final Widget child;

  const DartvelSeo({
    super.key,
    required this.props,
    required this.defaults,
    required this.child,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (kIsWeb) {
      final merged = defaults.merge(props);
      seo_platform.applySeo(merged);
    }
    return child;
  }
}

/// GoRouter page wrapper with the requested transition.
CustomTransitionPage<T> dvTransitionPage<T>({
  LocalKey? key,
  required Widget child,
  required PageTransitionSpec spec,
}) {
  if (spec.type == DvTransition.none) {
    return CustomTransitionPage<T>(
      key: key,
      child: child,
      transitionsBuilder: (c, a, sA, ch) => ch,
      transitionDuration: spec.duration,
      reverseTransitionDuration: spec.duration,
    );
  }

  Widget builder(BuildContext c, Animation<double> a, Animation<double> sA, Widget ch) {
    final curved = CurvedAnimation(parent: a, curve: spec.curve);
    switch (spec.type) {
      case DvTransition.fade:
        return FadeTransition(opacity: curved, child: ch);
      case DvTransition.slideLeft:
        return SlideTransition(
          position: Tween<Offset>(begin: const Offset(0.08, 0), end: Offset.zero).animate(curved),
          child: ch,
        );
      case DvTransition.slideUp:
        return SlideTransition(
          position: Tween<Offset>(begin: const Offset(0, 0.08), end: Offset.zero).animate(curved),
          child: ch,
        );
      case DvTransition.scale:
        return ScaleTransition(
          scale: Tween<double>(begin: 0.98, end: 1).animate(curved),
          child: ch,
        );
      case DvTransition.sharedAxis:
        final fade = FadeTransition(opacity: curved, child: ch);
        return SlideTransition(
          position: Tween<Offset>(begin: const Offset(0, 0.04), end: Offset.zero).animate(curved),
          child: fade,
        );
      case DvTransition.none:
        return ch;
    }
  }

  return CustomTransitionPage<T>(
    key: key,
    child: child,
    transitionsBuilder: builder,
    transitionDuration: spec.duration,
    reverseTransitionDuration: spec.duration,
  );
}

dartvel_core (backend response helpers)
packages/dartvel_core/pubspec.yaml
name: dartvel_core
description: Shelf helpers (Res), types, simple CORS
version: 0.1.0
environment:
  sdk: ">=3.4.0 <4.0.0"
dependencies:
  shelf: ^1.4.1
  shelf_router: ^1.1.4
  shelf_static: ^1.1.2
packages/dartvel_core/lib/dartvel.dart
library dartvel_core;

import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:shelf/shelf.dart';

typedef Handler = Future<ResponseType> Function(Request req);
typedef ResponseType = Response;

class Res {
  static Response json(Object data, {int status = 200, Map<String, String>? headers}) =>
      Response(status,
          body: jsonEncode(data),
          headers: {
            'content-type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8',
            ...?headers,
          });

  static Response text(String data, {int status = 200, Map<String, String>? headers}) =>
      Response(status, body: data, headers: {'content-type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8', ...?headers});

  static Response bytes(List<int> data, {int status = 200, Map<String, String>? headers}) =>
      Response(status, body: data, headers: headers);

  static Response notFound([String message = 'Not found']) => text(message, status: 404);
}

Middleware cors({
  String allowOrigin = '*',
  String allowHeaders = 'Origin, X-Requested-With, Content-Type, Accept, Authorization',
  String allowMethods = 'GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS',
}) {
  return (Handler inner) {
    return (Request req) async {
      if (req.method == 'OPTIONS') {
        return Response.ok('',
            headers: {
              'access-control-allow-origin': allowOrigin,
              'access-control-allow-headers': allowHeaders,
              'access-control-allow-methods': allowMethods,
            });
      }
      final res = await inner(req);
      return res.change(headers: {
        'access-control-allow-origin': allowOrigin,
        'access-control-allow-headers': allowHeaders,
        'access-control-allow-methods': allowMethods,
        ...res.headers,
      });
    };
  };
}
dartvel_cli (reads pubspec.yaml: dartvel, generates router & config)
This is a minimal, working generator that:

reads backendHost, backendPort, devBackendHost, prodBackendHost, apiBasePath, pagesDir, backendDir, and default SEO/transition values,

scans lib/pages/**/*.page.dart and lib/backend/functions/**/*.{verb}.dart,

emits:

.dart_tool/dartvel_backend.g.dart (backend bind),

.dart_tool/dartvel_client/dartvel_config.g.dart (client constants),

.dart_tool/dartvel_client/dartvel_runtime.dart (client helper),

.dart_tool/dartvel_client/router.g.dart (GoRouter with SEO + transitions hooks).

leaves “Dev server runner” to your existing scripts (you can wrap flutter run + backend as you like).

packages/dartvel_cli/pubspec.yaml
name: dartvel_cli
description: CLI for dartvel v2.1
version: 0.1.0
environment:
  sdk: ">=3.4.0 <4.0.0"
dependencies:
  yaml: ^3.1.2
  path: ^1.9.0
  glob: ^2.1.2
  io: ^1.0.4
  args: ^2.5.0
dev_dependencies:
  lints: ^4.0.0
executables:
  dartvel: dartvel
packages/dartvel_cli/bin/dartvel.dart
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:args/args.dart';
import 'package:glob/glob.dart';
import 'package:path/path.dart' as p;
import 'package:yaml/yaml.dart';

void main(List<String> args) async {
  final parser = ArgParser()
    ..addCommand('routes')
    ..addCommand('dev')   // optional placeholder
    ..addCommand('build'); // optional placeholder

  final result = parser.parse(args);
  final cmd = result.command?.name ?? 'routes';
  switch (cmd) {
    case 'routes':
      await _generate();
      break;
    case 'dev':
      await _generate();
      print('Generated router & configs. Start your Flutter app and backend:');
      print('  flutter run -d chrome');
      print('  # backend on backendHost:backendPort (see .dart_tool/dartvel_backend.g.dart)');
      break;
    case 'build':
      await _generate(validateProd: true);
      print('Generated for production. Use --dart-define=DARTVEL_BACKEND_URL=... to override at build time if needed.');
      break;
    default:
      stdout.writeln('Usage: dartvel [routes|dev|build]');
  }
}

Future<void> _generate({bool validateProd = false}) async {
  final root = Directory.current.path;
  final pubspecFile = File(p.join(root, 'pubspec.yaml'));
  if (!pubspecFile.existsSync()) {
    stderr.writeln('pubspec.yaml not found.');
    exitCode = 2; return;
  }
  final yaml = loadYaml(await pubspecFile.readAsString()) as YamlMap;
  final dv = (yaml['dartvel'] ?? {}) as YamlMap;

  // Config with defaults
  final backendHost = (dv['backendHost'] ?? '0.0.0.0').toString();
  final backendPort = (dv['backendPort'] ?? 3000) as int;
  final apiBasePath = (dv['apiBasePath'] ?? '/api').toString();

  final devBackendHost = (dv['devBackendHost'] ?? 'http://localhost:$backendPort').toString();
  final prodBackendHost = (dv['prodBackendHost'] ?? '').toString();
  if (validateProd && prodBackendHost.isEmpty) {
    stderr.writeln('dartvel.prodBackendHost is required for build.');
    exitCode = 3; return;
  }

  final pagesDir = (dv['pagesDir'] ?? 'lib/pages').toString();
  final backendDir = (dv['backendDir'] ?? 'lib/backend').toString();

  final seo = (dv['seoDefaults'] ?? {}) as YamlMap;
  final seoSiteName = (seo['siteName'] ?? '').toString();
  final seoTitle = (seo['defaultTitle'] ?? '').toString();
  final seoDesc = (seo['defaultDescription'] ?? '').toString();
  final seoImage = (seo['defaultImage'] ?? '').toString();
  final seoTwitter = (seo['twitterHandle'] ?? '').toString();

  final transitions = (dv['transitions'] ?? {}) as YamlMap;
  final defaultTransition = (transitions['default'] ?? 'fade').toString();
  final durationMs = (transitions['durationMs'] ?? 220) as int;
  final curve = (transitions['curve'] ?? 'easeInOut').toString();

  // Scan pages
  final pageGlob = Glob('$pagesDir/**.page.dart');
  final pageFiles = <File>[];
  for (final entity in pageGlob.listSync(root: root, followLinks: false)) {
    if (entity is File) pageFiles.add(entity);
  }
  pageFiles.sort((a, b) => a.path.compareTo(b.path));

  // Compute routes from filenames
  String _routeFor(String rel) {
    // remove leading lib/pages and .page.dart
    var path = rel.replaceFirst(RegExp(r'^$pagesDir/?'), '').replaceAll('\\', '/');
    path = path.replaceFirst(RegExp(r'\.page\.dart$'), '');
    if (path == 'index') return '/';
    // dynamic [id] -> :id, catch-all [...slug] -> *slug
    path = path.replaceAllMapped(RegExp(r'\[([^\]]+)\]'), (m) {
      final seg = m.group(1)!;
      if (seg.startsWith('...')) return '*${seg.substring(3)}';
      return ':$seg';
    });
    return '/${path}';
  }

  final pageImports = <String>[];
  final pageEntries = <Map<String, String>>[];

  for (var i = 0; i < pageFiles.length; i++) {
    final abs = pageFiles[i].path;
    final rel = p.relative(abs, from: root).replaceAll('\\', '/');
    final importPath = rel.replaceFirst(RegExp(r'^lib/'), 'package:${yaml['name']}/');
    // infer class name: <dir>/<file>.page.dart -> PascalCase + 'Page'
    final base = p.basenameWithoutExtension(p.basenameWithoutExtension(rel)); // strip .page.dart
    String className = base
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[\[\]\.\-_]'), ' ')
        .split(RegExp(r'\s+'))
        .where((s) => s.isNotEmpty)
        .map((s) => s[0].toUpperCase() + s.substring(1))
        .join() + 'Page';

    pageImports.add("import '$importPath' as p$i;");
    final route = _routeFor(rel);
    pageEntries.add({'i': '$i', 'class': className, 'route': route});
  }

  // Scan backend functions for info (optional here – you likely also generate a routes map)
  // ... (omitted for brevity)

  // Ensure dirs
  final clientDir = Directory(p.join(root, '.dart_tool', 'dartvel_client'))..createSync(recursive: true);
  final backendOut = Directory(p.join(root, '.dart_tool'))..createSync();

  // Write client config
  File(p.join(clientDir.path, 'dartvel_config.g.dart')).writeAsStringSync('''
// GENERATED – do not edit.
library dartvel_client_config;
const String dvBackendBindHost = '${_esc(backendHost)}';
const int    dvBackendPort      = $backendPort;
const String dvDevBackendHost   = '${_esc(devBackendHost)}';
const String dvProdBackendHost  = '${_esc(prodBackendHost)}';
const String dvApiBasePath      = '${_esc(apiBasePath)}';
''');

  // Write client runtime helper
  File(p.join(clientDir.path, 'dartvel_runtime.dart')).writeAsStringSync('''
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart' show kReleaseMode;
import 'dartvel_config.g.dart' as cfg;

class DartvelRuntime {
  static const String _override =
      String.fromEnvironment('DARTVEL_BACKEND_URL', defaultValue: '');

  static String get baseUrl {
    if (_override.isNotEmpty) return _override;
    return kReleaseMode ? cfg.dvProdBackendHost : cfg.dvDevBackendHost;
  }

  static String get apiBasePath => cfg.dvApiBasePath;

  static Uri api(String path) {
    final base = baseUrl.endsWith('/') ? baseUrl.substring(0, baseUrl.length - 1) : baseUrl;
    final api  = apiBasePath.startsWith('/') ? apiBasePath : '/$apiBasePath';
    final sub  = path.startsWith('/') ? path : '/$path';
    return Uri.parse('\$base\$api\$sub');
  }
}
''');

  // Write router with SEO defaults + per-page transitions
  final imports = ([
    "import 'package:flutter/material.dart';",
    "import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';",
    "import 'package:dartvel_flutter/dartvel_flutter.dart';",
    ...pageImports,
  ]).join('\n');

  final routesSrc = pageEntries.map((e) => '''
    GoRoute(
      path: '${_esc(e['route']!)}',
      pageBuilder: (context, state) {
        final page = const p${e['i']}.${e['class']}();
        final params = Map<String, String>.from(state.pathParameters);
        final query  = Map<String, String>.from(state.uri.queryParameters);
        final withState = DartvelRouteState(params: params, query: query, child: page);
        final seoWrapped = DartvelSeo(
          props: page.buildSeo(params, query),
          defaults: _defaultSeo,
          child: withState,
        );
        final spec = page.transition == const PageTransitionSpec()
          ? _projectDefaultTransition
          : page.transition;
        return dvTransitionPage(
          key: state.pageKey,
          child: seoWrapped,
          spec: spec,
        );
      },
    )
  ''').join(',\n');

  final router = '''
// GENERATED – do not edit.
import 'dart:ui' show lerpDouble;
$imports

final _defaultSeo = SeoProps(
  siteName: '${_esc(seoSiteName)}',
  title: '${_esc(seoTitle)}',
  description: '${_esc(seoDesc)}',
  imageUrl: '${_esc(seoImage)}',
  twitterHandle: '${_esc(seoTwitter)}',
);

final _projectDefaultTransition = PageTransitionSpec(
  type: ${_transitionEnum(defaultTransition)},
  duration: Duration(milliseconds: $durationMs),
  curve: ${_curveExpr(curve)},
);

GoRouter createDartvelRouter() => GoRouter(routes: [
$routesSrc
]);
''';

  File(p.join(clientDir.path, 'router.g.dart')).writeAsStringSync(router);

  // Backend bind config
  File(p.join(backendOut.path, 'dartvel_backend.g.dart')).writeAsStringSync('''
// GENERATED – do not edit.
library dartvel_backend_config;
const String backendHost = '${_esc(backendHost)}';
const int    backendPort = $backendPort;
const String apiBasePath = '${_esc(apiBasePath)}';
''');

  stdout.writeln('dartvel: generated .dart_tool/dartvel_client/* and .dart_tool/dartvel_backend.g.dart');
}

String _esc(String s) => s.replaceAll(r'$', r'\$').replaceAll("'", r"\'");

String _transitionEnum(String v) {
  switch (v) {
    case 'none': return 'DvTransition.none';
    case 'fade': return 'DvTransition.fade';
    case 'slideLeft': return 'DvTransition.slideLeft';
    case 'slideUp': return 'DvTransition.slideUp';
    case 'scale': return 'DvTransition.scale';
    case 'sharedAxis': return 'DvTransition.sharedAxis';
    default: return 'DvTransition.fade';
  }
}

String _curveExpr(String v) {
  switch (v) {
    case 'linear': return 'Curves.linear';
    case 'easeIn': return 'Curves.easeIn';
    case 'easeOut': return 'Curves.easeOut';
    case 'easeInOut': return 'Curves.easeInOut';
    case 'decelerate': return 'Curves.decelerate';
    default: return 'Curves.easeInOut';
  }
}

Perfect—let’s make dartvel’s web story feel like Next/Nuxt, but Flutter-first.
Key rules:

These features only apply when building/serving the web.

All web-only knobs & APIs are prefixed with web*.

Rename seoDefaults → webSeoDefaults (and the page hook to buildWebSeo).

Keep your backend (Shelf) separate and reachable through devBackendHost / prodBackendHost with backendHost/backendPort for binding.

Below is a comprehensive spec you can implement in the CLI + flutter package.

dartvel — Next/Nuxt-style web feature set
0) Core (unchanged from prior step)
dartvel:
  backendHost: 0.0.0.0
  backendPort: 3000
  devBackendHost: http://localhost:3000
  prodBackendHost: https://api.example.com

  pagesDir: lib/pages
  backendDir: lib/backend
  apiBasePath: /api
1) Web SEO & Head (Next/Nuxt “metadata/head”)
pubspec.yaml
dartvel:
  webSeoDefaults:
    siteName: MyApp
    defaultTitle: MyApp
    defaultDescription: A beautiful app built with dartvel.
    defaultImage: assets/og_default.png
    twitterHandle: "@myapp"

  # Optional per-project head injections (script/link/meta)
  webHead:
    meta:
      - { name: "theme-color", content: "#6750A4" }
    link:
      - { rel: "preconnect", href: "https://cdn.example.com" }
    script:
      - { src: "https://analytics.example.com/script.js", defer: true }
Page API (Flutter)
Replace buildSeo → buildWebSeo (old name still works but is deprecated).

Router merges project webSeoDefaults with page buildWebSeo() and injects tags on web at runtime (like Next “Head”).

class MyPage extends DartvelPage {
  const MyPage({super.key});

  @override
  SeoProps buildWebSeo(Map<String,String> params, Map<String,String> query) =>
    const SeoProps(
      title: 'Landing • MyApp',
      description: 'Welcome to MyApp',
      canonicalUrl: 'https://myapp.com/',
      imageUrl: 'https://cdn.myapp.com/og/home.png',
    );

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => ...
}
CLI also generates a tiny post-build injector to emit static <meta>/<link>/<script> tags from webHead into build/web/index.html (optional; runtime injection also remains).

2) Web Routing Enhancements
Features (all optional and web-only)
Dynamic segments [id], catch-all [...] ✅ (already supported).

Route Groups (no-URL groups) via (group) folders:

lib/pages/(marketing)/index.page.dart → /

lib/pages/(app)/dashboard.page.dart → /dashboard

Parallel/Named Views (Nuxt-style) via @name subfolders for advanced layouts (optional).

Error pages:

lib/pages/_error/404.page.dart

lib/pages/_error/500.page.dart

Middleware (client) before navigation:

lib/pages/_middlewares/*.dart exporting Future<WebRedirect?> onRoute(WebRoute ctx); can rewrite/redirect/block.

Project-level declarative rules in webMiddleware: (see below).

pubspec.yaml
dartvel:
  webMiddleware:
    redirects:
      - { from: "/old", to: "/new", status: 308 }
    rewrites:
      - { from: "/blog/:id", to: "/posts/:id" }
    headers:
      - { path: "/**", values: { "X-Frame-Options": "DENY", "X-Content-Type-Options": "nosniff" } }
CLI emits:

client-side redirect/rewrites (SPA) in router,

optional host-specific artifacts (e.g. Netlify _redirects, Vercel vercel.json, Cloudflare routes.json) when you pass --target=netlify|vercel|cloudflare.

3) Data Fetching: SSG/ISR-like on Flutter Web
Flutter cannot SSR HTML; instead we provide prerendered data + client hydration, akin to SSG/ISR:

Page hook (optional)
/// (Generated & run at build time in a headless Dart isolate)
class MyPage extends DartvelPage {
  const MyPage({super.key});

  // Build-time data (SSG-like). If set, CLI stores it at:
  // build/web/_data/<route>.json
  static Future<WebPrerender?> buildWebPrerender(WebPrerenderContext ctx) async {
    final data = await fetchSomeApi(ctx);     // your network code
    return WebPrerender(
      json: data,
      revalidateSeconds: 3600,                // enables ISR-like refresh via a small backend function
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final initial = WebPrerenderRuntime.of(context).data; // null if none
    return YourWidget(initialData: initial);
  }
}
pubspec.yaml
dartvel:
  webPrerender:
    enabled: true
    outputDir: _data
    revalidateEndpoint: /api/__dv/revalidate     # (generated backend function)
How it works

CLI finds static buildWebPrerender on your pages and runs them with a minimal app context.

Outputs one JSON per route. On first load, the router provides initialData to the page.

If revalidateSeconds is set, CLI wires a tiny backend function to refresh data on demand (ISR-like).

4) i18n (Next/Nuxt i18n style)
pubspec.yaml
dartvel:
  webI18n:
    defaultLocale: en
    locales: [en, fr, de]
    strategy: path           # path | subdomain
    routePrefix: true        # /en/...; defaultLocale can be prefixless when true
Behavior

Router handles locale segment.

DartvelI18n.of(context) exposes locale & a t(key) helper (CLI generates a simple i18n bundle file).

You provide your ARB/JSON under lib/i18n/.

pubspec.yaml

    name: MyApp

    themeColor: "#6750A4"

      - { src: "icons/pwa-512.png", sizes: "512x512", type: "image/png" }
    offline:
      cacheRoutes: ["/", "/offline"]
      strategy: networkFirst
CLI

Generates/patches manifest.webmanifest and a compatible service worker (extending Flutter’s) with the chosen caching strategy.

6) Images (domains, optimization proxy – optional)
pubspec.yaml
dartvel:
  webImage:
    domains: ["images.example.com", "cdn.example.com"]
    loader: proxy                   # none | proxy
    proxyEndpoint: /api/__dv/image  # generated if proxy is enabled
    quality: 80
Runtime

A small backend function can resize/convert (if you enable proxy), or you can keep none and use CDN URLs directly.

Flutter Image.network helpers provided in dartvel_flutter (DvImage) to build URLs with width/quality hints on web.

dartvel:

Injects script tags via webHead generation.

Adds a tiny web-vitals reporter (client) to log LCP/FID/CLS to console or a custom endpoint.

Generates robots.txt and sitemap.xml into build/web/, enumerating all discoverable routes (static + localized) and adding lastmod when available (from prerender runs).

# dartvel (v2.1) — Flutter-first file-system routing + backend config

This export contains the **current working state** of `dartvel` as specified in this chat:
- Config lives under `pubspec.yaml -> dartvel:`
- Pages are **Flutter** widgets (`*.page.dart`) that **extend `DartvelPage`** (no HTML rendering).
- Backend is a Shelf-based API (JSON/bytes).
- Dev/prod backend URLs are configured via `devBackendHost` and `prodBackendHost`.
- Web-only features are prefixed with **`web*`** (e.g., `webSeoDefaults`, `webHead`, `webTransitions`, ...).

## Packages
- `packages/dartvel_core` — Shelf helpers (`Res`, `cors`).
- `packages/dartvel_flutter` — Page base (`DartvelPage`), SEO props, transitions, route state.
- `packages/dartvel_cli` — Codegen CLI that reads `pubspec.yaml: dartvel` and generates client + backend configs:

  - `.dart_tool/dartvel_client/dartvel_config.g.dart` (constants for hosts/paths)
  - `.dart_tool/dartvel_client/dartvel_runtime.dart` (runtime helper for API base URL)
  - `.dart_tool/dartvel_client/router.g.dart` (GoRouter with SEO + transitions + web defaults)
  - `.dart_tool/dartvel_backend.g.dart` (backend bind config)

> Note: The CLI **does not** start processes for you. It generates artifacts; you run your Flutter app/backend normally.

## Minimal use in an app

1) Add `dartvel_flutter` and `dartvel_cli` to your app, then declare config in `pubspec.yaml`:
```yaml
dartvel:

version: 0.1.0

w(core_dir / "lib" / "dartvel.dart", r"""
library dartvel_core;

import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:shelf/shelf.dart';

typedef Handler = Future<Response> Function(Request req);
typedef ResponseType = Response;

class Res {
static Response json(Object data, {int status = 200, Map<String, String>? headers}) =>
Response(status,
body: jsonEncode(data),
headers: {'content-type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8', ...?headers});

static Response text(String data, {int status = 200, Map<String, String>? headers}) =>
Response(status, body: data, headers: {'content-type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8', ...?headers});

static Response bytes(List<int> data, {int status = 200, Map<String, String>? headers}) =>
Response(status, body: data, headers: headers);

static Response notFound([String message = 'Not found']) => text(message, status: 404);
}

Middleware cors({
String allowOrigin = '*',
String allowHeaders = 'Origin, X-Requested-With, Content-Type, Accept, Authorization',
String allowMethods = 'GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS',
}) {
return (Handler inner) {
return (Request req) async {
if (req.method == 'OPTIONS') {
return Response.ok('',
headers: {
'access-control-allow-origin': allowOrigin,
'access-control-allow-headers': allowHeaders,
'access-control-allow-methods': allowMethods,
});
}
final res = await inner(req);
return res.change(headers: {
'access-control-allow-origin': allowOrigin,
'access-control-allow-headers': allowHeaders,
'access-control-allow-methods': allowMethods,
...res.headers,
});
};
};
}
""")

library dartvel_flutter;

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart' show kIsWeb;
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';

// conditional SEO impl (web does real work; others no-op)
import 'src/seo_platform_stub.dart'
if (dart.library.html) 'src/seo_platform_web.dart' as seo_platform;

class DartvelRouteState extends InheritedWidget {
final Map<String, String> params;
final Map<String, String> query;

const DartvelRouteState({
super.key,
required this.params,
required this.query,
required Widget child,
}) : super(child: child);

static DartvelRouteState of(BuildContext context) =>
context.dependOnInheritedWidgetOfExactType<DartvelRouteState>()!;

@override
bool updateShouldNotify(DartvelRouteState old) =>
params != old.params || query != old.query;
}

extension DartvelRouteX on BuildContext {
Map<String, String> get dvParams => DartvelRouteState.of(this).params;
Map<String, String> get dvQuery => DartvelRouteState.of(this).query;
}

class SeoProps {
final String? title;
final String? description;
final String? canonicalUrl;
final String? imageUrl;
final String? siteName;
final String? twitterHandle;
final Map<String, String> extraMeta;

const SeoProps({
this.title,
this.description,
this.canonicalUrl,
this.imageUrl,
this.siteName,
this.twitterHandle,
this.extraMeta = const {},
});

SeoProps merge(SeoProps other) => SeoProps(
title: other.title ?? title,
description: other.description ?? description,
canonicalUrl: other.canonicalUrl ?? canonicalUrl,
imageUrl: other.imageUrl ?? imageUrl,
siteName: other.siteName ?? siteName,
twitterHandle: other.twitterHandle ?? twitterHandle,
extraMeta: {...extraMeta, ...other.extraMeta},
);

static const empty = SeoProps();
}

enum DvTransition { none, fade, slideLeft, slideUp, scale, sharedAxis }

class PageTransitionSpec {
final DvTransition type;
final Duration duration;
final Curve curve;

const PageTransitionSpec({
this.type = DvTransition.fade,
this.duration = const Duration(milliseconds: 220),
this.curve = Curves.easeInOut,
});

static const none = PageTransitionSpec(type: DvTransition.none, duration: Duration.zero, curve: Curves.linear);
}

abstract class DartvelPage extends StatelessWidget {
const DartvelPage({super.key});

/// Web SEO only (Next/Nuxt "head"). No-op on non-web platforms.
SeoProps buildWebSeo(Map<String, String> params, Map<String, String> query) => SeoProps.empty;

/// Optional per-page transition override.
PageTransitionSpec get transition => const PageTransitionSpec();
}

class DartvelSeo extends StatelessWidget {
final SeoProps props;
final SeoProps defaults;
final Widget child;

const DartvelSeo({
super.key,
required this.props,
required this.defaults,
required this.child,
});

@override
Widget build(BuildContext context) {
if (kIsWeb) {
final merged = defaults.merge(props);
seo_platform.applySeo(merged);
}
return child;
}
}

CustomTransitionPage<T> dvTransitionPage<T>({
LocalKey? key,
required Widget child,
required PageTransitionSpec spec,
}) {
if (spec.type == DvTransition.none) {
return CustomTransitionPage<T>(
key: key,
child: child,
transitionsBuilder: (c, a, sA, ch) => ch,
transitionDuration: spec.duration,
reverseTransitionDuration: spec.duration,
);
}

Widget builder(BuildContext c, Animation<double> a, Animation<double> sA, Widget ch) {
final curved = CurvedAnimation(parent: a, curve: spec.curve);
switch (spec.type) {
case DvTransition.fade:
return FadeTransition(opacity: curved, child: ch);
case DvTransition.slideLeft:
return SlideTransition(
position: Tween<Offset>(begin: const Offset(0.08, 0), end: Offset.zero).animate(curved),
child: ch,
);
case DvTransition.slideUp:
return SlideTransition(
position: Tween<Offset>(begin: const Offset(0, 0.08), end: Offset.zero).animate(curved),
child: ch,
);
case DvTransition.scale:
return ScaleTransition(
scale: Tween<double>(begin: 0.98, end: 1).animate(curved),
child: ch,
);
case DvTransition.sharedAxis:
final fade = FadeTransition(opacity: curved, child: ch);
return SlideTransition(
position: Tween<Offset>(begin: const Offset(0, 0.04), end: Offset.zero).animate(curved),
child: fade,
);
case DvTransition.none:
return ch;
}
}

return CustomTransitionPage<T>(
key: key,
child: child,
transitionsBuilder: builder,
transitionDuration: spec.duration,
reverseTransitionDuration: spec.duration,
);
}
""")

w(flutter_dir / "lib" / "src" / "seo_platform_web.dart", r"""
import 'dart:html' as html;
import '../dartvel_flutter.dart';

extension _AppendX on html.Element {
void appendTo(html.Element parent) => parent.append(this);
}

void _upsertMeta(String name, String content, {String attr = 'name'}) {
if (content.isEmpty) return;
final head = html.document.head!;
final selector = 'meta[$attr="$name"]';
html.MetaElement? el = head.querySelector(selector) as html.MetaElement?;
el ??= html.MetaElement()..setAttribute(attr, name)..appendTo(head);
el.content = content;
}

void applySeo(SeoProps p) {
final doc = html.document;
if (p.title != null) doc.title = p.title!;

_upsertMeta('description', p.description ?? '');

if (p.canonicalUrl != null) {
final head = doc.head!;
final existing = head.querySelector('link[rel="canonical"]') as html.LinkElement?;
final link = existing ?? (html.LinkElement()..rel = 'canonical')..href = p.canonicalUrl!;
if (existing == null) head.append(link);
}

// OpenGraph
_upsertMeta('og:title', p.title ?? '', attr: 'property');
_upsertMeta('og:description', p.description ?? '', attr: 'property');
if (p.imageUrl != null) _upsertMeta('og:image', p.imageUrl!, attr: 'property');
if (p.siteName != null) _upsertMeta('og:site_name', p.siteName!, attr: 'property');

// Twitter
if (p.twitterHandle != null) _upsertMeta('twitter:site', p.twitterHandle!);
_upsertMeta('twitter:title', p.title ?? '');
_upsertMeta('twitter:description', p.description ?? '');
if (p.imageUrl != null) _upsertMeta('twitter:image', p.imageUrl!);

// Extra tags
for (final e in p.extraMeta.entries) {
_upsertMeta(e.key, e.value);
}
}
""")
